Bava Metzia 58b:7-13: Gemara tanu rabbanan: "lo tonu ish et amito" – beonaat devarim hakkatuv medabber. atta omer beonaat devarim, o eno ella beonaat mamon? keshehu omer "vechi timkeru mimkar laamitecha o kano miyyad amitecha", hare onaat mamon amur! ha ma ani mekayyem "lo tonu ish et amito"? beonaat devarim.

Ha ketzad? im haya baal teshuva, al yomar lo: "zechor maasecha harishonim". im haya ben gerim, al yomar lo: "zechor maase avotecha". im haya ger uva lilmod tora, al yomar lo: "pe sheachal nevelot uterefot, shekatzim uremasim, ba lilmod tora shenneemra mippi haggevura"?

Im hayu yissurin bain alav, im hayu cholaim bain alav, o shehaya mekabber et banav, al yomar lo kederech sheamru lo chaverav leiyyov: "halo yiratcha kislatecha tikvatcha vetom derachecha. zechor na mi hu naki avad".

Im hayu chammarim mevakkeshin tevua mimmennu, lo yomar lahem: "lechu etzel peloni shehu mocher tevua", veyodea bo shello machar meolam. rabbi yehuda omer: af lo yitle enav al hammikkach, beshaa sheen lo damim, shehare haddavar masur lallev, vechol davar hammasur lallev neemar bo "veyareta meelohecha".

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: gadol onaat devarim meonaat mamon, shezze neemar bo "veyareta meelohecha", veze lo neemar bo "veyareta meelohecha". verabbi elazar omer: ze begufo veze bemamono. rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: ze nittan lehishshavon, veze lo nittan lehishshavon.

Tane tanna kammeh derav nachman bar yitzchak: kol hammalbin pene chavero barabbim, keillu shofech damim. amar leh: shappir ka amrat, dechazena leh deazel summaka veate chiuora. amar leh abbaye lerav dimi: bemareva bemay zehiri? amar leh: beachvore appe, deamar rabbi chanina: hakkol yordin legehinnam, chutz mishshelosha.

Hakkol salka datach? ella ema: kol hayyordin legehinnam olim, chutz mishshelosha sheyyordin veen olin. veellu hen: habba al eshet ish, vehammalbin pene chavero barabbim, vehamechanne shem ra lachavero. mechanne hayeynu malbin? af al gav dedash beh bishmeh.
Berakhot 6b:18-28: Amar rav huna: kol hammitpallel achore bet hakkeneset nikra "rasha", shenneemar: "saviv reshaim yithallachun".
Amar abbaye: la amaran ella dela mahdar appeh leve kenishta, aval mahdar appeh leve kenishta — let lan ba.
Hahu gavra deka metzalle achore be kenishta, vela mahdar appeh leve kenishta. chalaf eliyyahu. chazyeh, iddemi leh ketayyaya, amar leh: kedu var kayymat kamme marach?! shelaf safsera vekatleh.
Amar leh hahu merabbanan lerav bivi bar abbaye, veamri la rav bivi lerav nachman bar yitzchak: may "kerum zullut livne adam"?
Amar leh: ellu devarim sheomdim berumo shel olam, uvene adam mezalzelin bahen.
Rabbi yochanan verabbi elazar deamri tarvayyhu: kevan shennitztarech adam labberiyyot, panav mishtannot kichrum, shenneemar: "kerum zullut livne adam".
May "kerum"? ki ata rav dimi, amar: of echad yesh bichrakke hayyam, ucherum" shemo, vechevan shechamma zorachat mithappech lechamma gevonin.
Rabbi amme verabbi assi deamri tarvayyhu: keillu niddon bishne dinim, esh umayim, shenneemar: "hirkavta enosh leroshenu banu vaesh uvammayim".

Veamar rabbi chelbo, amar rav huna: leolam yehe adam zahir bitfillat hammincha, shehare eliyyahu lo naana ella bitfillat hammincha, shenneemar: "vayhi baalot hammincha vayyiggash eliyyahu hannavi vayyomar vegomer aneni Adonai aneni".
"Aneni" — shettered esh min hashshamayim, vaaneni" — shello yomru maase cheshafim hem.

Rabbi yochanan amar: af bitfillat arvit, shenneemar: "tikkon tefillati ketoret lefanecha masat kappay minchat arev". rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: af tefillat shacharit, shenneemar: "Adonai boker tishma koli, boker eeroch lecha vaatzappe".
Ezekiel 28:25-29:4: Ko-amar adonay Adonai bekabbetzi ׀ et-bet yisrael min-haammim asher nafotzu vam venikdashti vam leene haggoyim veyashvu al-admatam asher natatti leavdi leyaakov
Veyashvu aleha lavetach uvanu vattim venatu cheramim veyashvu lavetach baasoti shefatim bechol hashshatim otam missevivotam veyadu ki ani Adonai elohehem {p}

Ezekiel 29:14-19: Veshavti et-shevut mitzrayim vahashivoti otam eretz patros al-eretz mechuratam vehayu sham mamlacha shefala

Venatatti et-eretz mitzrayim shemama betoch ׀ aratzot neshammot veareha betoch arim mochoravot tihyena shemama arbaim shana vahafitzoti et-mitzrayim baggoyim vezeritim baaratzot {s}

Mishnah Middot 1:1-4: Bishlosha mekomot hakkohanim shomrim bevet hammikdash, bevet avtinas, uvevet hannitzotz, uvevet hammoked. vehaleviyyim beesrim veechad makom. chamishsha, al chamishsha shaare har habbayit. arbaa, al arba pinnotav mittocho. chamishsha, al chamishsha shaare haazara. arbaa, al arba pinnoteha mibbachutz. veechad belishkat hakkarban, veechad belishkat happarochet, veechad laachore vet hakkapporet:

Ish har habbayit haya mechazzer al kol mishmar umishmar, vaavukot dolkin lefanav, vechol mishmar sheeno omed, omer lo ish har habbayit, shalom alecha. nikkar shehu yashen, chovto vemaklo. ureshut haya lo lisrof et kesuto. vehem omrim, ma kol baazara. kol ben levi loke uvegadav nisrafin, sheyyashen lo al mishmaro. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, paam achat matzu et achi imma yashen, vesarfu et kesuto:

Chamishsha shearim hayu lehar habbayit. shene shaare chulda min haddarom, meshammeshin kenisa vitzia. kifonos min hammaarav, meshammesh kenisa vitzia. tadi min hatztzafon, lo haya meshammesh kelum. shaar hammizrachi, alav shushan habbira tzura, shebbo chohen gadol hassoref et happara ufara vechol mesaadeha yotzim lehar hammishcha:

Shiva shearim hayu vaazara, shelosha vatztzafon ushelosha vaddarom veechad bammizrach. shebbaddarom, shaar haddelek. sheni lo, shaar habbechorot. shelishi lo, shaar hammayim. shebbammizrach, shaar nikkanor, ushete leshachot hayu lo, achat mimino veachat missemolo, achat lishkat pinchas hammalbish, veachat lishkat ose chavittin:
Mishnah Middot 1:5-8: Veshebbatztzafon, shaar hannitzotz. uchemin achsadra haya, vaaliyya venuya al gabbav, shehakkohanim shomrim milmalan vehaleviyyim millemattan, ufetach haya lo lachel. sheni lo, shaar hakkarban. shelishi lo, bet hammoked:

Vearba leshachot hayu bevet hammoked, kekitonot petuchot litraklin, shetayim bakkodesh ushetayim bachol, verashe fispasin mavdilin ben kodesh lachol. ume hayu meshammeshot. maaravit deromit, hi hayta lishkat telae karban. deromit mizrachit, hi hayta lishkat ose lechem happanim. mizrachit tzefonit, bah ganzu vene chashmonay et avne hammizbeach sheshshikketzum malche yavan. tzefonit maaravit, bah yordim levet hattevila:
Shenayim shearim hayu levet hammoked, echad patuach lachel veechad patuach laazara. amar rabbi yehuda, ze shehaya fatuach laazara, pishpash katan haya lo, shebbo nichnasin livlosh et haazara:
Bet hammoked, kippa, uvayit gadol haya, mukkaf rovadin shel even, vezikne vet av yeshenim sham, umaftechot haazara beyadam, ufirche chehunna, ish kisto vaaretz:
Mishnah Middot 1:9-2:3: Umakom haya sham, amma al amma, vetavla shel shayish vetabbaat hayta kevua vah, veshalshelet shehammaftechot hayu teluyot bah. higgia zeman hanneila, higbiah et hattavla battabbaat venatal et hammaftechot min hashshalshelet, venaal hakkohen mibbifnim, uven levi yashen lo mibbachutz. gamar millinol, hechezir et hammaftechot lashshalshelet veet hattavla limkomah, natan kesuto aleha, yashen lo. era keri beachad mehem, yotze veholech lo vammesibba haholechet tachat habbira, vehannerot dolkim mikkan umikkan, ad shehu maggia levet hattevila. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, bammesibba haholechet tachat hachel yotze veholech lo betadi:

Har habbayit haya chamesh meot amma al chamesh meot amma, rubbo min haddarom, sheni lo min hammizrach, shelishi lo min hatztzafon, miuto min hammaarav. mekom shehaya rov middato, sham haya rov tashmisho:

Kol hannichnasin lehar habbayit nichnasin derech yamin umakkifin veyotzin derech semol, chutz mimmi sheero davar, shehu makkif lismol. ma lecha makkif lismol, sheani avel, hashshochen babbayit hazze yenachamekka. sheani menudde, hashshochen babbayit hazze yitten belibbam vikarvucha, divre rabbi meir. amar lo rabbi yose, asitan keillu avru alav et haddin. ella, hashshochen babbayit hazze yitten belibbecha vetishma ledivre chaverecha vikarvucha:

Lifnim mimmennu, soreg, gavoah asara tefachim. ushelosh esre feratzot hayu sham, shepperatzum malche yavan. chazru ugedarum, vegazru chenegdam shelosh esre hishtachavayot. lifnim mimmennu, hachel, eser ammot. ushetem esre maalot hayu sham. rum hammaala chatzi amma, veshilchah chatzi amma. kol hammaalot shehayu sham, rum maala chatzi amma, veshilchah chatzi amma, chutz mishshel ulam. kol happetachim vehashshearim shehayu sham, gavhan esrim amma, verachban eser ammot, chutz mishshel ulam. kol happetachim shehayu sham, hayu lahen delatot, chutz mishshel ulam. kol hashshearim shehayu sham, hayu lahen shekofot, chutz mishshaar tadi, shehayu sham shete avanim muttot zo al gav zo. kol hashshearim shehayu sham, nishtannu lihyot shel zahav, chutz mishshaar nikkanor, mippene shennaasa vahen nes. veyesh omrim, mippene shennechushtan matzhiv:
Mishnah Middot 2:4-3:1: Kol hakketalim shehayu sham, hayu gevohim, chutz mikkotel hammizrachi, shehakkohen hassoref et happara omed berosh har hammishcha, umitkavven veroe vefitcho shel hechol bishat hazzayat haddam:

Ezrat hannashim hayta orech mea usheloshim vechamesh al rochav mea usheloshim vechamesh. vearba leshachot hayu vearba miktzooteha, shel arbaim arbaim amma. velo hayu mekorot. vechach hem atidim lihyot, shenneemar (yechezkel 46), vayyotzieni el hechatzer hachitzona vayyaavireni el arbaat miktzoe hechatzer vehinne chatzer bemiktzoa hechatzer, chatzer bemiktzoa hechatzer, bearbaat miktzoot hechatzer chatzerot keturot. veen keturot ella sheenan mekorot. ume hayu meshammeshot. deromit mizrachit, hi hayta lishkat hannezirim, sheshsham hannezirim mevashshelin et shalmehen, umegallechin et searan, umeshallechim tachat haddud. mizrachit tzefonit, hi hayta lishkat haetzim, sheshsham hakkohanim baale mumin matliin haetzim. vechol etz shennimtza vo tolaat, pasul meal gabbe hammizbeach. tzefonit maaravit, hi hayta lishkat metzoraim. maaravit deromit, amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov, shachachti me hayta meshammeshet. abba shaul omer, sham hayu notnin yayin vashemen, hi hayta nikret lishkat bet shemanya. vachalaka hayta barishona, vehikkifuha chetzotzra, shehannashim root milmalan, vehaanashim millemattan, kede shello yehu meoravin. vachamesh esre maalot olot mittochah leezrat yisrael, keneged chamesh esre maalot shebbattehillim, shealehen haleviyyim omrim bashshir. lo hayu terutot, ella mukkafot kachatzi goren agulla:

Uleshachot hayu tachat ezrat yisrael, ufetuchot leezrat hannashim, sheshsham haleviyyim notnim kinnorot unevalim umetziltayim vechol kele shir. ezrat yisrael hayta orech mea amma usheloshim vechamesh al rochav achat esre. vechen ezrat kohanim hayta orech mea usheloshim vechamesh al rochav achat esre. verashe fispasin mavdilin ben ezrat yisrael leezrat hakkohanim. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, maala hayta sham, ugevoha amma, vehadduchan natun aleha, uvah shalosh maalot shel chatzi chatzi amma. nimtzet ezrat hakkohanim gevoha meezrat yisrael shete ammot umechetza. kol haazara hayta orech mea ushemonim vasheva al rochav mea usheloshim vechamesh. ushelosh esre hishtachavayot hayu sham. abba yose ven chanan omer, keneged shelosha asar shearim. shearim deromiyyim semuchim lammaarav, shaar haelyon, shaar haddelek, shaar habbechorot, shaar hammayim, velamma nikra shemo shaar hammayim. shebbo machnisin tzelochit shel mayim shel nissuch bechag. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, uvo hammayim mefakkim, vaatidin lihyot yotzin mittachat miftan habbayit. uleummatan batztzafon semuchim lammaarav, shaar yechanya, shaar hakkarban, shaar hannashim, shaar hashshir. velamma nikra shemo shaar yechanya, shebbo yatza yechanya begaluto. shebbammizrach, shaar nikkanor. ushene fishpashim hayu lo, echad mimino veechad missemolo. ushenayim bamaarav, lo haya lahem shem:

Hammizbeach haya sheloshim ushetayim al sheloshim ushetayim. ala amma vechanas amma, ze hayesod. nimtza sheloshim al sheloshim. ala chamesh vechanas amma. ze hassovev. nimtza esrim ushemone al esrim ushemone. mekom hakkeranot amma mizze veamma mizze. nimtza esrim vashesh al esrim vashesh. mekom hilluch ragle hakkohanim, amma mizze veamma mizze. nimtza esrim vearba al esrim vearba, mekom hammaaracha. amar rabbi yose, mittechilla lo haya ella shemone veesrim al shemone veesrim, kones veole bemidda zo, ad shennimtza mekom hammaaracha esrim al esrim. ucheshealu vene haggola, hosifu alav arba ammot min haddarom vearba ammot min hammaarav, kemin gamma, shenneemar (yechezkel mag), vehaariel shetem esre orech bishtem esre rochav ravua. yachol sheeno ella shetem esre al shetem esre, keshehu omer (sham) el arbaat revaav, melammed shemmin haemtza hu moded shetem esre amma lechol ruach. vechut shel sikra chogro vaemtza, lehavedil ben haddamim haelyonim laddamim hattachtonim. vehayesod haya mehallech al pene chol hatztzafon veal pene chol hammaarav, veochel baddarom amma achat, uvammizrach amma echat:
Mishnah Sheviit 10:1-4:
Sheviit, meshammetet et hammilva bishtar veshello vishtar. hakkafat hachanut, enah meshammetet, veim asaah milva, hare ze meshammet. rabbi yehuda omer, harishon harishon meshammet. sechar sachir, eno meshammet, veim asao milva, hare ze meshammet. rabbi yose omer, kol melacha shepposeket bashsheviit, meshammetet, vesheenah poseket bashsheviit, enah meshammetet: 
Hashshochet et happara vechillekah berosh hashshana, im haya hachodesh meubbar, meshammet. veim lav, eno meshammet. haones, vehamefatte, vehammotzi shem ra, vechol maase vet din, en meshammetin. hammalve al hammashkon, vehammoser shetarotav levet din, enan meshammetin: 
Perozbul, eno meshammet. ze echad min haddevarim shehitkin hillel hazzaken, kesheraa shennimneu haam millehalvot ze et ze veovrin al ma shekkatuv battora (Devarim 15) hishshamer lecha pen yihye davar im levavcha beliyyaal vegomer, hitkin hillel lapperozbul: 
Zehu gufo shel perozbul. moser ani lachem ish peloni ufeloni haddayyanim shebbemakom peloni, shekkol chov sheyyesh li, sheegbennu kol zeman sheertze. vehaddayyanim chotmin lematta, o haedim:
Mishnah Sheviit 10:5-9:
Perozbul hammukdam, kasher, vehameuchar, pasul. shitre chov hammukdamim, pesulim, vehameucharim, kesherim. echad love mechamishsha, kotev perozbul lechol echad veechad. chamishsha lovin meechad, eno chotev ella perozbul echad lechullam: 
En kotvin perozbul ella al hakkarka. im en lo, mezakke hu betoch sadehu kol shehu. hayta lo sade memushkenet bair, kotvin aleha perozbul. rabbi chutzpit omer, kotvin laish al nichse ishto, velaytomim al nichse appotroppin: 
Kavveret devorim, rabbi eliezer omer, hare hi chekarka, vechotvin aleha perozbul, veenah mekabbelet tuma bimkomah, veharode mimmenna beshabbat chayyav. vachachamim omrim, enah kekarka, veen kotvin aleha perozbul, umekabbelet tuma bimkomah, veharode mimmenna beshabbat, patur: 
Hammachazir chov bashsheviit, yomar lo meshammet ani. amar lo af al pi chen, yekabbel mimmennu, shenneemar (Devarim 15) veze devar hashshemitta. kayyotze vo, rotzeach sheggala leir miklat veratzu anshe hair lechabbedo, yomar lahem, rotzeach ani. amru lo, af al pi chen, yekabbel mehem, shenneemar (sham 19) veze devar harotzeach: 
Hammachazir chov bashsheviit, ruach chachamim nocha mimmennu. hallove min hagger shennitgayyeru vanav immo, lo yachazir levanav. veim hechezir, ruach chachamim nocha mimmennu. kol hammittaltelin, niknin bimshicha. vechol hamekayyem et devaro, ruach chachamim nocha mimmennu:
Mishnah Sotah 1:9-2:4:
Vechen leinyan hattova. miryam himtina lemoshe shaa achat, shenneemar (Shemot b) vattetatztzav achoto merachok, lefichach nitakkevu lah yisrael shiva yamim bammidbar, shenneemar (Bamidbar 12) vehaam lo nasa ad heasef miryam. yosef zacha likbor et aviv, veen beechav gadol mimmennu, shenneemar (Bereshit 50) vayyaal yosef likbor et aviv, vayyaal immo gam rechev gam parashim. mi lanu gadol miyyosef, shello nitassek bo ella moshe. moshe zacha veatzmot yosef, veen beyisrael gadol mimmennu, shenneemar (Shemot 13) vayyikkach moshe et atzmot yosef immo. mi gadol mimmoshe, shello nitassek bo ella hammakom, shenneemar (Devarim led) vayyikbor oto vaggay. lo al moshe vilvad amru, ella al kol hatztzaddikim, shenneemar (yeshaya noach) vehalach lefanecha tzidkecha kevod Adonai yaasfecha: 
Haya mevi et minchatah betoch kefifa mitzrit venotnah al yadeha kede leyaggeah. kol hammenachot techillatan vesofan bichli sharet, vezo techillatah bichfifa mitzrit vesofah bichli sharet. kol hammenachot teunot shemen ulevona, vezo enah teuna lo shemen velo levona. kol hammenachot baot min hachittin, vezo vaa min hasseorin. minchat haomer af al pi shebbaa min hasseorin hi hayta vaa geres, vezo vaa kemach. rabban gamliel omer, keshem shemmaaseha maase vehema, kach karbanah maachal behema: 
Haya mevi feyali shel cheres chadasha, venoten letochah chatzi log mayim min hakkiyyor. rabbi yehuda omer, reviit. keshem shemmemaet bakketav, kach memaet bammayim. nichnas lahechol ufana limino, umakom haya sham amma al amma, vetavla shel shayish, vetabbaat hayta kevua vah. ucheshehu magbihah, notel afar mittachteha venoten kede sheyyerae al hammayim, shenneemar (Bamidbar 5) umin heafar asher yihye bekarka hammishkan yikkach hakkohen venatan el hammayim: 
Ba lo lichtov et hammegilla, meeze makom hu chotev, (Bamidbar 5) meim lo shachav ish vegomer, veat ki satit tachat ishech vegomer. veeno chotev vehishbia hakkohen et haishsha vegomer. vechotev yitten Adonai otach leala velishvua vegomer, uvau hammayim hamearrim haelle bemeayich latzbot beten velanpil yarech. veeno chotev veamra haishsha amen amen. rabbi yose omer, lo haya mafsik. rabbi yehuda omer, kol atzmo eno chotev, ella yitten Adonai otach leala velishvua vegomer uvau hammayim hamearrim haelle bemeayich vegomer. veeno chotev veamra haishsha amen amen: 
Eno chotev lo al halluach velo al hanneyar velo al haddiftera, ella al hammegilla, shenneemar (sham) bassefer. veeno chotev lo vekomos velo vekankantom velo vechol davar sheroshem, ella vidyo, shenneemar (sham) umacha, ketav sheyyachol lehimmachek:
Mishnah Sotah 2:5-3:2:
Al ma hi omeret amen amen. amen al haala, amen al hashshevua. amen meish ze, amen meish acher. amen shello satiti arusa unesua veshomeret yavam uchenusa, amen shello nitmeti. veim nitmeti, yavou vi. rabbi meir omer, amen shello nitmeti, amen shello ettame: 
Hakkol shavin sheeno matne immah lo al kodem shettitares velo al meachar shettitgaresh. nistera leacher venitmet veachar kach hechezirah, lo haya matne immah. ze hakkelal, kol shettibbael velo hayta asura lo, lo haya matne immah: 
Haya notel et minchatah mittoch kefifa mitzrit venotnah letoch keli sharet, venotnah al yadah. vechohen meniach yado mittachteha umenifah: 
Henif vehiggish, kamatz vehiktir, vehashshear neechol lakkohanim. haya mashkah veachar kach makriv et minchatah. rabbi shimon omer, makriv et minchatah veachar kach haya mashkah, shenneemar (Bamidbar 5) veachar yashke et haishsha et hammayim. im hishkah veachar kach hikriv et minchatah, keshera:
Mishnah Sotah 3:3-6:
Ad shello nimchaka hammegilla amra eni shota, megillatah nignezet, uminchatah mitpazzeret al haddashen. veen megillatah keshera lehashekot bah sota acheret. nimchaka hammegilla veamra temea ani, hammayim nishpachin uminchatah mitpazzeret al haddashen. nimchaka hammegilla veamra eni shota, meararim otah umashkin otah beal karchah: 
Enah maspeket lishtot ad sheppaneha morikot veeneha boltot vehi mitmallet gidin, vehem omrim hotziuha hotziuha, shello tetamme haazara. im yesh lah zechut, hayta tola lah. yesh zechut tola shana achat, yesh zechut tola shete shanim, yesh zechut tola shalosh shanim. mikkan omer ben azzay, chayyav adam lelammed et bitto tora, sheim tishte, teda shehazzechut tola lah. rabbi eliezer omer, kol hamelammed et bitto tora, keillu melammedah tiflut. rabbi yehoshua omer, rotza ishsha vekav vetiflut mittisha kabbin uferishut. hu haya omer, chasid shote, verasha arum, veishsha ferusha, umakkot perushin, hare ellu mechalle olam: 
Rabbi shimon omer, en zechut tola vammayim hammarim. veim atta omer, hazzechut tola vammayim hamearrim, madhe atta et hammayim bifne chol hannashim hashshotot, umotzi atta shem ra al hattehorot sheshshatu, sheomrim temeot hen ella shettalta lahen zechut. rabbi omer, hazzechut tola vammayim hamearrim, veenah yoledet veenah mashbachat, ella mitnavvena veholechet, lesof hi meta beotah mita: 
Nitmet minchatah ad shello kadsha vakkeli, hare hi kechol hammenachot vetippade, veim mishshekkadsha vakkeli, hare hi kechol hammenachot vetissaref. veellu shemminchotehen nisrafot, haomeret temea ani lecha, veshebbau lah edim shehi temea, vehaomeret eni shota, veshebbalah eno rotze lehashekotah, veshebbalah ba aleha vadderech. vechol hannesuot lechohanim, minchotehen nisrafot:
Mishnah Sotah 3:7-4:2:
Bat yisrael shennisset lechohen, minchatah nisrefet. vechohenet shennisset leyisrael, minchatah neechelet. ma ben kohen lechohenet, minchat kohenet neechelet, minchat kohen enah neechelet. kohenet mitchallelet, vechohen en mitchallel. kohenet mittammea lemetim, veen kohen mittamme lemetim. kohen ochel bekadshe kadashim, veen kohenet ochelet bekadshe kadashim: 
Ma ben ish leishsha. haish porea uforem, veen haishsha foraat uforemet. haish maddir et beno benazir, veen haishsha madderet et benah benazir. haish megalleach al nezirut aviv, veen haishsha megallachat al nezirut aviha. haish mocher et bitto, veen haishsha mocheret et bittah. haish mekaddesh et bitto, veen haishsha mekaddeshet et bittah. haish niskal arom, veen haishsha niskelet arumma. haish nitle, veen haishsha nitlet. haish nimkar bignevato, veen haishsha nimkeret bignevatah: 
Arusa veshomeret yavam, lo shotot velo notlot ketubba, shenneemar (Bamidbar 5), asher tiste ishsha tachat ishah, perat laarusa veshomeret yavam. almana lechohen gadol, gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot, mamzeret unetina leyisrael, uvat yisrael lemamzer ulenatin, lo shotot velo notlot ketubba: 
Veellu lo shotot velo notlot ketubba. haomeret temea ani, veshebbau lah edim shehi temea, vehaomeret eni shota. amar balah eni mashkah, veshebbalah ba aleha vadderech, notelet ketubbatah velo shota. metu vaalehen ad shello shatu, bet shammay omrim, notlot ketubba velo shotot. uvet hillel omrim, lo shotot velo notlot ketubba:
Mishnah Sotah 4:3-5:2:
Meubberet chavero umeneket chavero, lo shotot velo notlot ketubba, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, yachol hu lehaferishah ulehachazirah leachar zeman. aylonit uzekena vesheenah reuya leled, lo shotot velo notlot ketubba. rabbi eliezer omer, yachol hu lissa ishsha acheret velifrot velirbot hemenna. ushear kol hannashim, o shotot o lo notlot ketubba: 
Eshet kohen shota umutteret levalah. eshet saris shota. al yede chol arayot mekannin, chutz min hakkatan, umimmi sheeno ish: 
Veellu shebbet din mekannin lahen, mi shennitcharesh balah o nishtatta, o shehaya chavush bevet haasurin. lo lehashekotah amru, ella lefaslah mikketubbatah. rabbi yose omer, af lehashekotah, lichsheyyetze valah mibbet haasurin yashkenna: 
Keshem shehammayim bodkin otah, kach hammayim bodkin oto, shenneemar (Bamidbar 5) uvau, uvau. keshem sheasura labbaal, kach asura labboel, shenneemar (sham) nitmea, venitmaa, divre rabbi akiva. amar rabbi yehoshua, kach haya doresh zecharya ven hakkatztzav. rabbi omer, shene feamim haamurim bapparasha im nitmea nitmaa, echad labbaal veechad labboel: 
Bo bayyom darash rabbi akiva, (Vayikra 11) vechol keli cheres asher yippol mehem el tocho kol asher betocho yitma, eno omer tame ella yitma, letamme acherim, limmed al kikkar sheni shemmetamme et hashshelishi. amar rabbi yehoshua, mi yegalle afar meenecha, rabban yochanan ben zakkay, shehayita omer, atid dor acher letaher kikkar shelishi, sheen lo mikra min hattora shehu tame. vahalo akiva talmidcha mevi lo mikra min hattora shehu tame, shenneemar, kol asher betocho yitma:
Mishnah Sotah 5:3-6:1:
Bo vayyom darash rabbi akiva (Bamidbar la) umaddotem michutz lair et peat kedma alpayim baamma vegomer, umikra acher omer (sham) mikkir hair vachutza elef amma saviv. i efshar lomar elef amma, shekkevar neemar alpayim amma, vei efshar lomar alpayim amma, shekkevar neemar elef amma. ha chetzad, elef amma migrash, vealpayim amma techum shabbat. rabbi eliezer beno shel rabbi yose haggelili omer, elef amma migrash, vealpayim amma sadot ucheramim: 
Bo vayyom darash rabbi akiva (Shemot 15), az yashir moshe uvene yisrael et hashshira hazzot laAdonai vayyomru lemor, sheen talmud lomar lemor, uma talmud lomar lemor, melammed shehayu yisrael onin acharav shel moshe al kol davar vedavar, kekorin et hahallel, lechach neemar lemor. rabbi nechemya omer, kekorin et shema velo chekorin et hahallel: 
Bo vayyom darash rabbi yehoshua ben hureknos, lo avad iyyov et hakkadosh baruch hu ella meahava, shenneemar (iyyov 13) hen yikteleni lo ayachel. vaadayin haddavar shakul, lo ani metzappe o eni metzappe, talmud lomar (sham 27) ad egva lo asir tummati mimmenni, melammed shemmeahava asa. amar rabbi yehoshua, mi yegalle afar meenecha, rabban yochanan ben zakkay, shehayita doresh kol yamecha shello avad iyyov et hammakom ella miyyira, shenneemar (sham 1) ish tam veyashar yere elohim vesar mera, vahalo yehoshua talmid talmidcha limmed shemmeahava asa: 
Mi shekkinne leishto venistera, afillu shama meof happoreach, yotzi veyitten ketubba, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi yehoshua omer, ad sheyyisu veyittenu vah mozrot ballevana:
Mishnah Tamid 5:5-6:2:
Mi shezzacha vammachta, natal machtat hakkesef, veala lerosh hammizbeach, ufinna et haggechalim helach vehelach vechata. yarad veeran letoch shel zahav. nitpazzer mimmenna kekav gechalim, vehaya mechabbedan laamma. uveshabbat haya chofe alehen pesachter. ufesachter hayta cheli gadol machazeket letech, ushete sharsherot hayu vah, achat shehu moshech bah veyored, veachat shehu ochez bah milmalan bishvil shello titgalgel. ushelosha devarim hayta meshammeshet, kofin otah al gav gechalim veal hashsheretz beshabbat, umoridin bah et haddeshen meal gabbe hammizbeach: 
Higgiu ben haulam velammizbeach, natal echad et hammagrefa vezorkah ben haulam velammizbeach. en adam shomea kol chavero birushalayim mikkol hammagrefa. ushelosha devarim hayta meshammeshet, kohen sheshshomea et kolah, yodea sheechav hakkohanim nichnasim lehishtachavot, vehu ratz uva. uven levi shehu shomea et kolah, yodea sheechav haleviyyim nichnasim ledabber bashshir, vehu ratz uva. verosh hammaamad haya maamid et hattemeim beshaar hammizrach: 
Hechellu olim bemaalot haulam. mi shezzachu vedishshun mizbeach happenimi vehammenora hayu makdimin lifnehem. mi shezzacha vedishshun mizbeach happenimi nichnas, venatal et hatteni vehishtachava veyatza. mi shezzacha vedishshun hammenora, nichnas umatza shene nerot mizrachiyyim dolkin, medashshen et hammizrachi, umanniach et hammaaravi dolek, shemmimmennu haya madlik et hammenora ben haarbayim. metzao shekkava, medashsheno umadliko mimmizbach haola. natal et hakkuz mimmaala sheniyya, vehishtachava veyatza: 
Mi shezzacha vammachta, tzavar et haggechalim al gabbe hammizbeach veriddedan beshule hammachta, vehishtachava veyatza:
Mishnah Tamid 6:3-7:3: Mi shezzacha vakketoret, haya notel et habbazach mittoch hakkaf venotno leohavo o likrovo. nitpazzer mimmennu letocho, notno lo vechafnav. umelammedim oto, heve zahir shemma tatchil lefanecha, shello tikkave. hitchil meradded veyotze. lo haya hammaktir maktir ad shehamemunne omer lo, haketer. im haya chohen gadol, hamemunne omer, ishi chohen gadol, haketer. parshu haam, vehiktir vehishtachava veyatza:

Bizman shekkohen gadol nichnas lehishtachavot, shelosha ochazin bo, echad bimino, veechad bismolo, veechad baavanim tovot. vechevan sheshshama hamemunne kol raglav shel kohen gadol shehu yotze, higbiah lo et happarochet, nichnas vehishtachava veyatza, venichnesu echav hakkohanim vehishtachavu veyatzau:

Bau veamdu al maalot haulam. amdu harishonim lidrom achehem hakkohanim, vachamishsha chelim beyadam, hatteni veyad echad, vehakkuz beyad echad, vehammachta veyad echad, vehabbazach beyad echad, vechaf vechissuyah beyad echad. uverchu et haam beracha achat, ella shebbammedina omrim otah shalosh berachot, uvammikdash beracha echat. bammikdash hayu omrim et hashshem kichtavo, uvammedina bechinnuyo. bammedina hakkohanim nosim et kappehem, yedehem keneged kitfotehem, uvammikdash al gabbe rashehen, chutz mikkohen gadol sheeno magbiah et yadav lemala min hatztzitz. rabbi yehuda omer, af kohen gadol magbiah et yadav lemala min hatztzitz, shenneemar (Vayikra 9), vayyissa aharon et yadav el haam vayvarchem:

Bizman shekkohen gadol rotze lehaketir, haya ole vakkevesh vehassegan bimino. higgia lemachatzit hakkevesh, achaz hassegan bimino veheelahu. hoshit lo harishon harosh veharegel, vesamach alehen uzerakan. hoshit hashsheni larishon shete hayyadayim, notnan lechohen gadol, vesamach alehen uzerakan. nishmat hashsheni vehalach lo. vechach hayu moshitin lo shear kol haevarin, vehu somech alehen vezorkan. uvizman shehu rotze, hu somech vaacherim zorkin. ba lo lehakkif et hammizbeach. mehechan hu matchil, mikkeren deromit mizrachit, mizrachit tzefonit, tzefonit maaravit, maaravit deromit. natnu lo yayin lenassech, hassegan omed al hakkeren vehassudarim beyado, ushene chohanim omdim al shulchan hachalavim ushete chatzotzrot shel kesef beyadam, taku veheriu vetaku. bau veamdu etzel ben arza, echad mimino veechad missemolo. shacha lenassech, vehenif hassegan bassudarin, vehikkish ben arza batztzeltzal, vedibberu haleviyyim bashshir. higgiu leferek, taku, vehishtachavu haam. al kol perek, tekia. veal kol tekia, hishtachavaya. ze hu seder hattamid laavodat bet elohenu, yehi ratzon sheyibbane bimhera veyamenu, amen:
Mishnah Tamid 7:4: Hashshir shehayu haleviyyim omrim bammikdash, bayyom harishon hayu omrim (Tehillim 24:1), laAdonai haaretz umeloah tevel veyoshve vah. bashsheni hayu omrim (sham moach), gadol Adonai umehullal meod beir elohenu har kadsho. bashshelishi hayu omrim (sham 82), elohim nitztzav baadat el bekerev elohim yishpot. barvii hayu omrim (sham 94), el nekamot Adonai el nekamot hofia vegomer. bachamishi hayu omrim (sham 81), hareninu lelohim uzzenu, hariu lelohe yaakov. bashshishshi hayu omrim (sham 93), Adonai malach geut lavesh vegomer. beshabbat hayu omrim (sham 92), mizmor shir leyom hashshabbat, mizmor shir leatid lavo, leyom shekkullo shabbat menucha lechayye haolamim:
Mishnah Terumot 1:1-4:
Chamishsha lo yitromu, veim tarmu, en terumatan teruma. hacheresh, vehashshote, vehakkatan, vehattorem et sheeno shello. nachri shettaram et shel yisrael, afillu virshut, en terumato teruma: 
Cheresh hamedabber veeno shomea, lo yitrom. veim taram, terumato teruma. cheresh sheddibberu vo chachamim bechol makom, sheeno lo shomea velo medabber: 
Katan shello hevi shete searot, rabbi yehuda omer, terumato teruma. rabbi yose omer, im ad shello va leonat nedarim, en terumato teruma. umishebba leonat nedarim, terumato teruma: 
En tormin zetim al hashshemen, velo anavim al hayyayin. veim tarmu, bet shammay omrim, terumat atzman bahem. uvet hillel omrim, en terumatan teruma:
Mishnah Terumot 1:5-8:
En tormin min halleket, umin hashshichcha, umin happea, umin hahefker, velo mimmaaser rishon shennittela terumato, velo mimmaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu, velo min hachayyav al happatur, velo min happatur al hachayyav, velo min hattalush al hamechubbar, velo min hamechubbar al hattalush, velo min hechadash al hayyashan, velo min hayyashan al hechadash, velo mipperot haaretz al perot chutza laaretz, velo mipperot chutza laaretz al perot haaretz. veim tarmu, en terumatan teruma: 
Chamishsha lo yitromu, veim tarmu, terumatan teruma. haillem, vehashshikkor, vehearom, vehassuma, uvaal keri. lo yitromu, veim tarmu, terumatan teruma: 
En tormin, lo vemidda, velo vemishkal, velo veminyan. aval torem hu et hammadud veet hashshakul veet hammanuy. en tormin besal uvekuppa shehem shel midda, aval torem hu vahen chetzyan ushelishan. lo yitrom bisa chetzyah, shechetzyah midda: 
En tormin shemen al zetim hannichtashin, velo yayin al anavim hannidrachim. veim taram, terumato teruma, veyachazor veyitrom. harishona medammaat bifne atzmah, vechayyavin aleha chomesh, aval lo sheniyya:
Mishnah Terumot 1:9-2:2:
Vetormin shemen al zetim hannichbashim, veyayin al anavim laasotam tzimmukim. hare shettaram shemen al zetim laachila, vezetim al zetim laachila, veyayin al anavim laachila, vaanavim al anavim laachila, venimlach ledarchan, eno tzarich litrom: 
En tormin middavar shennigmera melachto al davar shello nigmera melachto, velo middavar shello nigmera melachto al davar shennigmera melachto, velo middavar shello nigmera melachto al davar shello nigmera melachto. veim tarmu, terumatan teruma: 
En tormin mittahor al hattame. veim tarmu, terumatan teruma. beemet amru, haiggul shel devela shennitma miktzato, torem min hattahor sheyyesh bo al hattame sheyyesh bo. vechen agudda shel yarak, vechen arema. hayu shene iggulim, shete aguddot, shete aremot, achat temea veachat tehora, lo yitrom mizze al ze. rabbi eliezer omer, tormin min hattahor al hattame: 
En tormin min hattame al hattahor. veim taram, shogeg, terumato teruma, umezid, lo asa chelum. vechen ben levi shehaya lo maaser tevel, haya mafrish alav veholech, shogeg, ma sheasa, asuy, mezid, lo asa chelum. rabbi yehuda omer, im haya yodea bo battechilla, af al pi shehu shogeg, lo asa chelum:
Mishnah Terumot 2:3-3:1:
Hammatbil kelim beshabbat, shogeg, yishtammesh bahem, mezid, lo yishtammesh bahem. hameasser vehamevashshel beshabbat, shogeg, yochal, mezid, lo yochal. hannotea beshabbat, shogeg, yekayyem, mezid, yaakor. uvashsheviit, ben shogeg ben mezid, yaakor: 
En tormin mimmin al sheeno mino. veim taram, en terumato teruma. kol min chittim, echad. kol min teenim ugerogarot udevela, echad. vetorem mizze al ze. kol makom sheyyesh kohen, torem min hayyafe. vechol makom sheen kohen, torem min hammitkayyem. rabbi yehuda omer, leolam hu torem min hayyafe: 
Tormin batzal katan shalem, velo chatzi vatzal gadol. rabbi yehuda omer, lo chi, ella chatzi vatzal gadol. vechen haya rabbi yehuda omer, tormin betzalim mibbene hammedina al hakkuferim, aval lo min hakkuferim al bene hammedina, mippene shehu maachal politikin: 
Vetormin zete shemen al zete chevesh, velo zete chevesh al zete shamen. veyayin sheeno mevushshal al hamevushshal, velo min hamevushshal al sheeno mevushshal. ze hakkelal, kol shehu chilayim bachavero, lo yitrom mizze al ze, afillu min hayyafe al hara. vechol sheeno chilayim bachavero, torem min hayyafe al hara, aval lo min hara al hayyafe. veim taram min hara al hayyafe, terumato teruma, chutz min hazzunin al hachittim, sheenan ochel. vehakkishshut vehammelaffon, min echad. rabbi yehuda omer, shene minin: 
Hattorem kishshut venimtzet mara, avattiach venimtza saruach, teruma, veyachazor veyitrom. hattorem chavit shel yayin venimtzet shel chometz, im yadua shehayta shel chometz ad shello teramah, ena teruma. im mishshetteramah hechemitza, hare zo teruma. im safek, teruma, veyachazor veyitrom. harishona, enah medammaat bifne atzmah, veen chayyavin aleha chomesh. vechen hashsheniyya:
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 3:13-14: Mattile ema al hatztzibbur shello leshem shamayim ze harode tzibbur bechazka vehem yereim umefachadim mimmennu vechavvanato lichvod atzmo vechol chafatzav shello lichvod shamayim kegon malche haakkum:

Kol echad veechad meesrim vearbaa anashim ellu shemmaninu af al pi shehen miyyisrael en lahem chelek laolam habba. veyesh averot kallot meellu veaf al pi chen amru chachamim sheharagil bahen en lahem chelek laolam habba (uchede) [ucheday] hen lehitrachek mehen ulehizzaher bahen. veellu hen. hamechanne shem lachavero. vehakkore lachavero bechinnuyo. vehammalbin pene chavero barabbim. vehammitkabbed biklon chavero. vehamevazze talmide chachamim. vehamevazze rabbotav. vehamevazze et hammoadot. vehamechallel et hakkadashim. bamme devarim amurim shekkol echad meellu en lo chelek laolam habba keshemmet belo teshuva aval im shav merisho umet vehu baal teshuva hare ze mibbene haolam habba sheen lecha davar sheomed bifne hatteshuva. afillu kafar baikkar kol yamav uvaacharona shav yesh lo chelek laolam habba shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 57 19)</small> "shalom shalom larachok velakkarov amar Adonai urefativ". kol harshaim vehammumarim vechayyotze bahen shechazru bitshuva ben begaluy ben bematmoniyyot mekabbelin otan shenneemar <small>(yirmeya 3 14)</small> "shuvu banim shovavim". af al pi sheadayin shovav hu shehare basseter shav velo begaluy mekabbelin oto bitshuva:
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 4:1: Arvaa veesrim devarim meakkevin et hatteshuva. arbaa mehen avon gadol vehaose echad mehen en hakkadosh baruch hu maspik beyado laasot teshuva lefi godel cheto. veellu hen. 1) hammachti et harabbim uvichlal avon ze hameakkev et harabbim millaasot mitzva. b) vehammatte et chavero midderech tova leraa kegon mesit umaddiach. 3) haroe beno yotze letarbut raa veeno memache beyado. hoil uveno birshuto illu micha bo haya poresh venimtza kemachtio. uvichlal avon ze kol sheefshar beyado limchot baacherim ben yachid ben rabbim velo micha ella yannichem bechishlonam. 4) vehaomer echta veashuv uvichlal ze haomer echta veyom hakkippurim mechapper:
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 4:2: Umehen chamishsha devarim hannoalim darche hatteshuva bifne osehen. veellu hen. 1) happoresh min hatztzibbur, lefi shebbizman sheyyaasu teshuva lo yihye immahen veeno zoche immahen bizchut sheosin. b) vehacholek al divre chachamim, lefi shemmachlakto goremet lo lifrosh mehen veeno yodea darche hatteshuva. 3) vehammalig al hammitzvot, shekkevan shennitbazzu beenav eno rodef acharehen velo osan veim lo yaase bamme yizke. 4) vehamevazze rabbotav, sheddavar ze gorem lo ledochofo uletardo kegechazi uvizman shennitrad lo yimtza melammed umore lo derech haemet. 5) vehassone et hattochachot shehare lo hinniach lo derech teshuva. shehattochacha goremet litshuva shebbizman shemmodiin lo laadam chataav umachlimin oto chozer bitshuva kemo shekkatuv battora <small>(Devarim 9 7)</small> "zechor (v) al tishkach". <small>(Devarim 9 7)</small> "mamrim heyitem". <small>(Devarim 29 3)</small> "velo natan Adonai lachem lev". <small>(Devarim 32 6)</small> "am naval velo chacham". vechen yeshayahu hochiach et yisrael veamar <small>(yeshaya 1 4)</small> "hoy goy chote". <small>(yeshaya 1 3)</small> "yada shor konehu". <small>(yeshaya moach 4)</small> "middati ki kashe atta". vechen tzivvahu hael lehochiach lachattaim shenneemar <small>(yeshaya noach 1)</small> "kera vegaron al tachsoch". vechen kol hanneviim hochichu leyisrael ad shechazru bitshuva. lefichach tzarich lehaamid bechol kahal vekahal miyyisrael chacham gadol vezaken vire shamayim minneurav veahuv lahem sheyyehe mochiach larabbim umachaziran bitshuva, veze shessone et hattochachot eno ba lammochiach velo shomea devarav lefichach yaamod bechattotav shehem beenav tovim:
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 4:3: Umehem chamishsha devarim haose otan i efshar lo sheyyashuv bitshuva gemura lefi shehem avonot shebben adam lachavero veeno yodea chavero shechata lo kede sheyyachazir lo o yishal mimmennu limchol lo. veellu hen. 1) hamekallel et harabbim velo killel adam yadua kede sheyyishal mimmennu kappara. b) vehacholek im gannav, shellefi sheeno yodea geneva zo shel mi hi ella haggannav gonev larabbim umevi lo vehu lokeach. veod shehu machazik yad haggannav umachtio. 3) vehammotze aveda veeno machriz aleha ad sheyyachazirah livaleha, leachar zeman kesheyyaase teshuva eno yodea lemi yachazir. 4) vehaochel shor aniyyim vitomim vealmanot. ellu bene adam umlalin hem veenan yeduim umefursamim vegolim meir leir veen lahem makkir kede sheyyeda shor ze shel mi hu veyachazirennu lo. 5) vehamekabbel shochad lehattot din eno yodea ad hechan higgia hattaya zo vechamma hi kochah kede sheyyachazir, shehaddavar yesh lo raglayim. veod shehu machazik yad ze umachtio:
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 4:4: Umehen chamishsha devarim haose otan en chezkato lashuv mehen. lefi shehem devarim kallim beene rov haadam venimtza chote vehu yedamme sheen ze chet. veellu hen. 1) haochel misseudda sheenah maspeket livaleha shezze avak gezel hu. vehu medamme shello chata veyomar kelum achalti ella birshuto. b) hammishtammesh baavoto shel ani shehaavot shel ani eno ella kegon kordom umacharesha veyomar belibbo enan chaserim vahare lo gazalti oto. 3) hammistakkel baarayot maale al dato sheen bechach kelum shehu omer vechi baalti o karavti etzlah. vehu eno yodea sheriyyat haenayim avon gadol shehi goremet legufan shel arayot shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 39)</small> "velo taturu achare levavchem veachare enechem". 4) hammitkabbed biklon chavero omer belibbo sheeno chet lefi sheen chavero omed sham velo higgia lo boshet velo biyyesho ella arach maasav hattovim vechachmato lemul maase chavero o chachmato kede sheyyerae mikkelalo shehu mechubbad vachavero bazuy. 5) vehachoshed kesherim omer belibbo sheeno chet lefi shehu omer me asiti lo vechi yesh sham ella chashad shemma asa o lo asa vehu eno yodea shezze avon shemmesim adam kasher bedato kevaal avera:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 5:13-15:
En notnin keli tachat hanner lekabbel bo shemen beshabbat shehare mevattel hakkeli mehechano. veim netano mibbeod yom muttar. venotnin keli tachat hanner beshabbat lekabbel bo nitzotzot mippene sheen bahen mammash vahare lo bitlo milletaltelo. veasur litten letocho mayim vaafillu meerev shabbat mippene shehu mekarev kibbuy hannitzotzot: 
En polin leor hanner velo korin leor hanner vaafillu gavoah shete komot vaafillu asara battim ze al gav ze vehanner baelyona lo yikra velo yafle leorah battachtona shemma yishkach veyatte. veim hayu shenayim korin beinyan echad muttarin likrot lifne hanner shekkol echad mehen mazkir chavero im shachach. aval lo bishne inyanim shekkol echad mehen tarud beinyano: 
Hattinokot korin lifne rabban leor hanner mippene sheharav meshammeran. aval hu lo yikra mippene sheen ematan alav. veyesh lo lirot bassefer leor hanner ad sheyyire rosh happarasha shehu tzarich lehakerotan. veachar kach noten hassefer beyadan vehem korin lefanav:
Niddah 16b:5-8: Tanya, amar rabbi yehoshua: roe ani et divre bet shammay. amru lo talmidav: rabbi, kamma heerachta alenu! amar lahem: mutav sheaarich alechem baolam hazze, kede sheyyaarichu yemechem laolam habba.
Amar rabbi zera: middivre kullam nilmad, baal nefesh — lo yivol veyishne.
Rava amar: boel veshona, ki tanya hahi — litharot.

Tanya name hachi: bamme devarim amurim — litharot, aval levalah — mutteret. uvamme devarim amurim — shehinnichah bechezkat tohora, aval hinnichah bechezkat temea — leolam hi bechezkatah, ad shettomar lo "tehora ani".

Shabbat 117b:11-118b:2: Ketzad? nafla deleka kulei. tanu rabbanan: kamma seudot chayyayv adam leechol bashshabbat — shalosh. rabbi chidka omer: arba. amar rabbi yochanan, ushenehem mikra echad darshu: "vayyomer moshe ichluhu hayyom ki shabbat hayyom laAdonai hayyom lo timtzauhu bassade". rabbi chidka savar: hane telata "hayyom" levar meureta, verabbanan savri: bahade deureta. tenan: nafla deleka belele shabbat

Matztzilin mezon shalosh seudot, may lav — dela achal! la, daachal. shacharit matztzilin mezon shete seudot, may lav — dela achal? la, daachal. bemincha matztzilin mezon seuda achat, may lav — dela achal? la, daachal!
Veha middekatane sefa: rabbi yose omer leolam matztzilin mezon shalosh seudot — mikkelal detanna kamma shalosh sevira leh! ella mechavvavrta, matnitin dela kerabbi chidka.

Veha ditnan: mi sheyyesh lo mezon shete seudot — lo yittol min hattamchuy, mezon arba esre — lo yittol min hakkuppa. manni? la rabbanan, vela rabbi chidka. i rabbanan — chamsere havyayn. i rabbi chidka — shet sere havyayn! leolam rabbanan, deamrinan leh: may devaet lemechal beappoke shabbeta, ichleh beshabbeta.

Lema rabbanan hi, vela rabbi chidka. afillu tema rabbi chidka, deamrinan leh: may devaet lemechal bemaale shabbeta, ichleh leureta. vechulle yoma demaale shabbeta betaanita motvinan leh?! ella ha manni — rabbi akiva hi, deamar: ase shabbattecha chol veal titztarech labberiyyot.

Veha ditnan: en pochatin leani haover mimmakom lemakom mikkikkar befunedyon mearba sein besela. lan — notnin lo parnasat lina, veim shavat — notnin lo mezon shalosh seudot. lema rabbanan hi, vela rabbi chidka? leolam rabbi chidka — kegon deikka seuda bahadeh, deamrinan leh: ha deikka bahadach — ichleh. vechi azel berekan azel?! dimlavvivynan leh seuda bahadeh. may parnasat lina? amar rav pappa: pureya uve sadya.

Tanu rabbanan: kearot sheachal bahen arvit — maddichan leechol bahen shacharit. shacharit — maddichan leechol bahen batztzohorayim. batztzohorayim — maddichan leechol bahen bammincha. min hammincha veelach — shuv eno maddiach. aval kosot vekitoniyyot utzelochiyyot — maddiach veholech kol hayyom kullo, lefi sheen keva lishtiyya.

Amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara: kol hamekayyem shalosh seudot beshabbat nitztzol mishshalosh pureaniyyot: mechevlo shel mashiach, umiddinah shel gehinnam, umimmilchemet gog umagog. mechevlo shel mashiach — ketiv hacha "yom", uchetiv hatam: "hinne anochi sholeach lachem et eliyya hannavi lifne bo yom vegomer". middinah shel gehinnam — ketiv hacha "yom", uchetiv hatam: "yom evra hayyom hahu". mimmilchemet gog umagog — ketiv hacha "yom", uchetiv hatam: "beyom bo gog".
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose: kol hameanneg et hashshabbat notnin lo nachala beli metzarim, shenneemar: "az titannag al Adonai vehirkavticha al bomote aretz vehaachalticha

Nachalat yaakov avicha vegomer". lo keavraham, shekkatuv bo "kum hithallech baaretz leorkah vegomer". velo keyitzchak, shekkatuv bo "ki lecha ulezaracha etten et kol haaratzot hael". ella keyaakov, shekkatuv bo "ufaratzta yamma vakedma vetzafona vanegba".

Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: nitztzol mishshibud galiyyot. ketiv hacha: "vehirkavtich al bomote aretz", uchetiv hatam: "veatta al bamotemo tidroch". amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol hameanneg et hashshabbat notnin lo mishalot libbo, shenneemar: "vehitannag al Adonai veyitten lecha mishalot libbecha". oneg ze eni yodea mahu. keshehu omer "vekarata lashshabbat oneg" — heve omer ze oneg shabbat. bamme meannego? rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh derav amar: betavshil shel teradin vedagim gedolim verashe shumin. rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: afillu davar muat, velichvod shabbat asao — hare ze oneg. may hi? amar rav pappa: kasa deharsana.
Yevamot 109a:18-109b:8: Gufa. tane bar kappara: leolam yidbak adam bishlosha devarim: bachalitza — keabba shaul, detanya, abba shaul omer: hakkones et yevimto leshem noy, leshem ishut, leshem davar acher — keillu pogea beerva, vekarov beenay lihyot havvalad mamzer.

Veamar rabbi avahu: atya "redifa" "redifa". ketiv hacha: "bakkesh shalom verodfehu", uchetiv hatam: "rodef tzedaka vachased yimtza chayyim tzedaka vechavod". bahafarat nedarim, kerabbi natan. detanya, rabbi natan omer: hannoder — keillu bana bama. vehamekayyeymo — keillu hikriv aleha korban.
Veyitrachek mishshelosha devarim: min hammeunin — dilma gadla umicharta bah. min happikdonot — bevar mata, devayyteh ki vayyteh dame. min haeravon — baarave shaltziyyon.

Deamar rabbi yitzchak: may dichtiv: "ra yeroa ki arav zar" — raa achar raa tavo limkabbele gerim, velaarave shaltziyyon, uletokea atzmo lidvar halacha. mekabbele gerim — kerabbi chelbo. deamar rabbi chelbo: kashim gerim leyisrael kesappachat baor.
Arave shaltziyyon — deavdi shelof dotz. tokea atzmo lidvar halacha — detanya, rabbi yose omer: kol haomer en lo tora — en lo tora. peshita! ella: kol haomer en lo ella tora — en lo ella tora.
Ha name peshita! ella daafillu tora en lo. may tama? amar rav pappa, amar kera: "velimmadtem vaasitem" — kol sheyyeshno baasiyya yeshno bilmida, kol sheeno baasiyya eno bilmida.
Veibbaet ema, leolam kidamritu meikkara: kol haomer en lo ella tora — en lo ella tora, la tzericha deka magmar leacharine veazli veavdi. mahu detema: it leh agra ledideh, ka mashma lan.
Veibbaet ema, tokea atzmo lidvar halacha: bedayyayna deate dina lekammeh, vegamar halacha umedamme milleta lemilleta, veit leh rabba vela azel meshael.

Deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: leolam yire dayyayn atzmo keillu cherev munnachat lo ben yerechotav, vegehinnam petucha lo mittachtav, shenneemar: "hinne mittato shellishlomo shishshim gibborim saviv lah miggibbore yisrael vegomer mippachad ballelot", mippachad shel gehinnam sheddome lelayla.
Zevachim 119a:3-119b:6: Bau lenov vegivon [vechulei]. mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "ki lo batem ad atta el hammenucha veel hannachala";
"El hammenucha" – zo shilo, "nachala" – zo yerushalayim. lamma chillekan? kede litten hetter ben ze laze.
Amar leh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: maaser sheni name litne! amar leh: maaser – "sham"–"sham" mearon ka yalfi; kevan dearon la hava, maaser name la havay.
I hachi, pesach vekadashim name – desham"–"sham" mearon yalfi; dechevan dearon la hava, inhu name la havo!

Amar leh: daamar lach ha, manni – rabbi shimon hi, deamar: af tzibbur lo hikrivu ella pesach vechovot hakkavua lahen zeman, aval chovot sheen kavua lahem zeman – hacha vehacha la keruv. masar behema – chovot sheen kavua lahen zeman hu, veittakkash masar dagan lemasar behema.

Mikkelal dilrabbi yehuda keruv? in; dehaamar rav adda bar matna: maaser sheni umasar behema neechalin benov vegivon ledivre rabbi yehuda. veha bae bira! velav tane rav yosef: shalosh birot hen – shilo, venov vegivon, uvet olamim? hu tane la vehu amar la: laachilat maaser sheni, veallibba derabbi yehuda.
Bau lirushalayim [vechulei]. tanu rabbanan: "ki lo batem ad atta el hammenucha veel hannachala" – "menucha" zo shilo, "nachala" zo yerushalayim.
Veomer: "hayta li nachalati kearye vayyaar", veomer: "haayit tzavua nachalati li haayit saviv aleha". divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi shimon omer: "menucha" zo yerushalayim, "nachala" zo shilo. veomer: "zot menuchati ade ad po eshev ki ivvitiha", veomer: "ki vachar Adonai betziyyon ivvah lemoshav lo".

Bishlama leman deamar "menucha" zo shilo – hayeynu dichtiv: "el hammenucha veel hannachala". ella leman deamar "menucha" zo yerushalayim, "nachala" zo shilo – "el hannachala veel hammenucha" mibbee leh! hachi kaamar: la mibbaya "menucha" dela metetu, ella afillu lenachala" name la metetu.
Tana deve rabbi yishmael: zo vezo shilo. rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: zo vezo yerushalayim. bishlama leman deamar "menucha" zo
Shilo "nachala" zo yerushalayim, i name ippecha – hayeynu dichtiv: "el hammenucha veel hannachala". ella leman deamar zo vazo shilo, o zo vazo yerushalayim – "menucha nachala" mibbee leh! kashya.
Bishlama leman deamar zo vazo shilo; "menucha" – denachu mikkibbush, "nachala (zo)" – diflagu hatam nachalot, dichtiv: "vaychallek lahem yehoshua vayyappel lahem goral beshilo al pi Adonai".
Ella leman deamar zo vazo yerushalayim; bishlama "nachala" – nachalat olamim. ella "menucha" – may menucha? menuchat aron, dichtiv: "vayhi kenoach haaron".
Bishlama leman deamar zo vazo yerushalayim, aval shilo havo (sharya) [sharyan] bamot – hayeynu dichtiv: "vayyikkach manoach et gedi haizzim veet hammincha vayyaal al hatztzur laAdonai".
Ella leman deamar zo vazo shilo, uvamot havo asiran – may "vayyikkach manoach"? horaat shaa hayta.
Tana deve rabbi yishmael kerabbi shimon ben yochay, deamar: zo vazo yerushalayim. vesimanaych: (mashche) [mashchinhu] gavra legavre.
Zohar, Bo 1: (Shemot 10:1) vayyomer Adonai el moshe bo el paro ki ani hichbadti et libbo vegomer. ribbi yehuda patach vamar, (tehillim 89) ashre haam yode terua Adonai beor panycha yehallechun. kamma itzterichu bene nasha, lemehach bearche dekudesha berich hu, ulemitar pikkude orayyta, begin deyizkun bah lealma deate, uleshezava lon mikkol kitrugin dilella vetatta. begin, deha kema deishtechachu mekatregin bealma letatta, hachi name ishtechachu mekatregin leella dekayyme alayyhu divne nasha.

Innun deavdin pikkude orayyta, veazle beorach meshar, bidchala demarehon, kamma innun sannegorin dekayymin alayyhu leella, kema deat amar (iyyov 33:23) im yesh alav malach melitz echad minni alef vegomer. uchetiv vaychunnennu vayyomer pedaehu meredet shachat matzati chofer. begin kach, zakkaa ihu man denatir pikkude orayyta.

Amar leh ribbi chiyyay, i hachi, amay itzterich hacha malach delehevi sannegora aleh devar nash veha ketiv (Mishlei 3:26) ki Adonai yihye bechislecha vshamar raglecha millached, uchetiv (Tehillim 121:7) Adonai yishmarcha mikkol ra. deha chame kudesha berich hu, kol ma devar nash avid bealma, hen tav hen bish. vechen hu omer, (Yirmeyahu 23:24) im yissater ish bammistarim vaani lo erennu neum Adonai.

Amar leh ribbi yehuda, kolla hachi hu vadday. aval ha ketiv, (iyyov 2:Adonai) vega el atzmo veel besaro. uchetiv, (iyyov 2:Adonai) vattesiteni vo levalleo chinnam. leachazaa deha reshu itmesar lesitra achara lekatrega, (ureshu itmesar) al millin dealma, (leman dela itzterich) uleitmassera bidoy. vechol illen archin temirin kame kudesha berich hu, velet ant keday lemehach avatrayyhu, begin deinnun nimmusin dekudesha berich hu, uvene nasha lav innun rashshain ledakdeka avatrayyhu, bar innun zakkae keshot deyadin raze orayyta, veazlin bearcha dechachmeta leminda innun millin setimin deorayyta.
Zohar, Vaera 16: Vayyomer Adonai el moshe emor el aharon kach mattecha unete yadcha al meme mitzrayim al naharotam al yeorehem veal agmehem veal kol mikve memehem vayyihyu dam vegomer. amar ribbi yehuda, hay kera it leistakkela beh, vehech yachil lemehach lechol hane atre. (velo od ella) vetu, deha ketiv veyyimmale shivat yamim achare hakkot Adonai et hayeor. et hayeor ketiv, veat amart al meme mitzrayim al naharotam al yeorehem veal agmehem.

Ella, meme mitzrayim nilus hava. umittamman itmalyayn kol innun shear agammin viorin umabbuin vechol memin dilhon. veal da, aharon lo nata lemachaa ella lenilus bilchodoy. veta chaze dehachi hu, dichtiv velo yachlu mitzrayim lishtot mayim min hayeor.

Amar ribbi abba, ta chaze, mayin tattain mitparshan lechamma sitrin, (nusach acher umayin illae ad kan vegomer) (illain deha) umayin illain mitkanshe beve kenishu mayya, dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:9) vayyomer elohim yikkavu hammayim mittachat hashshamayim el makom echad. uchetiv ulemikkeve hammayim kara yammim. hay kera ukemuha. veta chaze, hahu rekia deit beh shimsha vesihara kochavayay umazzale, da ihu be kenishut mayya rabba, dehu natil kol mayin, veashke leara, dehi alma tattaa, kevan, denatal mayya badar lon, ufalig lon lechol ivar, umittamman itshakyayn kolla.

Uvezimna dedina sharya, alma tattaa la yanka min hahu rekia, veyanka missetar semala, ucheden ikre (Yeshayahu 34:6) cherev laAdonai mala dam. vavy leinun deyankin keden minah, veitshakyayn minah, divhahu zimna yamma yanka mitteren sitrin, hava itpelag litren chulakin, chivvavr vesumak. ucheden shade liora chulaka demitzrayim, vealke leella vealke letatta. veal da shatan yisrael mayya. umitzrae dama.

I tema begin giula hava vela yattir. ta chaze, shatan dama veal lemeayyhu, veistallak uvaka, ad dahavo mezabbenin lon yisrael mayya bemamona, ucheden shatan mayya begini kach sheruta lealkaa lon hava dama.

Ribbi yitzchak patach hay kera, (Tehillim 145:1) aromimcha elohay hammelech vaavarcha shimcha leolam vaed. ta chaze, david lokovel darga deleh kaamar, dichtiv elohay didi. begin devaa lesalleka shevacheh, uleaala leh linhora illaa, leitarva da beda, lemeheve kolla chad. begine kach, aromimcha elohay hammelech vegomer.

Detanenan, kol yomoy dedavid, ishtaddal leatkena kuresya, uleanhara anpaha, begin deyagin aleh veitnehir tadir nehora tattaa binhora illaa, lemehve kolla chad. vechad ata shelomo, ashkach alma shelim, vesihara deitmalya, vela itzterich leatrecha alla leanhara. (ad kan)

Ta chaze, beshaata devae kudesha berich hu lemesav nukemin meammin ovde avoda zara, ittear semala, veitmalya sihara mehahu sitra dama. ucheden, navin mabbuin unechalin diltatta, kol innun delistar semala dama. veal da, dina dilhon dama.

Ta chaze, kad hay dama ittear (nusach acher kad dina ittear al alma begin hahu dema dekatulin kudesha berich hu ittear) al amma, hahu dama dekatulin ihu deyittear alayyhu amma achara vekatil lon. aval (hasheta) bemitzrayim, la baa kudesha berich hu leayytaa alayyhu amma achara leatara alayyhu dama begin deyisrael havo benayyhu, vela yitztaarun begin dedayyrin beara dilhon, aval kudesha berich hu macha lon bedama, benaharin dilhon, dela havo yachlin lemishte.

Uvegin deshuletanuta dilhon, shalta behahu nahara, pakid kudesha berich hu leshuletanuta dilhon bekadmita, begin deyalke dachala dilhon bekadmita, begin denilus chad dachala dilhon hava, vechen shear dachalin dilhon navin dama. hada hu dichtiv vehaya dam bechol eretz mitzrayim uvaetzim uvaavanim.

Rabbi chiyyay kam lelya chad lemile beorayyta, vahava immeh Rabbi yose zuta, dehava ravya. patach Rabbi chiyyay veamar, (Kohelet 9:7) lech echol besimcha lachmecha ushete velev tov yiyinecha ki chevar ratza haelohim et maasecha. may ka chama shelomo deamar hay kera.

Ella shelomo kol milloy bechachma havo, vehay deamar lech echol besimcha lachmecha, beshaata devar nash azil beorchoy dekudesha berich hu, kudesha berich hu mekarev leh legabbeh, veyahiv leh shalva venayycha, keden nahama vechamra deachil veshate, bechedva delibba, begin dekudesha berich hu itree beovadoy.

Amar leh hahu ravya, i hachi, ha amart dechol milloy deshlomo bechachmeta havo, an hu chachmeta hacha. amar leh beri tevashshel bishshulach, vetecheme hay kera. amar leh ad la bashilna yadana. amar leh mena lan.

Amar leh kala chad shemana meabba, dehava amar behay kera, deshlomo ka azhar leh lebar nash, leattera lah lochneset yisrael besimcha, deihu sitra dimina, veihu nahama, deyitattar bechedva. ulevatar, yitattar bechamra, deihu semala, begin detishtechach bimhemanuta decholla, chedvavta shelemata, bimina usemala, vechad tehve ben tarvavyyhu keden kol birkan sharan bealma. vechol da, kad itree kudesha berich hu beovadehon divne nasha, hada hu dichtiv ki chevar ratza haelohim et maasecha. ata Rabbi chiyyay uneshakeh, amar, chayyecha beri hay milla shavakna beginach, vehasheta yadana, dekudesha berich hu bae leattera lach beorayyta.

Tu patach Rabbi chiyyay veamar, emor el aharon kach mattecha unete yadcha al meme mitzrayim. may tama aharon velo moshe. ella, amar kudesha berich hu, aharon mayin kayymin beducheteh, usemala bae lenagda mayin mittamman, aharon deate mehahu sitra yittear leh, vechad semala nakit lon, innun yithadderun dama.

Ta chaze tattaa dechol dargin macha bekadmita. amar rabbi shimon mittattaa shara kudesha berich hu. veyada dileh, macha bechol etzbea veetzbea. vechad mata ledarga illaa dechol dargin, aved ihu dileh, veavar beara demitzrayim, vekatal kolla. uvegine kach katal kol bucherin beara demitzrayim, begin deihu darga illaa uvuchera decholla.

Veta chaze, paro hava shuletaneh bemayya, (nusach acher bekadmita vametateah shara kudesha berich hu vechad mata ledarga ilaa dilhon deihu buchera dechol dargin dilhon katal kol buchera beara demitzrayim begin hahu darga ilaa uvuchera dechola veta chaze paro hava buchera veshuletaneh bemayya) dichtiv, (yechezkel 29:3) hattannim haggadol harovetz betoch yeorav, begin kach ithappach nahareh bedama bekadmita. levatar tzefardeim dimshammete lon bekalin tesirin mekarkerin bego meayyhu, (nusach acher mekarkerin bego yeora) venafke miggo yeora, vesalke beyabbeshta veramin kalin bechol sitrin, ad deinnun naflin kemetin bego beta.

Veraza demilla, kol innun eser atin deavad kudesha berich hu, kullehu havo miggo yada takkifa, vehahu yada ittekaf al innun dargin kullehu shultanuta dilhon, begin levalbela datayyhu, vela havo yade lemebad midi. ta chaze, kol innun dargin dilhon, kevan denafke lemebad midi, deitchaze lecholla la yachlin (levatar) lemebad midi. (emat kad) (nusach acher begin hahu) yada takkifa (sefer acher sharya) desharya alayyhu.
Zohar, Vaera 20: Amar hahu yudai, ha deamrittu dekudesha berich hu katal bemitzrayim, kol innun ane, kol innun beire. telat motane havo bivire. chad, dever. vechad, innun dekatil barad. vechad, innun buchere divire.

Uma hava motana dilhon. ella, ha, ketiv bekadmita, (Shemot 9:3) hinne yad Adonai hoya bemiknecha asher bassade, amay bechullehu la ketiv yad Adonai. ella, hacha (nusach acher lo ketiv yad elohim ella yad Adonai) (sefer acher el yad Adonai) ihu yada bachamishsha etzbean. deha bekadmita ketiv, etzba elohim hi. vehacha kullehu chamesh etzbean, vechol etzbea veetzbea, katal zina chada. vachamishsha zinin havo, dichtiv, bassusim, bachamorim, baggemallim, babbakar, uvatztzon. ha chamishsha zinin, lachamishsha etzbean, deikrun yad. begine kach, hinne yad Adonai hoya vegomer dever kaved meod. dahavo metim miggarmayyhu, veishtechachu metim.

Batar dela ahadru mitzrae, innun atvavn mammash, ahadru vekatlu kol innun deishtaaru. vedever, ahdar barad. ma ben hay lehay. ella da benichuta, veda bitkifu derugeza. uteren illen, havo baatar chad, bechamesh etzbean.
Zohar, Vaera 9: (Shemot 6:13) vaydabber Adonai el moshe veel aharon vaytzavvem el beni yisrael veel paro melech mitzrayim. Rabbi yose amar, el bene yisrael ledabbera lon benachat kadka chaze, veel paro: leanhaga beh yekar, veukemuha.

Amar ribbi yesa, amay samich hacha (Shemot 6:14) elle rashe vet avotam. ella, amar leh kudesha berich hu, dabberu lon livne yisrael benachat, deaf al gav deinnun yatve befulechana kashya, malchin beni malchin innun. uvegin kach, ketiv, elle rashe vet avotam illen deat chame, reshe bet avahan innun.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, dechullehu la shakkeru nimusehon, vela itarvu beamma achara illen innun dekayymu beduchetayyhu kaddisha, vela shakru leitarva behu bemitzrae. amar ribbi acha, begin leayytaa lemoshe uleaharon, deinnun itchazun leappaka lehu leyisrael, ulemallela lefaro, uleraddaa leh bechutera, begin divchol reshehon deyisrael, la ishtechach kevavtayyhu.

Ta chaze, (Shemot 6:25) veelazar ben aharon lakach lo mibbenot putiel lo leishsha vatteled lo et pinchas elle rashe avot haleviyyim. vechi elle rashe, veha hu bilchodoy hava. ella, begin definchas kiyyem kamma alfin verivvavn miyyisrael, vehu kiyyem lerashe avahan, (levae) ketiv beh elle.

Tu, vatteled lo et pinchas elle rashe, ovda dereshe delevae ishtechach beh, uma deinnun (Vayikra 56 amud bet) garu veittukadu, hu ashlim, veravavch kehunata dilhon, vesharya beh tastuka detarvavyyhu. ovda dereshe delevae ishtechach beh, uman ninhu. nadav vaavihu. innun perishu at kayyeyma meatreh, vehu ata vechavar lon. begin kach, ityeyhiv leh yaruta, verucha detarvavyyhu. veadkar hacha al ma delehve levatar.

Vei tema, amay adkar hacha pinchas. ella chama kudesha berich hu leaharon, beshaata deamar vaezkor et beriti, dizminin teren benohi deaharon leafgama leh lehay berit, vehasheta deka meshadder leh lemitzrayim, baa leabera leh leaharon, dela lemehach bishlichuta da. kevan dechama kudesha berich hu, dekaim pinchas vekiyyem leh lehay berit beatreh, veatkin akima dilhon, miyyad hu aharon umoshe. amar kudesha berich hu, hasheta hu aharon, ihu aharon dekadmeta.

(Shemot 6:26) hu aharon umoshe asher amar Adonai lahem hotziu et bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim vegomer. hu aharon umoshe. hem aharon umoshe mibbae leh. ella, leachlala da beda, rucha bemayya. hu moshe veaharon: leachlala mayya berucha, veal da ketiv hu, velo hem.
Zohar, Yitro 27: (Shemot 20:8) zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho. rabbi yitzchak amar, ketiv (Bereshit 2:3) vayvarech elohim et yom hashshevii, uchetiv bamman (Shemot 16:26) sheshet yamim tilketuhu uveyom hashshevii shabbat lo yihye bo. kevan dela mishtechach beh mezone, ma bircheta ishtechach beh.

Ella hachi tana, kol birkan dilella vetatta, beyoma sheviaa talyayn. vetana, amay la ishtechach manna beyoma sheviaa, mishshum dehahu yoma, mitbarchan minneh kol shita yomin illain, vechol chad vechad yahiv mezoneh letatta, kol chad beyomoy, mehahi beracha demitbarchan beyoma sheviaa.

Uvegine kach, man deihu bedarga dimhemanuta, bae lesaddera patora, uleatkena seudata belelya deshabbeta, begin deyitbarech patoreh, kol innun shita yomin, deha behahu zimna, izdaman beracha, leitbarcha kol shita yomin deshabbeta, uvirchata la ishtechach befatora rekanayya. veal kach, bae lesaddera patoreh belelya deshabbeta, benahame uvimzone.
Rabbi yitzchak amar, afilu beyoma deshabbeta name. rabbi yehuda amar, bae leitanga behay yoma, ulemechal telat seudate beshabbeta, begin deyishtechach sava veinnuga behay yoma bealma.

Rabbi abba amar, leizdammena bircheta beinnun yomin dilella, demitbarchan mehay yoma. vehay yoma, malya resheh dizer anpin, mittalla denachit meattika kaddisha setima decholla, veatil lechakla detappuchin kaddishin, telat zimne, mikkad ayiyil shabbeta, deyitbarchun kullehu kachada.

Veal da bae bar nash, leitanga telat zimnin illen, deha beha talya mehemanuta dilella, beattika kaddisha, uvizer appin, uvechakla detappuchin. uvae bar nash leitanga behu, ulemechode behu. uman degara seudata minayyhu, achze pegimuta leela veonsheh dehahu bar nash saggi.

Begine kach, bae lesaddera patoreh, telat zimne, mikkad ayiyil shabbeta, vela yishtekach patoreh rekanayya, vetishre bircheta aleh, kol shear yome deshabbeta. uvehay milla, achze, vetale mehemanuta leella.

Rabbi shimon amar, hay man deashlim telat seudate beshabbata, kala nafik umachreza aleh, (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai, da seudata chada, lokovel (Vayikra 288 amud bet) attika kaddisha dechol kaddishin. vehirkavticha al bomote aretz, da seudata tinyayna, lokovel chakla detappuchin kaddishin. vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha, da hu shelimu deishtelim bizer appin.

Ulokavlayyhu bae leashlema seudateh, uvae leitanga bechullehu seudate, ulemechode bechol chad vechad minnayyhu, mishshum deihu mehemanuta shelemata. uvegin kach, shabbeta ityakkar, mikkol shear zimnin vechaggin, mishshum decholla beh ishtechach, vela ishtechach hachi bechullehu zimne vechagge. amar rabbi chiyyay, begin kach, mishshum deishtechach kolla beh, idkar telat zimnin. dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:2) vaychal elohim bayyom hashshevii. vayyishbot bayyom hashshevii. vayvarech elohim et yom hashshevii.

Rabbi abba, (nusach acher rav hamenuna sava) kad hava yativ bisudata deshabbeta, have chadde, bechol chad vechad, vahava amar, da hi seudata kaddisha, deattika kaddisha setima decholla. bisudata achara hava amar, da hi seudata dekudesha berich hu. vechen bechullehu seudate, vahava chadde bechol chad vechad. kad hava ashlim seudate, amar ashlimu seudate dimhemanuta.

Rabbi shimon, kad hava ate lisudata, hava amar hachi, atkinu seudata dimhemnuta illaa, atkinu seudata demalka, vahava yativ vechadde. kad ashlim seudata telitaa, havo machrize aleh, az titannag al Adonai vehirkavticha al bomote aretz vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha.

Amar rabbi elazar leavuy, illen seudate hech mittaknin. amar leh, lelya deshabbeta, ketiv, vehirkavticha al bomote aretz. beh belelya, mitbarcha matronita, vechullehu chakal tappuchin, umitbarcha patoreh devar nash, venishmeta ittosfat, vehahu lelya, chedva dematronita have. uvae bar nash lemechode bechedvavta, ulemechal seudata dematronita.

Beyoma deshabbeta, bisudata tinyayna, ketiv (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai. al Adonai vadday. dehahi shaata itgalya attika kaddisha, vechullehu almin bechedvavta, ushelimu vechedvavta deattika avdenan, useudata dileh hu vadday.

Bisudata telitaa deshabbeta, ketiv vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha. da hi seudata dizer appin, dehave bishlemuta. vechullehu shita yomin, mehahu shelimu mitbarchan. uvae bar nash lemechode bisudateh, uleashlema illen seudate, deinnun seudate mehemanuta shelemata, dezara kaddisha deyisrael, di mehemanuta illaa, deha dilhon hi, vela deammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. uvegini kach amar, (Shemot lo) beni uven bene yisrael.

Ta chaze, bisudate illen, ishtemodun yisrael, deinnun beni malka. deinnun mehechala demalka, deinnun beni mehemanuta, uman defagim chad seudata minnayyhu, achze pegimuta leella, veachze garmeh delav mibbene malka illaa hu, delav mibbene hechala demalka hu delav mizzara kaddisha deyisrael hu. veyahavin aleh chumera ditlat millin, dina degehinnam vegomer.

Veta chazi, bechullehu shear zimnin vechaggin, bae bar nash lechde, ulemechde lemiskene. vei hu chadde bilchodoy, vela yahiv lemiskene, onsheh saggi, deha bilchodoy chadde, vela yahiv chidu leachara. aleh ketiv, (Malachi 2:3) vezeriti feresh al penechem peresh chaggechem. vei ihu beshabbata chadde, af al gav dela yahiv leachara, la yahavin aleh onsha, kishar zimnin vechaggin, dichtiv peresh chaggechem. persh chaggechem kaamar, velo peresh shabbattechem. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 1:14) chadshechem umoadechem sana nafshi. veillu shabbat la kaamar.

Uvegine kach ketiv, beni uven bene yisrael. umishshum dechol mehemanuta ishtechach beshabbata, yahavin leh levar nash nishmeta achara, nishmeta illaa, nishmeta dechol shelimu bah, kedugema dealma deate. uvegine kach ikre shabbat. mahu shabbat. shema dekudesha berich hu. shema deihu shelim mikkol sitroy.

Amar rabbi yosi, vadday kach hu. vavy leh levar nash, dela ashlim chedavavta demalka kaddisha. uman chedvavta deleh. illen telat seudate mehemanuta. seudate deavraham yitzchak veyaakov kelilan behu. vechullehu chidu al chidu mehemanuta shelemuta, mikkol sitroy.

Tana, bahaden yoma mitatteran avahan, vechol benin yankin, ma delav hachi bechol shear chaggin uzemanin. bahaden yoma, chayyayvayya degehinnam nayychin. bahaden yoma, kol dinin itkafyayn, vela mitarin bealma. bahaden yoma orayyta mitattera beitrin shelemin. bahaden yoma, chedvavta vetafnuka ishtema, bematan vechamshin almin.

Ta chazi, bechol shita yome deshabbeta, kad mata shaata ditzlota demincha, dina (156 amud alef) takkifa shalta, vechol dinin mitarin. aval beyoma deshabbeta, kad mata idan ditzlota demincha, raava deraavin ishtechach, veattika kaddisha galya ratzon dileh, vechol dinin mitkafyayn, umishtechach reuta vecheddu becholla.

Uvehay ratzon, istallak moshe, nevia mehemana kaddisha mealma. begin leminda, dela bedina istallak, vehahi shaata beratzon deattika kaddisha nafak nishmateh, veittammar beh. begin kach, (Devarim la) velo yada ish et kevurato ketiv. ma attika kaddisha, temira mikkol temirin, vela yadin illain vetattain. uf hacha, hay nishmeta deittammar behay ratzon, deitgalya beshaata ditzlota demincha deshabbeta, ketiv velo yada ish et kevurato vehu tamir mikkol temirin dealma, vedina la shalta beh. zakkaa chulakeh demoshe.

Tana, behay yoma, deorayyta mitattera beh, mitattera becholla, bechol innun pikkudin bechol innun gizrin veonashin, beshivin anafin dinhora, dezaharin mikkol sitra vesitra. man chame, anafin denafkin mikkol anafa vaanafa, chamishsha kayymin bego ilana, kullehu anpin behu achidan. man chame, innun tarin demitpattechan bechol setar usetar, kullehu mizdaharin venaharin, behahu nehora denafik vela pasik.

Kal karoza nafik, ittearu kaddishe elyonin, ittearu amma kaddisha, deitbachar leella vetatta. ittearu chedvavta lekadmut marechon. ittearu bechedvavta shelemata. izdemanu bitlat chedvavn, ditlat avahan. izdemanu lekadmut mehemanuta, dechedvav dechol chedvavta. zakkaa chulekechon, yisrael kaddishin, bealma den uvealma deate. da hu yaruta lechon, mikkol ammim ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. veal da ketiv, beni uven bene yisrael.

Amar Rabbi yehuda, hachi hu vadday. veal da ketiv zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho uchetiv (Vayikra 19:2) kedoshim tihyu ki kadosh ani Adonai. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 58:13) vekarata lashshabbat oneg likdosh Adonai mechubbad.

Tana, behay yoma, kol nishmatehon detzaddikayyay, mitaddenin betafnuke attika kaddisha, setima dechol setimin. verucha chada meinnuga dehahu attika kaddisha mitpashta (hahu mitpashshet) bechullehu almin, vesalleka venachta, umitpashsheta lechullehu bene kaddishin, lechullehu neture orayyta, venayychin benayycha shelim, mitneshe mikkullehu, kol rugezin, kol dinin, vechol pulechanin kashin. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 14:3) beyom hinniach Adonai lach meatzbecha umiragzecha umin haavoda hakkasha.

Begine kach, shakil shabbeta lokovel orayyta, vechol denatir shabbeta, keillu natir orayyta kulla. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 56:2) ashre enosh yaase zot uven adam yachazik bah shomer shabbat mechallelo veshomer yado measot kol ra. ishtema, deman denatir shabbat, keman denatir orayyta kulla.

Rabbi yuday shail leh lera shimon, yoma chad deara immeh bearcha, amar leh, Rabbi, ha ketiv (sefer acher befarsheta deshabbat) befarsheta da shabbat, deamar yeshaya, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 56:4) cho amar Adonai lassarisim asher yishmeru et shabbetotay vegomer, venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay vegomer. ma ka mayyre.

Amar leh, kapputekaa, chamarach kitre betifsa, unechit, demilla deorayyta bae tzachuta. o afche laachorach, vezil avatray, utechavvevn libbach. amar leh, begineh demor avidna archa, uvatreh demor estakkel bishchinta.

Amar leh, ta chaze, milla da ha ukemuha chavrayyay, vela perishu milla. cho amar Adonai lassarisim. man sarisim. illen innun chavrayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta, umesarse garmayyhu kol shita yomin deshabbeta, velaan beorayyta, uvelelya deshabbeta mezarze garmayyhu beziuuga dilhon, mishshum deyade raza illaa, beshaata dematronita izdavvevgat bemalka.

Veinnun chavrayyay deyadin raza da, mechavvevnin libbayyhu limhemanuta demarehon umitbarchan beibba dimehon behahu lelya. veda hu dichtiv, asher yishmeru, kema deat amar, (Bereshit 37:11) veaviv shamar et haddavar.

Veikrun sarisim vadday, begin lechakkaa leshabbeta leashkecha raava demarehon, dichtiv vvcharo baasher chafatzti. may baasher chafatzti. da ziuuga dematronita. umachazikim bivriti, kolla chad, bivriti setam. zakkaa chulakeh deman deitkaddash bikdusha da, veyada raza da.

Ta chazi, ketiv sheshet yamim taavod veasita kol melachtecha veyom hashshevii shabbat laAdonai elohecha vegomer, kol melachtecha, beinnun shita yome avidtayyhu divne nasha uvegin hay milla. la mizdavvevge chavrayyay, bar bezimna dela yishtekach meavidtayyhu divni nasha, ella avidte dekudesha berich hu. umay avidte. ziuuga dematronita, leappaka nishmatin kaddishin lealma.

Uvegin kach, behay lelya chavrayyay mitkaddeshe bikdushsha demarehon, umechavvevne libbayyhu, venafke bene maale, benin kaddishin, dela satan limina velismala, benin demalka umatronita. veal illen ketiv, (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem, laAdonai elohechem vadday. begin deillen ikrun benin dileh, benin lemalka ulematronita.

Veha datayyhu dechavrayyay deyadin raza da, beda mitdabbekan. uvegin kach ikrun benin lekudesha berich hu. vehani innun dealma mitkayyeyma beginayyhu. vechad salik alma bedina, istakkal kudesha berich hu beinnun benoy, umerachem al alma. veal da ketiv (Yirmeyahu 2:21) kullo zera emet. zera emet vadday. mahu emet. izka kaddisha shelemata. kema deat amer (Micha 7:20) titten emet leyaakov. (emet da kudesha berich hu) vecholla chad. uvegine kach, zera emet vadday.

Amar leh Rabbi yuday, berich rachamana deshadarni hacha, berich rachamana, deha milla da shemana mippumach. bacha rabbi yuday. amar leh Rabbi shimon, amay ka bachit. amar leh, bachena, daamena devavy leinun bene alma, dearchehon kivire, vela yade vela mistakkele, detav lon dela itberiu. vavy lealma kad yippuk mor minneh, deman yachil legallaa razin, uman yinda lon, uman yistakkal bearche orayyta.

Amar leh, chayyecha, let alma ella leinun chavrayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta veyadin setime orayyta. vadday bikshot gazru chavrayyay al amma deara, dimchabbelin archayyhu, vela yadin ben yemina lismala, deha innun kivire, deyeot lemebad behu dina, afillu beyom hakkippurim. veal benayyhu ketiv, (Hoshea 2:6) ki vene zenunim hemma, vene zenunim mammash.

Amar leh, Rabbi, hay kera bae leityayshsheva bearchoy. ketiv (Yeshayahu 56:5) venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay yad vashem tov mibbanim umibbanot shem olam etten lo. etten lahem mibbae leh, mahu etten lo.

Amar leh, ta chaze, venatatti lahem beveti, mahu beti. kema deat amar (Bamidbar 12:7) bechol beti neeman hu. (341 dekudesha berich hu ikre bet) uvechomotay, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 62:6) al chomotayich yerushala 40 hifkadti shomrim yad vashem, kelomar deyishlefun nishmatin kaddishin midducheta da. vehahu yad, chulak beashlamuta. tav, malya mibbenin umibbenatan. shem olam etten lo, lehahu chulak shelim. asher lo yikkaret ledare darin. davar acher etten lo lehahu deyada raza demilla, veyitkevavn bema devae lechavvevna.

Tu amar Rabbi shimon, ketiv, (Shemot 35:3) lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem beyom hashshabbat. may taama. begin dela itchaze dina behay yoma. vei tema ha laggavoah salleka. bechol moshvotechem kaamar, vela laggavoah. vehahu desalleka laggavoah, leachfeya ledina achara salleka. detanenan, it eshsha achla eshsha. veesha demadbecha, achla eshsha achara.
Uvegine kach, itgalya attika kaddisha behay yoma, mikkol shear yomin. uvezimna deitgalya attika, la itchaze dina kelal. vechol illain vetattain mishtakkechin bechedvavta shelemata, vedina la shalta.

Tana, ketiv (Shemot 31:17) ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai et hashshamayim veet haaretz. sheshet yamim vadday, vela besheshet. vehane yomin kaddishin illain, ikrun yome dishma kaddisha itkelil behu, veinnun itteklilan beh. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael mikkol ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, alayyhu ketiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom.

ohc: Bedabberam el paro. ulay ki beyom rishon sheddibberu hayu chen vegomer velo achar ken, veshiur tevat bedabberam behatechalat dabberam.

rashi: Vegam ani. kemo shehitztzavti veheemadti habberit yesh alay lekayyem, lefichach shamati et naakat bene yisrael hannoakim, asher mitzrayim maavidim otam vaezkor oto habberit, ki bivrit ben habbetarim amarti lo "vegam et haggoy asher yaavodu dan anochi" (Bereshit 15):
ohc: Vegam ani shamati vegomer. amro vegam perush, millevad shehitpallelu lemiddat harachamim, umillevad ahavat haavot uveritam, yesh bechina shelishit shelletzad tzaakatam levad mehashshibud shama Adonai kol tzaakatam mikkeev lev. vehu amro vegam ani, uferush "ani" hu shem harachamim sheamar battechilla "vayyomer elav ani Adonai", mitztzad rachamay levad shamati et naakatam, perush, tzeaka mikkeev lev kechalal hannoek mibbeli tzorech tefillatam, vehu sheddiyyek lomar asher mitzrayim maavidim otam, perush, bechinat tzaar hashshibud shemmitzrayim maavidim otam hu sheshshamati. veayyen ma shepperashti befasuk (Shemot 2:23) "vattaal shavatam el haelohim min haavoda". gam yityashshev lefi shear hadderachim shekkatavnu, vehammaskil yavin:

Vaezkor et beriti. perush gam ken legoolam latet lahem et haaretz, vehi habberit harshuma besamuch, vaani makdim bizman ze letzad harachamim kemo shekkatavnu lemala. vehaomer shehabberit hi lippara min haggoy haoved, lo huzekra berit zo besamuch vedochak leharechik haddevarim:

rashi: Vattaal hatztzefardea. tzefaredda achat hayta vehayu makkin otah vehi mattezet nechilim nechilim, zehu midrasho (sanhedrin 67). ufeshuto yesh lomar, sherutz hatzefardeim kore leshon yechidut; vechen vattehi hakkinnam – harchisha, 341 belaaz, veaf vattaal hatztzefardea – 520 belaaz:
Letannin. nachash:
ohc: Vayyaasu chen kaasher tzivva vegomer. taam kafal lomar "chen kaasher" vegomer, velo hispik lo beachat mehenna, nitkavven lishne devarim: haechad sheasu haddevarim ken, vehashsheni shello asu ad asher shaal mehem paro haot kaasher tzivva Adonai.

Od yirtze, leheyot ki haot yaggid al chizzuk nevuatam kede sheyyeamnu, heid hakkatuv alehem ki lo asu haddavar letzad davar ze ella laasot mitzvat Adonai. vehu amro kaasher tzivva Adonai, ki yoter chaviv al hatztzaddikim asot mitzvat Adonai mikkol ratzon baolam:

rashi: Hinne yotze hammayma. linkavav; shehaya ose atzmo eloah veomer sheeno tzarich linkavav, umashkim veyotze lannilus veose sham tzerachav (tanchuma):
Ketzeti et hair. min hair, aval betoch hair lo hitpallel lefi shehayta melea gillulim (Shemot Rabba):
ohc: Vehabbarad lo yihye od. perush, lo yihye mechadash, uma shekkevar haya veyatza min hashshamayim en od, al derech amro (Shemot 9:33): "umatar lo nittach artza", veamad baavir ad et bo devaro beacharit hayyamim vehorid avanim shehayu al gav ish (berachot ned:).
Lemaan teda vegomer. perush, en ani mitpallel alecha letzad sheani maamin bidvarecha shetteshallach et haam, ella lehareotcha ki laAdonai haaretz.

rashi: Lishchin poreach avabuot. ketargumo, loshichana sage avabuin, sheal yado tzomchin bahen buot:
Shechin. leshon chamimut; veharebe yesh bilshon mishna, "shana shechuna" (yoma 53):
Vederech bogdim etan. kashe lo velaacherim:
