targum: Sichla tava yahev chesda vearcha takifa devazoze tevad:

rashi: Venilu mitzrayim. levakkesh refua leme hayeor sheyyihyu reuyin lishtot:
Kofer nefesh ish ashro. ashro shel adam hu kofer nafsho, sheasa mimmennu tzedaka:
Verash lo shama geara. uvilvad shello yashmia geara larash shennoten lo veeno machlimo. davar acher: kofer nefesh ish ashro, torato:

Verash. bedivre tora lo shama geara. eno yodea lasur min haraa, lefi shello nizhar. umidrash aggada: al "machatzit hashshekel" medabber, shehittil hakkatuv al kol yisrael, vehishva bo dal veashir (Shemot 30:15); sheen harash shomea geara uchelimma min heashir, lemor lo: chelki gadol mechelkecha bekarbenot tzibbur:
targum: It leh purekana denafsheh degavra utereh umaskena la mekabbel bata:

rashi: Mirma belev chorshe ra. umittoch shehem terudim bemachashavot shel tarmit, en lahem simcha, uleyoatze shalom simcha:
targum: Ramayuta belibbehon dechashlin bishta uleilen deyaatzin shelama chedveta teheve:

rashi: Ki atta shalachti et yadi vegomer. ki illu ratziti, keshehayta yadi vemiknecha shehikkitim baddever, shelachtiha vehikketi otcha veet ammecha im habbehemot, vattikkached min haaretz, aval baavur zot heemadticha vegomer:

ohc: Vayyar paro ki chadal vegomer. perush, shello amad bitshuvato sheamar "Adonai hatztzaddik" vegomer afillu zeman muat, ella techef umiyyad "vayyosef lachato". perush, hosif al hakkodem, ki illu lo haya ella shiur harishon lo haya maspik lehachazik beyisrael achare reoto pele habbarad, ella shehosif al geder risho shehaya bo vehichbid libbo velev avadav.
Chassalat parashat vaere.

rashi: Vayyimmale. minyan shivat yamim, shello shav hayeor lekadmuto, shehayta hammakka meshammeshet revia chodesh, 9 chalakim haya meid umatre vahem (tanchuma):
ohc: Vayyimmale shivat yamim. perush, malu shiur hammugebal lammakka, veachare sheshshalmu shivat yamim achare hakkot vegomer vayyomer Adonai. vechavvanat hakkatuv behodaa zo hi ki lo nitraggesh paro bemakka zo levakkesh mimmoshe lehitpallel el Adonai venishara hammakka ad gevulah, vehu amro vayyimmale vegomer achare shehikka Adonai veshalmu umalu yeme hammakka. veze ledaat merabbotenu zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 9,12) sheamru ki esrim vearbaa yamim haya matre bahem ad shello baa hammakka veshiva yamim hayta hammakka meshammeshet bahem, aval lehaomer ki shiva yamim haya matre bahem veesrim vearbaa yamim hayta hammakka meshammeshet bahem, hayu shivat yamim shel hahatraa, umimmela hannishar mehachodesh hayta meshammeshet hammakka bahem. ella shekkashe lisvarato mimmakkat choshech, veulay zo yatzta mehakkelal, veefshar sheggam hayeor makkato yatzta mehakkelal, veyode man deamar esrim vearbaa yamim hayta meshammeshet hammakka shehayeor lo archa makkato, veyitkavvenu shenehem yachad bemashmaut hakkatuv sheamar "shivat yamim achare hakkot" shello hukka ella shivat yamim kemishpat makkat choshech shello hayta yoter mishshiva. vesover ani shehagam shehaya gevul lammakka hayta mistalleket im haya moshe mitpallel kodem hazzeman hahu:

rashi: Vehachebed et libbo. leshon paol hu, kemo "haloch venasoa" (Bereshit 12), vechen "vehakkot et moav" (Melachim 2 3:24), "veshaol lo velohim" (Shmuel 1 22:13), "hakke ufatzoa" (Melachim 1 20):
Kaasher dibber Adonai. vehechan dibber? velo yishma alechem paro:
Mipperi fi ish yochal tov. missechar torato yochal tov baolam hazze, vehakkeren kayyemet laolam habba:
Venefesh bogdim chamas. vechefetz bogdim chamas, kemo "im yesh et nafshechem" (Bereshit 23:8), "al titteneni benefesh tzaray" (tehillim 27:12):
targum: Gavra min peri fumi nisba tavta venafshehon devazoze titchatef:

rashi: Vattehi hakkinnam. harchisha, 331 belaaz:
ohc: Vattehi hakkinnam baadam vegomer kol afar vegomer. kashe, shehaya tzarich lomar "kol afar vegomer haya chinnim vattehi hakkinnam baadam uvabbehema". veyuvan al pi ma shennechleku hattosafot bemassechet shabbat daf 12 rabbi yaakov meorliynsh verabbenu tam ma hi hannikret kinna, umehem hochichu mikkan ki kinna hi hakkofetzet sheddarkah lehithauot meafar haaretz, umehem amru ki zo nikret parosh, vechinna hi hallevana haggedola babbegadim, vehochichu meotah sheamru (berachot na,1) missemartute kalme. vehinne lema shenneemar ki kinnim hi kinna hallevana, ba hakkatuv lehasir mekom hattaut, ki hassechel yakkir davar ze shemma shemmithavve meheafar hi kinna hakkofetzet. laze im haya omer "kol afar haaretz vegomer vattehi hakkinnam", az tihye hakkavvana bifshitut shehi hakkofetzet. laze nitchakkem lomar vattehi hakkinnam baadam, perush hargila lihyot baadam mimmennu, vehakkanat hahakkaa hi sheyyitrabbe ippusho veyigdal beguf haadam kinna hallevana uvabbehema kinna hargila bah.

O efshar ki shenehem hayu bainyan, haachat remazah beamro vattehi hakkinnam baadam uvabbehema, perush hammithavve mehaadam umehabbehema, millevad kinna hakkofetzet shekkol afar haaretz haya chinnim. uchefi ze shene minim ellu nikraim kinnim, uchefi ze en hochacha mikkan lakkinna hammuzkar bedivre chachamim ma hi, im hi min hallavan o min hakkofetz, kevan sheshshenehem nikraim kinna. umeatta en hochachot harav yosef meorliynsh hochacha, uvanu lehacheraat rabbenu tam shehochiach mehashshas ma hu shekkorin chazal kinna, shehi hallevana, aval hakkofetzet yichadu lah chachamim shem parosh kede lehakkir min hakkinna sheasru beshabbat, vechen halacha (tur shulechan aruch orach chayyim siman 316).

rashi: Vegam hakimoti et beriti vegomer. vegam keshennireti lahem beel shadday hitztzavti veheemadti veriti beni uvenehem,

Latet lahem eretz kenaan. leavraham befarashat mila neemar "ani el shadday vegomer venatatti lecha ulezaracha acharecha et eretz megurecha" (Bereshit 17), leyitzchak "ki lecha ulezaracha etten et kol haaratzot hael vahakimoti et hashshevua asher nishbati leavraham" (sham 26), veotah shevua shennishbati leavraham beel shadday amarti leyaakov – "ani el shadday pere ureve vegomer veet haaretz asher vegomer" (sham 35), hare shennadarti lahem velo kiyyamti:
ohc: Vegam hakimoti vegomer. lefi ma shepperashnu ki yodiennu elohim asher yafli beno uven haavot, yirtze beamro vegam hakimoti keillu amar vahagam shehakimoti vegomer, o vegam shehakimoti vegomer, af al pi chen lo hissigu lehodia lahem shemi Adonai kemo shehissagta atta.

Od yirtze lomar ki davar ze hu davar she baruch hu chayyav laasoto kivyachol, millevad shennigla alehem beel shadday vehivticham, od lo shekkiyyem immahem shevua vechulei, umeatta tzarich lekayyem shevuato vehaddavar behechreach lihyot. uvaze techezakna yadav shel moshe kesheyyeda ki davar ze en lo menia millihyot ken. vahagam shekkevar heshivo al ma shettaan moshe shehaya lo leakkev hashshelichut ad et ketz veheshivo vayyomer lo ani Adonai ki lo yuchal lisbol lichbosh et rachamav, adayin yesh lachush sheyyitatztzel moshe bigmar shelichut hayyetzia kesheyyire kol chozek lev paro o al hayyam yerata laachorav, laze hodio el elyon ki haddevarim hem alav betokef hashshevua latet lahem et haaretz.

Et eretz megurehem. tzarich ladaat lamma lo hispik bema shehizkir shemah "eretz kenaan", vechazar veamar "et eretz megurehem"? veulay shennitkavven lomar ki haggerut kevar hitchil mime haavot, venafka minnah lehatechil hamminyan mizzeman haavot uchemo shekken haya. ella ki adayin kashe, shehaya lo lomar "et eretz kenaan eretz megurehem", lamma amar "et" shennire shehem shete aratzot? veulay shennitkavven lehosif eretz pelishtim, uchemo shepperashti befasuk (Bereshit 26:3) "gur baaretz hazzot vegomer ki lecha ulezaracha etten" vegomer, yeuyyan sham.

rashi: Lo yeunne latztzaddik. lo yeera, lo tizdammen lo avera beli daat:
targum: La shappir letzadika kol midaam deata verashie malyan bishta:

rashi: Heevid et chelo. al tzor avoda gedola:
Kol rosh. anshe chelotav:

Mukrach vechol katef meruta. kederech hatztzarim al hair yamim rabbim, vetorchim vigeim beset massaot etzim vaavanim. vehu lachad et tzor beesrim veshalosh lemalchuto, kemo shemmatzinu beseder olam (seder olam Rabba 26). mukrach kalbu belaaz:
Meruta. pelia belaaz:
Vesachar lo haya lo. leachar sheshshallu shelalah, ala hayyam veshataf mehem, lefi shennigzar aleha veal shelalah leaved bayyam:
targum: Bar adam nevuchadretzar malka devavel aflach yat mashiryateh pulechan rav al kol sear resh natter vechol chetaf itmerat vaagar la hava leh ulemashiryateh mitzor al pulechana deaflach alah:

rashi: Mibbenot putiel. mizzera yitro sheppittem agalim laaza, umizzera yosef sheppitpet beyitzro (sota 43):
Kaet machar. kaet hazzot lemachar; sarat lo serita bakkotel – lemachar keshettaggia chamma lechan, yered habbarad:

Hivvasda. shennityasseda; vechol teva shettechillat yesodah yod, kegon yasad, yeled, yada, yasur, keshehi mitpaelet, tavo havvav bimkom hayyod, kemo hivvasdah, hivvaldah (Hoshea 2), vayyivvada, "vayyivvaled leyosef" (Bereshit 46), "bidvarim lo yivvaser aved" (Mishlei 29):

Ushene chayye levi vegomer. lamma nimnu shenotav shel levi? lehodia kamma yeme hashshibud; shekkol zeman sheechad min hashshevatim kayyam lo haya shibud (shemot Rabba 1), shenneemar "vayyamat yosef vechol echav" (shemot 1), veachar kach "vayyakam melech chadash", velevi heerich yamim al kullam:
Unetashticha hammidbara. zo hi avdanan shel dagim, kevan shennitshu al pene hayyabbasha metim. 21 284 25 belaaz:
targum: Vaaratshinach lemadbera yatach veyat kol shiltone tukefach al appay chakla titreme neveltach la titkenesh vela titkevar lechayat ara uleofa dishmaya mesartach leishtetzaa:

rashi: Betafsam becha vechappecha. bakkaf keri, keadam hamehallech venishan al maklo:
Terotz. tirtzetz:
Uvakata lahem kol katef. ketefehem, keadam hannismach al kane, venishbar, vehaadam nofel alav vehakkerumiyyot nichnasot lo bichtefav:

Vehaamadta lahem kol matnayim. meachar shettishshaver, yitztarchu lechazzek et matnehem velaamod alehem; vahare atta keadam shechavero nishan alav vehu challash, veomer lo: hitchazzek al matnecha, ki lo tismoch od alay. vechen tirgem yonatan: "vela tehe lehon levet sumechvavn". veyesh machalifin vehaamadta lahem lo himadta, veeni roe et divrehen. umenachem chibbero im maamad raglayim, kamoni:
targum: Beitkenayutehon bach beyad melach takif titmesar veyevad bet rochatzanehon uveistemachutehon alach tittevar vela tehe lehon levet sumechvan:

rashi: Belahatehem. belachashehon; veen lo dimyon bammikra; veyesh ledammot lo "lahat hacherev hammithappechet" (Bereshit 3) – dome shehi mithappechet al yede lachash:
Peullato asher avad bah. sechar peulla asher avad bemitzvati betzor, etten lo et eretz mitzrayim:
Asher asu li. mitzrayim raa, bemishantam shehivtichu et ammi, beezratam, hevel (Eicha 4:17):
targum: Agreh deaflach beh yehavet leh yat ara demitzrayim dechavu kodamay leitpera minhon amar Adonai elohim:

rashi: Shelach haez. ketargumo, shelach kenosh, vechen "yoshve haggevim heizu" (yeshaya 10), "haizu bene vinyamin" (yirmeya 6):
Velo yeasef habbayta. leshon hachenasa hu:
ohc: Veatta shelach haez. veim tomar, im ken ma makka zo osa? hare shellecha lefanecha ma shehikdim Adonai lomar lo sheen tachlit hakkavvana bammakkot lehara, ella baavur hareoto kocho haggadol veyado hachazaka, velaze hodio sheyyeesof adam uvehema min hassade. veal kol panim taase hammakka roshem behashechata ma shehu mechubbar laaretz, shekken ketiv: "veet kol esev hassade hikka habbarad veet kol etz hassade shibber" (Shemot 9:25).

Venishar lanu lehasekil betevat veatta ma yechavven bah elohenu elyon, im lomar kifshatah mammash beoto et lamma yetzav hael al ze kevan sheen habbarad yored ad lemachar kaet hahi. veulay ki tzarich shiur ze lishloach ad lemakom sheadam uvehema shamma velashuv leasef habbayta.

Od nire behakedim lishol: devar Adonai "shelach haez" – leeze makom note? im lehayyare devar Adonai, hu meatzmo kesheyyishma ki machar yamtir Adonai barad bassade yira veyachnis avadav umiknehu, ella vadday shello bau haddevarim ella lemi sheeno yere devar Adonai. uchefi ze yechavven beamro veatta al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 101; midrash Tehillim 100,2) en "veatta" ella teshuva, ki leheyot shehem enam samim al lev devar Adonai, laze amar lahem sheyyachzeru bitshuva veyasimu al lev devar Adonai ki aso yaase, veyachnisu min hassade vegomer. vehodia hakkatuv ki harshaim lo chazru bitshuva velo samu libbam vegomer, uvaara bam esh Adonai.

Haetiru el Adonai. tzarich ladaat lamma lo pana uva el beto bemakka zo kemo sheasa bemakkat haddam, halo gam et zot heruhu chartummav ki asu gam hemma. achen piv ana bo taam haregashato bazo vechol kayyotze bah shehuregash vekara lemoshe lehitpallel baado, ki lo haya mitpael ella kesheemot mavet naflu alav.
Veze seder makkotav: rishona makkat dam lo haya lo bah sakkanat mavet, umayim litzmao matzu lo sevivot hayeor o haya kone miyyisrael, laze lo nirgash mimmenna.

Makkat tzefardea hayu bo shene devarim: haechad – hareashat hakkol, vehashsheni – shehayu nichnasim bimehem, dichtiv (Shemot 7:29) "uvecha uveammecha yaalu hatzefardeim", umakka zo mevahelet hannefesh veen adam batuach bechayyav. laze amar paro el moshe vegomer veyaser hatzefardeim mimmenni perush, mittoch bene meav vegomer;

Makkat kinnim, ki hagam sheyyitztaer aval en sham sakkanat mavet katztzefardeim shettinkov bene meav vegomer vetaasennu terefa, velaze hagam sheyyada ki etzba elohim hi veheidu hachartummim ki enam yecholim asot, af al pi chen "vayyechezak lev" vegomer.
Makkat arov, emot shen behemot sheshshalach Adonai bo, bihaluhu vayyira ad meod, vetechef shalach acharehem veamar (Shemot 8:21) "lechu zivchu vegomer anochi ashallach vegomer haetiru baadi".
Makkat dever, letzad shehayta bammikne levad, hagam ki shalach veraa mikne yisrael velo met echad, af al pi chen lo shat libbo levakkesh rachamim.

Makkat shechin, letzad shello haya bo sakkana, gam efshar shennitkabbed bemakka zo mimma shello hizkir Adonai beferush ki gam bo haya shechin, velo amar ella (Shemot 9:11) ki haya hashshechin bachartummim uvechol mitzrayim, laze lo bikkesh mimmoshe lehitpallel baado.

Makkat barad, letzad shehirim Adonai mishshamayim venatan kolot veesh min hashshamayim nafla alehem emata vafachad, sheyyaase lahem kemahpechat sedom vaamora, ufachad verahav levavo (Yeshayahu 60:5) veamar "Adonai hatztzaddik vegomer haetiru el Adonai" vegomer (Shemot 9:27).
Makkat haarbe piv ana bo, ki ma shennitraggesh hu letzad sheyyare yirat mavet, dichtiv (Shemot 10:17) "veyaser mealay rak et hammavet hazze".

Makkat choshech lo rainu lo shebbikkesh mimmoshe lehitpallel, veulay ki bishlosha yamim rishonim haya madlik ashashiyyot ufanasot gedolot vayyaer et hachoshech, uvishlosha yamim sheniyyim shehaya choshech memushshash velo kamu ish mittachtav lo haya metziut lo sheyyelech adam likro lemoshe ki lo kamu ish mittachtav, veachar sheshshalmu shivat yeme afela (Shemot Rabba 14) techef umiyyad shalach achar moshe veamar elav sheyyelchu ella sheyyittenu bittachon mehem sheyyachzeru velo kibbel moshe, uletzad shekkevar paska hammakka lo hutzrach lomar lo hitpallel.

rashi: Mishenet kane. kamma peamim samchu alehem, bime sancheriv (Melachim 1 18:21) uvime nevuchadnetztzar (yirmeya 37:5-8), velo hoil lahem, kekane ze, shehu rach veeno somech et hannishan alav:
targum: Veyedun kol yatve mitzrayim are ana Adonai chalaf dahavo semach kanya reia levet yisrael:

rashi: Mitavva vaayin nafsho atzel. mitavva nafsho lechol tov vaayin:
Venefesh charutzim tedushshan: yesharim haochlim yegia kappehem. zehu mashmao lefi peshuto. ulefi meshalo: leatid yire bichvod talmide chachamim veyitavve, velo yassig lo:
targum: Mitragrega nafsheh deatla midaam vela mayte lah venafshehon ditkife tidhan:

rashi: Vaani akshe. meachar shehirshia vehitris kenegdi, vegaluy lefanay sheen nachat ruach baummot latet lev shalem lashuv, tov sheyyitkashshe libbo, lemaan harebot bo ototay, vetakkiru attem et gevurati. vechen middato shel hakkabba, mevi puranut al haummot kede sheyyishmeu yisrael veyiru, shennee "hichratti goyim nashammu pinnotam … amarti ach tiri oti tikchi musar" (Tzefanya 3); veaappiche bechamesh makkot harishonot lo neemar vaychazzek Adonai et lev paro, ella vayyechezak lev paro (tanchuma):
Chachim. kemin tabbeot barzel eynsh belaaz:
Degat yeorecha bekaskesotecha. intishaikratish belaaz; kelomar: etten belev kol gibborecha latzet immecha lammilchama, veyippelu kullam:
targum: Veetten shirin belisatach veektol shiltone tukefach im gibbarach vaavatlinach mimalchutach veyat kol shiltone tukefach im gibbarach yitkatlun:

rashi: Verisha tesallef chattat. kemo chote, veal shehu rasha gamur korehu chattat. umashmautah: et hachote tesallef rishato, tekalkel oto vetashpilehu. kol silluf – kilkul vechishshalon hu, kemo "ivvelet adam tesallef darko" (Mishlei 19:3), vetavo alav raa:
targum: Tzidketa tintor leilen ditmimin bearchathon verashia metaltel bachatohi:

rashi: Hem hamedabberim vegomer. hem shennitztauu, hem shekkiyyemu:
Hu moshe veaharon. hem bishlichutam uvetzidkatam mittechilla vead sof (Megila 11):
ohc: Veamro hem hamedabberim, perush, kemelech haggozer al avdo bidvar sefatayim laasot davar. od yechavven lehodia shehagam shettimtza sheamar hakkatuv sheydabber moshe, teda ki gam aharon dibber, kaasher avaer befasuk "vayhi beyom dibber Adonai" (Shemot 6:28).

Hu moshe veaharon. perush, sheshshekulim hem, velaze paam yakdim moshe ufaam yakdim aharon, umeatta yachol lomar al shenehem leshon yachid "hu moshe veaharon". veulay ki taam sheamar besamuch leshon rabbim "hem hamedabberim" letzad shebbaddibbur yishtannu.

rashi: Adam arum kose daat. afillu bechachmato hu tzanua, vechol shekken ledivre shetut hu mechasse. aval velev kesilim yikra ivvelet. machriz ivvelet bekol ram:
targum: Bar nash arima mechase yediata velibbehon desachle sane yediata:

rashi: Yad charutzim. yesharim:
Timshol. taashir:
targum: Ayda detakife tishlat veramae yehon lemisa:

ohc: Vidatem vegomer. perush, achshav yesh lachem ladaat yedia berura ki ani Adonai elohechem hu hammotzi etchem mittachat sivlot mitzrayim, perush, latet alechem sivlot elahuti. od yirtze lomar lahem sheyyashgichu lehakkir middot elohechem, ki el rachum Adonai elohechem.

rashi: Belatehem. lachash sheomrin oto ballat uvachashay; verabbotenu amru, "belatehem" maase shedim, "belahatehem" maase cheshafim (sanhedrin 67):
Vayyechezak lev paro. lomar al yede mechashshefut attem osim ken; "teven attem machnisim leafrayim", ir shekkullah teven, af attem meviin mechashshefut lemitzrayim shekkullah keshafim:
ohc: Vayyaasu chen chartumme vegomer. lefi divrehem zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 9,11) shehayu kol memot mitzrayim ledam, im ken minnayin matzu mayim lehafcho ledam? veulay ki lo nehefchu ella mayim hamegullim, aval mayim shello niru baolam shehem tachat laaretz lo nehefchu, keamro "vayyachperu mitzrayim sevivot" vegomer.

Od lefi divrehem zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 9,10) ki yisrael nitashsheru mimmakkat hayeor, shehayu mochrim mayim lammitzrim vechulei yeuyyan sham divrehem, kefi ze asu hachartummim mehannimkar lahem. uchevar amarnu shehakkatuv rasham shinnuy hammaase shennaasa meAdonai ki yishtanne mimmaase keshafim veshedim, ella ki letzad kashyut arpam shel hammitzrim lo bachanu bemaase kishfehem ladaat ki enam ella chizzayon vedimyon kozev.

rashi: Vayyasar hearov. velo metu kemo shemmetu hatzefardeim, sheim metu haya lahem hanaa beorotam (tanchuma):

Hitpaer alay. kemo "hayitpaer haggarzen al hachotzev bo" (Yeshayahu 10) – mishtabbeach lomar ani gadol mimmecha, 275 belaaz. vechen hitpaer alay – hishtabbeach lehitchakkem velishol davar gadol, velomar shello uchal laasoto:

Lematay atir lecha. et asher atir lecha hayyom al hacheratat hatzefardeim, lematay tirtze sheyyikkartu? vetire im ashlim devari lammoed shettikba li. illu neemar "matay" atir, haya mashma matay etpallel, achshav shenneemar "lematay", mashma ani hayyom etpallel alecha, sheyyikkartu hatzefardeim lizman shettikba alay; emor leeze yom tirtze sheyyikkartu: atir, haetiru, vehaetarti. velo neemar etar, itru, veatarti, mippene shekkol leshon eter harebot pelel hu, vechaasher yomar arbe, harebu, vehirbeti, leshon mafil, kach yomar atir, haetiru, vehaetarti devarim; veav lechullam "vehaetartem alay divrechem" (Yechezkel 35) – hirbetem:
ohc: Hitpaer alay vegomer. tzarich ladaat kavvanat amro hitpaer alay vegomer. veim lomar ki hagam sheyyomar lo lehasir mealav techef umiyyad, ze hu hahitpaarut, im ken kesheamar lo paro "lemachar", velo amar atta beshaa zo, sheyyaggid ki lo ratza lehitpaer alav, ma makom lomar lo "kidvarcha lemaan teda"? en ze hitpaarut miyyom leyom, veadrabba hirchik lo hazzeman. od tzarich ledakdek divre moshe sheamar lematay atir vegomer, shello haya lo lomar ella matay yasir hatzefardeim shehu hamevukkash.

Achen kavvanat moshe lehareoto asher yafli Adonai lechabbev yedidav, umizze yeshaer veyachlit bedato ki mehannimna sheyyaazvem Adonai beshum ofen. ki hinne midderech hammusar, eved ki yishal davar merabbo, ulevay sheyyassig asohu lo, lo sheyyatne alav bizman mesuyyam, uvilvad shello yakdim uvilvad shello yeacher, ella veeved yishaf rabbo et asher yachpotz lechanno ratzon. veamar moshe: bo uree hahashgacha hannechona ushelemut hachibbuv, sheetir laAdonai veomar elav bitfillati ki yaase haddavar beet asher ekba lo hazzeman. vehu amro lematay atir, perush, leeze zeman, titpaer alay lomar hitpallel laAdonai atta ki lizman peloni yasir vegomer.

rashi: Melo chofnechem. 416 belaaz:
Piach kivshan. davar hannippach min haggechalim amumim hannisrafim bakkivshan, uvelaaz 349:
Piach. leshon hafacha, sheharuach mefichan umafrichan:

Uzerako moshe. vechol davar hannizrak bechoach, eno nizrak ella veyad achat, hare nissim harebe – echad shehechezik kumtzo shel moshe melo chafnayim shello veshel aharon, veechad shehalach haavak al kol eretz mitzrayim (tanchuma):
Vayyivla matte aharon. meachar shechazar venaasa matte, bala et kullan (shabbat 97):
Verav. day lo bema shehorid kevar:
Kaved. targumo yakkir velo ityakkar, mippene shehu shem davar, kemo "ki chaved mimmecha haddavar" (Shemot 18):
ohc: Vayyomer Adonai vegomer kaved vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma modia bedavar ze haelohim, achar shehem yodim oto. veulay ki lo haya teshuva beferush mipparo al ze lemoshe shello yeshallach, ella raa haot veshatak, vehodia Adonai lemoshe ma zo shetika, ki kaved libbo umeen leshallach et haam velo chash lehashiv shelilat haddavar.

rashi: Vayyetar el Adonai. nitammetz bitfilla, vechen im ba lomar vayyatir, haya yachol lomar, umashma vayyarbe bitfilla, ucheshehu omer bilshon vayyifal, mashma vayyirbe lehitpallel:
Gam lazot. lemofet hammatte shennehpach letannin, velo laze shel dam:
ohc: Vayyifen vegomer velo shat libbo vegomer. lo sheheshiv sheeno chafetz leshalleach, vechavvanat harasha kede shello yitchayyev onesh al hammeun veyavi alav od makka acheret. vetaam shello shat libbo velo shaal mimmoshe sheyyevakkesh alav rachamim nevaer besamuch (Shemot 8:4) beezrat hashshem:

rashi: Vayyetze, vayyitzak. miyyad, sheyyikkartu lemachar:
ohc: Asher sam lefaro. mikkan shetztzarich lefaresh tefillato.

rashi: Hon mehevel yimat. ose girsato chavilot chavilot yimat, sheyyishtakkach mimmennu meat meat (avoda zara 19.):
targum: Mazala min avla demareh yizar udemachnesh veyahav lemaskena yasne mamoneh:

rashi: Et kol maggefotay. lamadnu mikkan shemmakkat bechorot shekula keneged kol hammakkot:
ohc: Ki bappaam hazzot vegomer. hodio otzem hammakka kedin hahatraa shetztzarich lehaterot alav bammita atzmah, sheim hitru bo bemita kalla uvaim lahamito bachamura – patur kayyadua.

Kol maggefotay vegomer. kashe, halo rainu shehevi alav od shalosh makkot acherot. vehaya nire lomar ki letzad sheshshekula zo keneged kullan, uma sheamru zichronam livracha (Rashi) sheshshekula makkat bechorot keneged kol hammakkot, ulay shezzo shekula keneged kol shellefaneha, shehem shesh makkot, umakkat bechorot shekula keneged kol shellefaneha umakkat barad bichlal, uchesheatta ba leminyan tihye makkat bechorot shekula keneged 14 makkot, velo hinani derech ze.

Vehannachon beenay shennitkavven lomar elav ki beemtzaut makka zo yatte libbo lehavin leharegish bammaggefot shehevi alav Adonai, yuvan ki bechol makka umakka shehevi ad atta lo haya machlit paro bedato ki hem meelohe hayyecholet vehaya tole bimchashshefut umaase shedim, veze lecha haot sheggam hachartummim osim ken. vahagam shehayta makka sheamru hachartummim etzba elohim hi, yesh makom lefaro lachshov ki efshar ki haanashim hahemma lo hissigu hassagat moshe veaharon bimchashshefut veomrim ken, uleolam yimmatze adam mechashshef sheyyaase ken. laze amar elav Adonai ki bappaam hazzot beemtzaut hammakka asher avi alecha ani sholeach et kol maggefotay shekkevar heveti alecha el libbecha perush shetteda ki lo maase kishshuf veshedim hemma ella maase elohim, vehu amro maggefotay bechinnuy haose otam, ki birotcha makka niflaa asher en yecholet leshed vechishshuf laasot afillu dome dedome lehorid esh min hashshamayim befile pelaot az larishonot titbonen.

rashi: Veim maen atta. veim sarvan atta: maen. kemo memaen, mesarev, ella kinnuy haadam al shem hammifal, kemo "shalev" (Iyov 16), "shaket" (Shoftim 18), "sar vezaef" (Melachim 1 20):

Nogef et kol gevulecha. makke, vechen kol leshon maggefa eno leshon mita ella leshon makka, vechen "venagfu ishsha hara" (Shemot 21), eno leshon mita, vechen "uveterem yitnaggefu raglechem" (Yirmeyahu 13), "pen tiggof baeven raglecha" (Tehillim 91), "uleeven negef" (Yeshayahu 8):
ohc: Veim maen atta. tzarich hahatraa samuch lammakka.

rashi: Tishshachet haaretz. nishchetet haaretz, itchabbalat ara:
ohc: Tishshachet haaretz. perush, shehearov yashchit gam kol nimtza millevad bene adam:

rashi: Velo shamu el moshe. lo kibbelu tanchumin:

Mikkotzer ruach. kol mi shehu metzer, rucho uneshimato ketzara, veeno yachol lehaarich binshimato: karov leinyan ze shamati befarasha zo merabbi baruch berabbi eliezer, vehevi li reaya mimmikra ze, "bappaam hazzot odiem et yadi veet gevurati veyadu ki shemi Adonai" (Yirmeyahu 16) – lamadnu keshehakkabba meammen et devarav afillu lefuranut modia sheshshemo Adonai, vechol shekken haamana letova. verabbotenu derashuhu leinyan shel mala, sheamar moshe lama hareota, amar lo hakkabba "chaval al deavdin vela mishtakkechin" – yesh li lehitonen al mitat haavot, harebe peamim nigleti alehem beel shadday velo amru li ma shimcha, veatta amarta ma shemo, ma omar alehem:

Vegam hakimoti vegomer. ucheshebbikkesh avraham likbor et sara lo matza kever ad shekkana vedamim merubbim, vechen beyitzchak iraru alav al habbeerot asher chafar, vechen yaakov vayyiken et chelkat hassade, lintot oholo, velo hirharu achar middotay, veatta amarta lama hareota? veen hammidrash mityashshev achar hammikra mippene chamma devarim, achat, shello neemar ushemi Adonai lo shaalu li, veim tomar lo hodiam shekkach shemo, hare techilla keshennigla leavraham ben habbetarim neemar "ani Adonai asher hotzeticha meur kasdim" (Bereshit 15), veod heach hassemicha nimshechet bidvarim shehu somech lechan vegam ani shamati vegomer lachen amar livne yisrael? lechach ani omer yityashshev hammikra al peshuto, dibbur davur al afnav, vehadderasha tiddaresh, shenneemar "halo cho devari kaesh neum Adonai uchefattish yefotzetz sala" (Yirmeyahu 23) – mitchallek lechamma nitzotzot (sanhedrin 34):
ohc: Mikkotzer ruach. ulay ki letzad shello hayu bene tora lo shamu, velaze yikkare kotzer ruach ki hattora marchevet libbo shel adam.

Umeavoda kasha. taam amro umeavoda, ze yaggid ki millevad tzaar haavoda od haya lahem kotzer ruach, vehattaam birotam kamma kavda alehem hammelacha katzra nafsham millevad perat tzaar haavoda, vegam midderech haish asher tiktzar nafsho lo yuchal avod ki yechalesh lemachovo, veraim hem hashshenayim, asher al ken amar umeavoda ki katzra rucham vegam kavda avodatam.

Od lema shennitbasseru yisrael besorat haggeulla, nitrachev levavam vattechi nafsham verucham, ucheshechazru lashshibud, hagam shello hayu mishtabedim ella shiur haragil ulematta mimmennu, af al pi chen tiktzar ruach, vehammaskil betiviyyut harekavat haenoshi yaskil al davar. umodia od hakkatuv sheggam hichbidu ullam alehem yoter meharagil, vehu amro umeavoda vegomer.

rashi: Mitlakkachat betoch habbarad. nes betoch nes, haesh vehabbarad meoravin, vehabbarad mayim hu, velaasot retzon konam asu shalom benehem:
ohc: Vayhi varad veesh vegomer. amro mitlakkachat perush, ki leheyot shehammayim vehaesh hem shene devarim hafekiyyim biktze hakketzavot, veen keruv lahem, uvehitchabberam yachad hammitrabbe al chavero notzeach umeabbedo, im mayim rabbim yuchelu lechabbot, veim esh rabba hi ochelet et hammayim. vehodia Adonai ki bishlichut Adonai kesheshshelacham yachad hayta haesh mitlakkachat, perush, mafelet hafekiut tivah asher hitbia Adonai bah shello lehillakach yachad hi im hammayim, hi hayta mitlakkachat betoch habbarad venismechet elav laasot retzono yitbarach.

rashi: Mofet. ot, lehodia sheyyesh tzeroch bemi sheshsholeach etchem:
Ben chacham musar av. mikra katzar hu: ben chacham shoel veohev musar av. veyesh omrim: bishvil musar haav hu chacham:
Veletz. lo shama geara sheeno mekabbel tochachot:
targum: Bar chakkima mekabbel marduta deabba uvera memikna la mekabbel baata:

rashi: Uvecha uveammecha. betoch meehem nichnasin umekarkerin (sota 11):

Lo nittach. lo higgia, veaf otan shehayu baavir lo higgiu laaretz; vedome lo: "vattittach alenu haala vehashshevua" (Daniel 9) deezra – vattaggia alenu. umenachem ben saruk chibbero bechelek "kehittuch kesef" (Yechezkel 22), leshon yetzikat mattechet, veroe ani et devarav, ketargumo veyatzak – veattich, latzeket – leattacha. af ze lo nittach laaretz – lo hutzak laaretz:
Notzer piv shomer nafsho posek sefatav. poteach sefatav ledabber tamid kol rucho, min "vattefasseki et raglayich" (Yechezkel 16:25) leshon rachav:
targum: Denatar pumeh mizdehar benafsheh ufetiach sifvateh senu shetzya it leh:

rashi: Zivchu lelohechem baaretz. bimkomchem velo telchu bammidbar:
Hah. kemo ahah; hah layyom heatid lavo al otan haovde kochavim umazzalot:
targum: Bar adam itnabbe vetemar kidnan amar Adonai elohim aylilu vaamaru vay min kodam yoma:

rashi: Vealu. min hayeor:
Bevetecha. veachar kach bevet avadecha. hu hitchil baetza techilla, "vayyomer el ammo" (Shemot 1), umimmennu hitchila happuranut:

Velo teshev arbaim shana. arbaim ushetayim shene reavon nigzeru bachalom paro, keneged shelosha peamim shennichtav hachalom: sheva parot vesheva shibbolim raot raa (Bereshit 41:1-7), vesippero leyosef (Bereshit 41:17-24), hare shene feamim, veyosef amar lo: "sheva happarot harakkot veharaot vesheva hashshibbolim harekot" (Bereshit 41:27), hare arbaim ushetayim laraav; velo haya lahem ella shetayim, shenneemar "ki ze shenatayim haraav" (Bereshit 45:6); umishsheyyarad yaakov lemitzrayim pasak haraav, shehare bashshana hashshelishit zaru, shenneemar "veten zera venichye vegomer" (Bereshit 47:19); vehaarbaim nifreu lahem achshav (Bereshit Rabba 89:9):
Teshev arbaim shana. teshev shera ashigia belaaz:
targum: La tebar bah rigla di enasha verigla di veira la tebar vah vela tityattev arbein shenin:

rashi: Henis. hivriach:
Yidach. leshon kefitza, shehashshalhevet kofetzet venichretet:
targum: Nuhare detzadike nirvaz usheraga derashie nidach:

rashi: Lehotzi et hakkinnim. livrotam ulehotziam mimmakom acher:
Velo yacholu. sheen hashshed sholet al beriyya pechuta mikkasseora (sanhedrin 67):

Yesh mitashsher veen kol. mare atzmo ashir. davar acher: yesh adam shehu mitashsher besofo, veen lo kelum bitchillato, veyesh shehu ba lide aniyyut mimmamon gadol. davar acher: mitashsher begezel aniyyim, vesof en lo kelum, veyesh mitroshesh al yede sheppizzer venatan laevyonim, vehon rav muchan lo:
targum: It dimatter nafsheh velet kol midaam umemasken nafsheh umazaleh sagia:

rashi: Hattannim haggadol. lefi shekkol gedullatah shel mitzrayim vechol sova shebbah, al yede yeore nilus hu, lefichach hannavi memashshel et malkah letannin, veet ammah lidgat yeor:
Li yeori. eni tzarich laelyonim, ki yesh li yeori, maspik kol tzerachi:
Vaani asitini. bigvurati uvechachmati higdalti gedullati umemshalti:
targum: Itnabbe vetemar kidnan amar Adonai elohim ha ana shelach rugezi alach paro malka demitzrayim deat dame letanina rabba di share bego naharvateh di amar dili malchuta vaana chevishit:

rashi: Et yadi. yad mammash, lehakkot bahem:
ohc: Velo yishma. kashe, achar sheamar "vaani akshe", ma makom lomar "velo yishma"? od tzarich ladaat ma netinat yad zo chadasha sheenah bichlal otot umoftim haamurim lemala behakeshaat libbo. od yesh ledakdek bakkatuv.

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hu: bitchilla amar vaani akshe vegomer vehirbeti, umodia od sheachar sheyyarbe moftim yosif paro harasha al chattato pesha, velo yirtze lishmoa hashshelichut od mikkem kesheeshlach etchem elav. vechen haya, dichtiv (Shemot 10:28) "al tosef reot panay" vegomer. umodia Adonai lemoshe ki baasoto chen az hu gevulo, ki techef umiyyad yitten Adonai yado, perush, makkat bechorot, al derech amro (divrei hayamim 1 21:16) "vecharbo shelufa beyado".

Veamar bechinnuy elav et yadi, lomar ki makka zo yaasenna Adonai beyado mammash kivyachol, keamram zichronam livracha (mechilta ba): ani velo malach velo saraf velo shaliach ella hakkadosh baruch hu bichvodo vechulei, uveemtzaut makka zo techef umiyyad otzi et tzivotay. veramaz gam ken al ma sheasa belohehem shefatim gedolim bemakkat bechorot kayyadua:

Uvaze nacha dati bemaamar moshe sham, kesheamar lo paro "al tosef" vegomer, heshivo "ken dibbarta lo osif" vegomer. vekashe al moshe rabbenu, al mi samach lomar "lo osif" vegomer, veim yomar lo elohenu "lech el paro" paam acheret, ma yaane? ulefi ma shepperashnu tamo lishvach, ki Adonai amar elav ki kesheyyaggia lemadregat meun shemiat divrehem, ze hu sof gezerato lintot Adonai yado vegomer ulehotzi. laze kesheamar lo "al tosef" vegomer, hare shalal hashshemia shello yishma od mehem davar katan vegadol, vaafillu reot penehem asar al atzmo. laze techef amar elav "ken dibbarta lo osif" vegomer, ella od tishmana aznecha davar atta vegomer. vedavar ze shel makkat bechorot kevar hodio Adonai, uchemo shepperashti befarashat shemot befasuk (Shemot 4:22) "ko amar Adonai beni vechori yisrael", darsho mishsham.

Vehotzeti et tzivotay et ammi vegomer. tzarich ladaat mi hem hatztzevaot, veim hem yisrael haya lo lomar "et tzivot ammi bene yisrael". veulay ki yechavven Adonai lirshom battora hafelagat maalatenu etzlo, ki en lo tzevaot meyuchadim lo keyisrael, velaze im haya omer "et tzivot ammi" vegomer haya makom lomar ki Adonai yesh lo harebe tzive tzevaot veze echad mehem. laze amar et tzivotay setam, lomar harshumim, veen tzorech lomar tzava peloni, ki beamrecha tzivot Adonai echad hu hameyuchad, veachar kach amar mi hu ze veeze hu – et ammi vene yisrael. veyitbaer hakkatuv al derech kelal uferat – en bakkelal, tzivotay, ella happerat shehem bene yisrael, umeatta lo yikkare bechinnuy tzivot Adonai ella yisrael hameromamim vehameullim.

rashi: Hinne yad Adonai hoya. leshon hove, ki chen yomar bilshon nekeva al sheavar hayta, veal heatid tihye, veal haomed hoya, kemo osa, rotza, roa:
ohc: Asher bassade. perush davka, vechullan metu dichtiv "vayyamat kol mikne mitzrayim" (Shemot 9:6), perush shehayu bassade karashum bedivre Adonai.

Baavur vegomer ulemaan sapper. yirtze baavur hareotcha et kochi atta sheamarta mi Adonai, ulemaan sapper shemi beemtzautecha bechol haaretz, perusho, kol haolam yesapperu et godel asher asa lammemaen bidvarav. vechen shamanu sheamar melech echad gadol ki im yavo meshiach yisrael veyaase ot o mofet ki lo yaase kefaro lemaen bidvar Adonai.
Kol mikne mitzrayim. perush, shello hichnisum mehassade, velaze lo amar "asher bassade", vehaven:

Umimmikne vene yisrael. shehayu lahem mime yaakov uvanav shebbau mitzrayma, gam ulay shekkanu merevach shehirvichu bemakkat haddam. veod yirtze lomar sheim hayu mitchakkemin mehammitzriyyim limkor leyisrael kede sheyyihyu nikraim al shem yisrael kede sheyyafli Adonai bahem velo yamutu vehayu maarimin – gam ellu metu. aval mikne yisrael shehem kefi haemet miknehem, lo met. veshiur hakkatuv hu: vayyamat kol mikne mitzrayim vechelek echad mimmikne bene yisrael, uferush mem – lo mem miktzat hatztzon ella mem miktzat min hammikne hannikra al shem yisrael, ki yesh mikne shennikra al shemo vehu shello, veyesh sheeno shello ella shemo nikra alav, veamar ki bechina achat mimmikne yisrael sheheerimu hammitzriyyim likrotam al shemam metu. umikne yisrael perush shehu kefi haemet shel yisrael lo met mehem afillu echad:

rashi: Elle rashe vet avotam. mittoch shehuzkak leyaches shivto shel levi ad moshe veaharon bishvil moshe veaharon, hitchil leyachasam derech toldotam meruven. uvefsikta rabbati raiti, lefi shekkinteram yaakov avinu lishlosha shevatim hallalu bishat moto, chazar hakkatuv veyichasam kan levaddam, lomar shechashuvim hem:
ohc: Elle rashe vegomer. taam sheheela mispar bene yisrael ad moshe, lefi ma shepperashti besamuch shehimlicham al yisrael, yiches otam hakkatuv lomar ki en maamidin al yisrael ella hameyuchas ad yaakov, velaze lo yiches otam hakkatuv kodem ella achar maamar moshe "hen bene yisrael" uteshuvat Adonai elav vaytzavvem, shehimlich otam, venachon.

rashi: Rak bezadon yitten matztza. machaloket:
Veet noatzim. veim hammityaatzim talin chachma:
targum: Lechod bizdanuta atya matzuta veilen demitmalchin chakkime inun:

rashi: Deaga velev ish yashchenna. yesichenna middato:

Vedavar tov yesammechenna. yaasok battora, vehi tesammach et haddeaga shebbelibbo vetatztzilennu mimmenna. uledivre haomer: yesichenna laacherim, kach sofo shel mikra: vedavar tov. sheyyenachamennu chavero, yesammach et haddeaga:
targum: Milta dechilta belibbeh degavra medachala umilaya tavaya mechadyan leh:

rashi: Ushene chayye kehat, ushene chayye amram vegomer. mecheshbon ze anu lemedim al moshav bene yisrael arba meot shana sheamar hakkatuv (Bereshit 15:13), shello veeretz mitzrayim levaddah hayu, ella miyyom shennolad yitzchak; shehare kehat miyyorde mitzrayim haya, chashov kol shenotav ushenot amram ushemonim shel moshe, lo timtzaem arba meot shana, veharebe shanim nivlaim labbanim bishne haavot:
Vayyomer moshe lifne Adonai. hi haamira sheamar lemala hen bene yisrael lo shimu elay, veshana hakkatuv kan, kevan shehifsik hainyan; vechen hi hashshita, keadam haomer "nachazor al harishonot":
Torat chacham mekor chayyim. shehi melammedatto lasur mimmokshe mavet:
targum: Nimosa dechakkima mabbua dechaye lemiste min pacha demota:

rashi: Achot nachshon. mikkan lamdu, hannose ishsha tzarich livdok veacheha (bava batra 110):
Malach rasha yippol bera. kegon bilam, sheamar lo hakkadosh baruch hu "lech im haanashim" (Bamidbar 22:20, la), vehirshia lehassi levalak etza raa; lechach nafal bacherev (Bamidbar 31:8):
Vetzir emunim marpe. ze moshe rabbenu:
targum: Shelicha visha yippel vevishta veizgada mehemna asya hu:

rashi: Et goyim. "iddan tevar ammayya" (targum yonatan):
targum: Are kariv yoma vekariv yoma daatid lemete min kodam Adonai yom anan zia tevar ammaya yehe:

rashi: Ad ko. ad henna; umidrasho: ad shettishma mimmenni makkat bechorot sheeftach bah becho" amar Adonai kachatzot hallayla (Shemot 11:4):
ohc: Veamarta elav Adonai vegomer shelachani vegomer. kol hakkatuv meyuttar, velo haya lo lomar ella pasuk sheacharav "ko amar Adonai" vegomer. veim lomar ki hu shelacho, ze eno tzarich ki yadua hu. veulay ki leheyot shebba elav vehu holech laasot tzerachav babboker hashekem, veyomar paro sheen ze mehilchot derech eretz, shehaya lo lehametin ad et sheyyihye yoshev befalatin shello veyomar elav hashshelichut, laze tzivva Adonai latet lo taam bitchillat devarav veyomar elav Adonai shelachani elecha udevar melech alay lavo beet zo. gam letzad shehu eloah elyon tzarich laasot shelichuto techef umiyyad.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 8,1) befasuk (Yechezkel 29,3) "li yeori vaani asitini", shehaya ose atzmo eloah vehaya mate ammo lomar ki hu machnis veeno motzi, vehaya yotze behashekama derech nistar mikkol chay vehaya ose tzerachav bayor. laze baa hashshelichut meAdonai limkom genuvato umistoro mikkol chay, veamar elav techillat devarav: "Adonai elohe haivrim hu shelachani elecha", perush, hodiani makom atta bo, vahare lecha ot ki Adonai elohenu yodea im yissater ish bammistarim. gam baze nivash ki gilla Adonai kelono laavadav ki kevolo kach polto vesheker bimino vehinne hu kaasher yevaer haggalal (Melachim 1 14,10). veamro vehinne lo shamata ad ko, perush, modio ki Adonai yodea machshavot, vahagam sheadayin lo heshiv paro teshuva lemoshe al haddavar kemo shepperashti befasuk "kaved lev paro", af al pi chen Adonai yodea ki lo shama ad ko.

Od yirtze, letzad shekkadma shelichut moshe veasa ot matte shennehpach lenachash, velo hayta lo makka keshello shama al yede shelichut zo, ucheshebba lehakkot makka rishona shel dam amar elav ki kevar amar lo hashshelichut al ma hu mevi alav haraa, veze shiur hakkatuv Adonai elohe haivrim kevar shelachani elecha vedibbarti lecha vehinne lo shamata, asher al ken ko amar Adonai vegomer, beofen ki eno tzarich lomar lo od paam acheret "ko amar Adonai shallach ammi" vegomer, shekkevar amar lo haddavar.

rashi: Mechuratam. meguratam. lashon acher: kemo toldotam, vechen chibbero menachem:
targum: Veettev yat galut mitzrayim veatev yathon leara patros al ara totvutehon vihon taman malchu chalasha:

rashi: Devar sheker yisna tzaddik. hatztzaddik sone devar sheker, aval harasha mekabbelo:
Yavish veyachpir. et habberiyyot bechach:
targum: Milta deshikra sane tzadika verashia nivhat venechpar:

rashi: Al hashshamayim. letzad hashshamayim. umidrash aggada: higbiho hakkabba lemoshe lemala min hashshamayim:

Terem tirun. adayin lo tirun; vechen kol terem shebbammikra "adayin lo" hu, veeno leshon kodem, "terem yishkavu" (Bereshit 19) – ad la shechivu, "terem yitzmach" (sham 2) – ad la tzemach. af ze chen hu – yadati ki adayin enchem yereim, umishshettihye harvacha taamdu bekilkulechem:
ohc: Veatta vaavadecha vegomer. hizkir haavadim, leheyot sheraa ki lo samu libbam el devar Adonai vehinnichu avdehem umiknehem bassade shittefam yachad. veim tomar mi gilla lemoshe sheachar makkat habbarad odam bemirdam velo nichneu, vahalo hitzdiku alehem et haddin achar kach veamru "Adonai hatztzaddik vaani veammi harshaim"? kevar katavti lecha shehashshem hiskilo ki yavi makkat bechorot al hammitzriyyim, gam kefi ma shepperashti befasuk (Shemot 7:4) "velo yishma alechem paro" sheyyaggia et shello yirtze od lishmoa afillu hashshelichut mehem, im ken mizze yada moshe shehagam sheyyechdelu hammatar vegomer lo yeshallechu et haam veamar lahem "yadati" vegomer. od yitbaer besamuch ki yeshno letaam shemmimmennu amar "terem tirun".

Yadati ki terem tirun. perush, yodea ani ki kodem shettistallek hammakka attem yereim et Adonai veomrim "Adonai hatztzaddik" vegomer, aval achar kelot hammakka vetiru harevacha tosifu limrod kevattechilla, uchevar nahagta ken immi shettaskim al shilluach haam kodem kelot hammakka veachar kelot tachbid libbecha.

Od yirtze lehodio ki yodea hu ki divrehem lo arma vetachbula kede sheyyitratztze moshe lehitpallel baadam, ella millibbam pachad verahav levavam meAdonai elohim, veyesh baze hodaa lahem ki yodea hu machshevot adam vetachbulotav, vedavar ze yassigehu paro beatzmo ki tzedek bimin moshe. gam hodio baze ki yodea hu ki en ze ella terem kelot hammakka lo achare chen kesheyyire harevacha yimrod, vegam ze yedaehu levassof shehagam sheyyishtaddel lehachechish nevuato velishloach yisrael lo yimshol berucho, vehaven:

rashi: Vehifla. vehivdil:

Ki afilot henna. meucharot, vaadayin hayu rakkot vicholot laamod bifne kashe; veaappi shenneemar "veet kol esev hassade hikka habbarad", yesh lefaresh peshuto shel mikra baasavim haomdim bekilcham, haruyim lilkot babbarad. uvemidrash rabbi tanchuma yesh merabbotenu shennechleku al zot, vedarshu ki afilot, pile felaot naasu lahem shello laku:

Beyom hahu atzmiach keren. lo shamati velo matzati perush mikra ze ma hu tzemach karnam shel yisrael bemappelet mitzrayim, shehare yisrael galu shemone shanim lifne mappelet mitzrayim. veomer ani beyom hahu musav al parasha shel mala, mikketz arbaim shana akabbetz et mitzrayim, veoto cheshbon kala beshana shemmalach belshatztzar, umatzinu bedaniyyel shebbeotah shana hitchilu malche paras lehitchazzek venigzera mappala al bavel, shenneemar (Daniel 7:1) "bishnat chada levelshatztzar daniyyel chelem chaza vegomer kadmita kearye hi bavel", uchetiv (sham) "chaze havet ad di meritu gappa vegomer vaaru cheva ochari tinyana damya ledov", hi paras, uchetiv "vechen amrin la kumi achuli besar saggi", kelomar tifsi hammelucha, umalchut paras hi tzemichat keren leyisrael, shenneemar bechoresh "hu yivne iri vegaluti yeshalleach" (Yeshayahu 45:13). uminnayin shearbaim shana shel mitzrayim kalu beoto happerek? mitzrayim nittena beyad nevuchadnetztzar beesrim vasheva linvuchadnetztzar, beshana shenneemra nevua zo lichezkel, hosif arbaim shana, hare shishshim vesheva, tze mehem arbaim vechamesh linvuchadnetztzar, veesrim veshalosh leevil merodach, kidamrinan bemassechet megilla (11:), veshana achat mehem alta laze velaze, kidamrinan hatam shanim mekuttaot hayu:
Ulecha etten pitchon pe betocham. lecha yechezkel yehe pitchon pe kesheyyiru nevuatcha mitkayyemet:
targum: Beyoma hahu ayte furekan levet yisrael velach etten miftach puma binvua venehon veyedun are ana Adonai:

rashi: Hu aharon umoshe. ellu shehuzkeru lemala, sheyyalda yocheved leamram. hu aharon umoshe. yesh mekomot shemmakdim aharon lemoshe veyesh mekomot shemmakdim moshe leaharon, lomar lecha sheshshekulin keechad:
Al tzivotam. betzivotam, kol tzevaam leshivtehem; yesh al sheeno ella vimkom ot achat, "veal charbecha tichye" (Bereshit 27), kemo becharbecha, "amadtem al charbechem" (Yechezkel 33) – becharbechem:
ohc: Hu aharon umoshe. perush, hameyuchasim bapparasha, hem asher amar Adonai lahem hotziu. perush, letzad sheyyesh beyadam yecholet lehotzi, shehem malche paro melech mitzrayim uvene yisrael kemo shepperesh bappasuk "vaytzavvem", laze amar Adonai lahem hotziu et bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim, vechol hamemaen yakkuhu beshevet musar asher hechin Adonai legev kesilim.

rashi: Nasati et yadi. harimotiha lehishshava bechisi:
ohc: Veheveti vegomer. kashe, ki divre el elyon devaro tahor hu, ki yotze mitzrayim hem hannichnasim laaretz, dichtiv: "veheveti etchem el haaretz", velo matzinu shekken haya, ella veet benehem hevi shamma, aval kol dor yotze mitzrayim mibben esrim shana naflu pigrehem bammidbar. vetigdal hakkushya lema sheamarnu shennishba Adonai al kol haddevarim beamro "lachen", veamru zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 6,4) en "lachen" ella leshon shevua.

Venire ki mekor hachachma nitchakkem al kushya zo, vekodem amro veheveti etchem vegomer, amar vidatem ki ani Adonai hammotzi vegomer, perush tenay hu haddavar uvaze "veheveti" vegomer, vezulat ze im tenaatzu Adonai en kan havetacha zo. vaasher al ken katav perat ze shel yediat Adonai vegomer beemtza havetachot hattovot, velo icher velo hikdim, lomar ad kan hu bishvua belo tenay, aval perat ze shel havaatam laaretz tenay hu haddavar "vidatem" vegomer, az "heveti", vezulat ze yihye ma sheyyihye.

rashi: Vayhi beesrim vesheva shana. lemalchut nevuchadnetztzar, otah shana nittena mitzrayim beyado, kach shaninu beseder olam (seder olam Rabba 26); veyesh bassefer hazze harebe nevuot ketuvot mukdam umeuchar:
targum: Vahava beasrin usheva shenin bekadmaa bechad leyarcha hava pitgam nevua min kodam Adonai imi lememar:

rashi: Vaera. el haavot:
Beel shadday. hivtachtim havetachot uvechullan amarti lahem ani el shadday:
Ushemi Adonai lo nodati lahem. lo hodati en ketiv kan ella lo nodati, lo nikkarti lahem bemidat amittut shelli, shealeha nikra shemi Adonai, neeman leammet devaray, shehare hivtachtim velo kiyyamti:
ohc: Vaera el avraham vegomer. taam shehizkiram bifratut, letzad shekkol echad yesh bo bechina meulla. el avraham shennitalla letzad shehu asher hikkir et boro techilla mibbeli sheyyakdim elav davar mimmennu yitbarach, ki halo timtza kol mi shekkadam lo yedia mehabbore mimmaasav vehanehagato im beruav en leshabbeach oto kesheyyelech bederech bachar lo yah, ki chol maskil yivchar battov uvifrat battov hashshalem vehearev vehammufla hu derech Adonai, ma sheen ken avraham, ki davak baAdonai kodem sheyyukkar etzlo middotav yitbarach vehanehagato, uchevar katavti ki leavraham lemana sheyyikreu lo (Yeshayahu 41:8) ohavo shel makom, perush ahavat haemet ahavat hattov, ki hagam sheadayin lo hikkir mimmennu ella hannisyonot haggedolot, af al pi chen davak baAdonai vaahavo uchemo shekkatavnu bimkomo.
El yitzchak. shehayta bo bechina acheret, sheppashat tzavvaro al gabbe hammizbeach.
Veel yaakov. shehaya shalem, shello yatzta mimmennu tippa meusa keyishmael veesav.

Vehakkavvana baze, shelchol 3 hadderagot hatztzaddikim bechire olam lo nigleti alehem ella beel shadday, shehu gilluy haddarga lematta mehaddargat gilluy shennitgalla lemoshe shehu beshem Adonai, keamro "ani Adonai", vehakkavvana baze lehodio ki hu kafuy betovato shel makom shekkol kach hechshivo mehaavot vehu medabber lefanav bemiut derech eretz.

Vahagam shemmatzinu sheamar binvuat haavot gam ken (Bereshit 18:1) "vayyera elav Adonai", middevar Adonai kan atta lamed ki hakkatuv sham yaggid shennigla lahem Adonai, aval lo hissigu ladaat ulehakkir bechina zo hanniflaa, vehu amro ushemi Adonai lo nodati lahem, perush shello nitvaddea lahem bechina zo haelyona.

Od yirtze beamro ushemi Adonai lo nodati vegomer, perush: hodaat yichud shene shemot yachad shehem shemi Adonai shennodati lecha, keamro "vaydabber elohim ani Adonai", vehu sod amro (Melachim 1 18:39) "Adonai hu haelohim", vehu sod amro (Zecharya 14:9) "Adonai echad ushemo echad". lo nodati lahem lehaavot, perush: sod shene shemot yachad, shemi, Adonai, shehem elohim havaya, shehaddin yease rachamim verachamim yeasu mishpat – lo nodati, vehaven. veamar "lo nodati" ki Adonai baruch hu hu shemo ushemo hu, veeno kishar hannivraim shechalukim mishshemam ushemam chaluk mehem, asher al ken lo yitzdak lomar "lo hodati" ki hashshem hu hamedabber, veim ken tzarich lomar lo nodati.

Od yitbaer amro beel shadday ushemi vegomer, al derech ma sheppershu besefer hazzohar hakkadosh (Zohar 10 23.) befasuk "vaamartem ko lechay", ki middat "ko" hi bechinat hahechol shehu shechinato yitbarach, veyichudah hu chay haolam, veze bechinat yichud katan. veachar kach chazar leyached yichud elyon veamar "veatta shalom", remez lemakom gavoah shehu tiferet yisrael haramuz beVav. veulay ki hen hen haddevarim hanneemarim kan beamro beel shadday, shezze hu bechinat chay, aval ushemi Adonai shehu yichud haelyon haramuz betevat "veatta" sheggilla lemoshe beamro vaydabber elohim vegomer ani Adonai, lo nodati lahem vegomer, vehaven:

Od yirtze, ki ba haadon baruch hu lehashiv lemoshe al sheshshelacho kodem hakketz, veamar ki hagam shessam ketz lachoshech latzet bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim vehakketz adayin lo nishlam, yesh lecha ladaat ki hakketz sheasiti lehaavot hu bechinat el shadday, uvo samti laggalut gevul veamarti lo day, aval bechina acheret lo nodati, perush lo amarti lahem hakketz sheyyihye beemtzaut harachamim im yevakkeshu viorru rachamim, kemo sheasu yisrael shebbikshu mimmenni rachamim vayyidpeku al dalte harachamim kodem hakketz, "lo nodati lahem". velachen hagam shello shalmu yeme hainnuy vehatztzara, af al pi chen richamti alehem bemiddat havaya, vehu amro bitchilla ani Adonai, vehaven.

Od yirtze al ze hadderech: vaera el avraham – perush, ech alim rachamim meam ze asher hem banay bechunay shennigleti al avotam, velo leechad bilvad ella lishloshet haavot, lechol echad bizmanno. velaze hifsik benehem "el avraham el yitzchak veel yaakov", velo amar "el avraham veyitzchak veyaakov", veze yaggid shevach kol echad bifne atzmo beel shadday, hu chibbat gilluy shechina. veamro ushemi Adonai lo nodati lahem – perush, adayin lo hodati middat rachamay lahem, shekkol hahavtachot shehivtachtim adayin lo heveti alehem, vaani chafetz lehodia lahem middat rachamay ki lahem yeotu. venitkavven Adonai baze lehodia godel chibbatam beenav.

rashi: Velo yihye. mitzrayim levet yisrael od lemivtach hammazkir lahem avon, sheamar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu: "lo tosifu lirotam od" (Shemot 14:13):
targum: Vela yehon od levet yisrael leitrachatza alehon leadkera chovin beafnayutehon batrehon veyedun are ana Adonai elohim:

rashi: Leavdi leyaakov. kemo shennetanah leyaakov nachala belo metzarim, "ufaratzta yamma vakedma tzafona vanegba" (Bereshit 28:14):
targum: Kidnan amar Adonai elohim kad achnash yat bet yisrael mibbene ammaya deitbadaru letaman veitkadesh behon leene ammaya vituvun al arahon dihavit leavdi leyaakov:

rashi: Etzba elohim hiv. makka zo enah al yede cheshafim, meet hammakom hi (Shemot Rabba):
Kaasher dibber Adonai. velo yishma alechem paro:

ohc: Vayyaas moshe vegomer ken asu. tzarich ledakdek lamma kafal lomar kaasher tzivva vegomer ken asu, velo hispik hakkatuv beachat mehenna. venire sheyyechavven lomar sheasu hashshelichut kaasher amar lahem Adonai bishte haderagot: haachat, shekkol ma shehissigu hevin bedivre Adonai ken asu, vehashsheniyya, shennitkavvenu el amittut haddevarim bishlemut. veze hu shiur hakkatuv "vayyaas moshe vegomer kaasher tzivva" vegomer velo shinnu davar, vechozer hakkatuv umeid veomer kaasher tzivva Adonai otam perush, ma shennitkavven Adonai bemitzvato lahem ken asu, vehaven.

Od yirtze lomar, ki chol maase moshe veaharon lo hayta lesibbat emtzaut shum davar, ella kaasher tzivva otam Adonai, vehu al derech amro (Devarim 6:25) "utzedaka tihye lanu vegomer kaasher tzivvanu", veamro ken asu hu al guf hammaase shello haya beshum shinnuy.

Od yirtze, sheal kol dibbur vedibbur hayu mazkirin shem shamayim, vehu amro asu, uvishat maase amru "kaasher" vegomer. od yirtze lomar, shello hayu mitakkevim baddavar, ella techef umiyyad bechalloto letzauot otam Adonai hayu nechpazim laasot devar Adonai.

Lemor bo dabber vegomer. amro lemor perush sheyyomar elav ki hu amar lo bo dabber, veamro vishallach betosefet vav hagam shello kadam lo davar, letzad sheshshelichut moshe ledabber lefaro hu inyan gadol ledabber hedyot lifne melech, veod lo sheyyedabber elav devarim hannokvim libbo lehotzi balo mippiv.

Od yirtze lomar elav, ki lo millevad sheim yetzu meatzman lo yeakkev al yadam, ella shetztzarich hu beatzmo leshallecham gam ken veyomar lahem "kumu tzeu". od yirtze shemmavticho sheyyedabber uvevadday sheyyeshallach vegomer levassof.

Bo el paro. kelal ze beyadcha – kol makom sheyyomar "bo el paro" yechavven lomar lo sheyyikkanes el teraklin shello belo hashealat reshut, hagam shehayu lo kemishpat hammelachim shomre habbayit, af al pi chen yeol veyikkanes etzlo mibbeli sheelat reshut. vechen haya ose, keamram zichronam livracha (yalkut shemauni 175) ki kamma shomrim hayu lefaro mezuyyanim vaarayot uchelavim, vehaya nichnas been monea. umatzati reaya berura ledivrehem zichronam livracha mimma sheamar paro lemoshe (Shemot 10:28) "hishshamer lecha vegomer al tosef reot panay" vegomer – lamma hutzrach paro lehaterot bemoshe? vehaya lo letzauot laavadav shomre habbayit, ki chen minhag hammelachim lehaamid shomre hammelech velahem yetzav shello yannichuhu likkanes. ella vadday ki lo amdu kenegdo vaafillu arayot, veze nes atzum. laze haya Adonai tzarich lomar lo: "bo el paro", perush, hikkanes vaale elav velo tasim libbecha lemonea baolam. uvizman shehaya paro yotze hammayma, haya omer lo "lech el paro", ki sham en shomrim liro mehem lehitztarech lomar elav "ale elav", ella letzad sheen zeman ze rauy lahalicha, ki hu motzi bolo hattauv veeno mehammusar, laze omer lo "lech" af al pi chen.

Lo tarchiku lalechet. perush, keshiur shelosha yamim, ki kelum taam sheamar moshe hu "hen nizbach vegomer velo yiskelunu", im ken lamma yitztarchu leharechik derech sheloshet yamim, beharechakat parsa o yoter ketzat day. vetaam shennitratztza lo moshe, kevan shekkol atzmenu en anu mishtaddelim ella latzet mehair, ma li bitnao yom o yomayim, vechi yirdof tirdefehu raa ugezerato omedet leummato. laze lo ratza moshe ledakdek bitnay hazzeman veamar "rak al yosef paro hatel levilti shallach" beeze ofen sheyyihye, vedikdek lomar "rak" leshon miut, lomar hagam sheyyihye hashshelichut bitnay pachot mishshelosha yamim.

rashi: Chomarim chomarim. tzibburim tzibburim, ketargumo, degorin – gallin:
Vayyomer lemachar. hitpallel hayyom, sheyyikkartu lemachar:
ohc: Veheshivo paro lemachar vegomer, vekashe, ki hagam ki nefesh rasha ivveta ra (Mishlei 21:10) – ze davka bedavar sheen haraut nikkar laadam ella bammusekol, aval kazo vechaze en lecha adam sheyyachpotz sheyyitakkev besakkanat mavet, kemo shekken keraah hu: "veyaser mealay et hammavet". vehaya nire lomar ki liroto zerizuto shel moshe sheamar "lematay atir" vegomer, hitattu en sichlo ki amar ken moshe letzad shehikkir ki karav zeman ketz hammakka veen od meaz vahala shelita lelohe haivrim vehammakka kalta meeleha, veheerim chas veshalom moshe letzad sheamar bedato ki chafotz yachpotz paro lemaher ulehasir hannega, laze amar "hitpaer", umin hassetam yomar baet uvaona hazzot, laze saval tzaar oto zeman lehakkir haddavar im mirma achaz veamar "lemachar".

Ella shekkefi darkenu en anu tzerichin laze, ki ratza livchon hitpaarut moshe sheamar sheyyitpallel veyatne bitfillato al elohav sheyyishma tefillato atta velo yaase ki im lemachar, veen midda zo afillu beoved lechochav umazzal. veamar lemachar perush sheyyitpallel achshav veyomar bitfillato ki lemachar yasir vegomer, nitkavven harasha lehagedil hannissayon sheyyitpallel lehasir velo yasir ad lemachar. veheshiv moshe al ze veamar kidvarcha naase lemaan teda ki en chaAdonai elohenu sheyyekabbel tefillatenu bitnaeha, al derech amro (Devarim 4:7) "ki mi vegomer chaAdonai elohenu bechol karenu elav", velaze techef umiyyad yatza vehitpallel laAdonai. veen lachush velomar ki bamme yeammet paro et haddavar shehitpallel az velo lemachar beet hatztzorech, hinne letzad shello haya mitpallel toch hakkerach hayu yodim zeman tefillato uchesheyyatza beoto yom velo lemachar hinne haot tzodek, vehu amro vayyetze moshe vegomer meim paro vayyitzak moshe vegomer perush tzaak shene devarim: haechad lahasiram vehashsheni lahasiram lemachar velo kodem, velaze dikdek lomar "al devar hatztzefardeim", velo amar "vayyitzak vegomer lehasir hatztzefardeim", sheaz yihye nishma shettefillato hayta al hahasara levad belo tenay hazzeman, "vayyaas Adonai kidvar moshe", perush, bazzeman sheamar lo, "vayyasar" vegomer.

rashi: Vaydabber elohim el moshe. dibber itto mishpat, al shehiksha ledabber velomar "lama hareota laam hazze":

Vayyomer elav ani Adonai. neeman leshallem sachar tov lammithallechim lefanay, velo lechinnam shelachticha ki im lekayyem devari sheddibbarti laavot harishonim. uvallashon hazze matzinu shehu nidrash bechamma mekomot ani Adonai neeman lehippara – keshehu amur etzel onesh – kegon "vechillalta et shem elohecha ani Adonai" (Vayikra 19:12), ucheshehu omer etzel kiyyum mitzvot – kegon "ushemartem mitzvotay vaasitem otam ani Adonai" (sham 22) – neeman litten sachar:
ohc: Vaydabber elohim vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma dibber elohim, gam hodaat "ani Adonai" achar shekkevar amar lo lemala zichron hashshem, veamar lo (Shemot 3:15) "ze shemi leolam".

Achen leheyot sheddibber moshe lifne el nora veayom devarim sheenam mehammusar, uvifrat lifne melech gadol, vedavar ze nimshach letzad shehera lo panim tzochakot panim semechot harshumim beshem 26, laze herahu Adonai panim shel mora shehem bechinat haddin harshumim beshem elohim, vehu amro "vaydabber elohim el moshe". veshiur amro vaydabber elohim hu ki hakkatuv yaggid shehaya Adonai medabber kol haddevarim haamurim bapparasha bivchinat shem elohim, shehem panim hammafchidim umaridim et hannidbar elav.

Veamro vayyomer elav ani Adonai, perush, al derech amram (berachot 30:) bimkom gila sham tehe reada, nitkavven lomar lo ki hagam ki herahu middat harachamim bedabbero immo, lo mippene ze yasir masve happachad vidabber belo mora malchut shamayim, veze lecha haot ki Adonai hu haelohim shehare hu medabber immo befanim hannoraim, vehaven:

Od yirtze al ze hadderech: vaydabber elohim – perush, dibber itto mishpat, uma hu hammishpat? ki teano taana hannishmaat. veamar "ani Adonai" – perush, ech atta meyaches li midda raa bar minan vetomar elay "lama hareota", vahalo ani Adonai umiddati middat hachesed veharachamim vetov ani lakkol. uchemo shekken amar hannavi (Eicha 3:38): "mippi elyon lo tetze haraot" ki im hattovot. uma sheamar sham "vehattov" hu al bechinat perat tov echad shehu lihyot adam tzaddik, lo yigzor Adonai davar ken ella beyad kol adam livchor battov. vetimtza shebbechol paam sheyyazkir Adonai zichron tashlum hara leose risha yedakdek lomar (Shmuel 1 24:14) "ki mershaim yetze resha", vechen hu omer (yirmeya 2:19) "teyasserech raatech", (yeshaya 64:6) "vattemugenu beyad avonenu", (Iyov 8:4) "vayshallechem beyad pisham". ma sheen ken hattov (tehillim 85:13) "Adonai yitten hattov", (tehillim 145:9) "tov Adonai lakkol". umeatta lu yihye sheavra tzara al yisrael, mi yodea im hayu chayyavin ken vaavonam garam, o letzad hakkodem letashlum gezerat hainnuy, o letzad ketzat mehem shello heeminu karauy vechaddome. vehinnecha roe ki hazzekenim chazru laachorehem velo halchu im moshe lifne paro, keamram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 5), vehikpid Adonai alehem, beofen ki mehem yatza lahem davar ze. veech hotzi mippiv devarim nachrim lomar "lama hareota"?

Od yirtze al ze hadderech: leheyot sheamar moshe "lama hareota, lamma shelachtani" baa hatteshuva – keneged "lama hareota" dibber itto kashot, sheddibber lifne elohav belo derech kavod, vehelim hakkatuv haddevarim letzad kevodo shel moshe. o efshar sheamar lo sheyyaamidennu bammishpat al ze beet mishpat, ucheneged "lamma shelachtani" heshiv "vayyomer elav ani Adonai" – perush: rachman ani, laze lo yacholti lisbol reot yisrael betzaar ad et ketz, vehikdamti leshalchacha kodem haggaat hakketz lehakel meal yisrael hatztzara shel haggalut. uteshuva zo enah tzodeket ella achar shehikdim lomar lo "atta tire", ki techef umiyyad yafli pele befaro makkot niflaot, vetechef nistallek hashshibud.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 3,6) befasuk "motzi asirim bakkosharot" – bechi lemitzrayim veshirot leyisrael, vehem shete middot: middat haddin umiddat rachamim. velaze amar hakkatuv, keneged ma shehechin ladun et hammitzriyyim amar vaydabber elohim shehu bechinat haddin, ucheneged ma sheratza lehetiv leyisrael amar vayyomer elav ani Adonai. uvichlal ze ramaz lo ki hammakkot haggedolot hammuchanot lavo al hammitzriyyim, hagam sheyyavou derech kelal al kol mitzrayim veyisrael netunim netunim hemma betocham, vedavar yadua ki en hammashchit mavchin umechabbel hakkol, uvifrat bevo hachoshech haddaat notenet ki bevadday ki yachshich derech kelal lechol yoshve aretz. laze amar ki erech haddinim harmuzim beshem elohim asher hechin Adonai lehashekot et hammitzriyyim teshammesh middat harachamim leerech yisrael, vehu amro "ani Adonai". vechen hu omer (Shemot 10:23) "ulechol bene yisrael haya or", (Shemot 9:6) "umimmikne yisrael lo met" vegomer.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 33,3) ki harshaim mehappechim middat harachamim lemiddat haddin, vehu atzmo sheamar hakkatuv kan ki gam middat harachamim hiskima laasot din bemitzrayim, veze hu shiur hakkatuv vaydabber elohim shehu kinnuy ledin, vayyomer elav vegomer ani modiacha ki middat haddin zo hi mishshem havaya sheggam harachamim nithappechu alehem ledin.

Od yirmoz gam ken keneged yisrael al derech amram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 33,2) ashrehem hatztzaddikim shemhappechim middat haddin lemiddat rachamim, vehu amro vaydabber elohim vayyomer vegomer, perush middat haddin zo sheatta roe naaset rachamim hammitkannet beshem havaya, umizze yachlit moshe bedato ki nechtam gezar din raat paro afillu behasekamat harachamim, venechtam gezar din tovat yisrael afillu bemiddat haddin, uvaze techezakna yadav bashshelichut.

Od yirtze lehashiv al ma shettaan moshe lamma lo kinne Adonai, veamar elohim ani, vehu amro vaydabber elohim perush sheddibber elav ki hu elohim umevi bammishpat al hakkol veet paro yishpot mishpat shalem, vetaam shello miher, "vayyomer elav ani Adonai", veshem ze yesh bo middot harshumim 13 middot harachamim veachat mehem hu erech appayim, sheeno memaher lifroa larshaim befoal kappehem.

Od yirtze al ze hadderech: vaydabber elohim – umiddat din ze baa keneged hashshaliach shehu moshe, sheddibber lifne Adonai shello kederech hammusar, aval keneged hammishtalleach alehem shehem yisrael – "vayyomer elav ani Adonai".

Od yirtze al ze hadderech: vaydabber elohim el moshe – yashav alav baddin, "vayyomer elav ani Adonai" – perush, hagam shetztzarich ladun otcha, elecha ani noheg middat harachamim. vehu sheddiyyek lomar "elav ani Adonai", vehattaam al derech amram zichronam livracha (rosh hashshana 17.) lemi nose avon – lemi sheover al pesha. veyadua hu ki moshe anav meod umaavir al middotav yoter mikkol hannivraim, laze nahag Adonai immo bemidda zo venasa avono shehaya rauy lavo immo bemishpat alav, vehu amro "ani Adonai" veramaz lemiddat "nose avon", veen kan mishpat elav.

Od ramaz Adonai sod amro "Adonai hu haelohim" (Melachim 1 18:39), vehu amro "vaydabber elohim vayyomer vegomer ani Adonai", veze hu gilluy yichud Adonai asher gilla Adonai sodo el avdo nevio neeman beto:

rashi: Toavat mitzrayim. yirat mitzrayim, kemo "ulemilkom toavat bene ammon" (Melachim 2 23:13), veetzel yisrael kore otah toeva; veod yesh lomar belashon acher, toavat mitzrayim, davar sanouy hu lemitzrayim zevicha sheanu zovchim, shehare yiratam anu zovchim:
Velo yiskelunu. bitmiha:
Veech yishmaeni faro. ze echad measara kal vachomer shebbattora (Bereshit Rabba 92):

Aral sefatayim. atum sefatayim; vechen kol leshon arla ani omer shehu atum, "arela aznam" (Yirmeyahu 6) – atuma mishshemoa, "arle lev" (sham 9) – atumim mehavin, "shete gam atta vehearel" (Chavakuk 2) – veheatem mishshichrut kos hakkelala, "arlat basar" – shehaggid atum umechusse vah, "vaaraltem arlato" (Vayikra 19) – asu lo otem uchesuy issur sheyyavdil bifne achilato, "shalosh shanim yihye lachem arelim" (sham) – atum umechusse umuvdal milleachlo:
ohc: Lifne Adonai lemor hen vegomer. kashe amro lemor, ki lemi yomar Adonai divre moshe? veulay sheyyechavven hakkatuv lomar ki lo heshiv moshe teshuva zo leval yelech bishlichut ze, ella kemi shemmitlonen al atzmo shello hitzliach, vehu amro tevat lemor, perush, sheen tachlit haddibbur ella haamira, lo tachlit zulatah shehi meniat hashshelichut, vehaven.

Od yirtze, ki kavvanat devarav hem lomar amira acheret, vehi muvenet mehaddibbur meamro "hen bene vegomer vaani aral sefatayim", rotze lomar baze ki yihye Adonai rofehu, veayyen befasuk "hen bene" vegomer:

Hen bene yisrael vegomer. kal vachomer ze yitzdak lefi ma shepperashti befasuk "mikkotzer ruach", shehem divre tora, yishpot betzedek moshe kal vachomer, ki lo chashav ki ze gorem. veim nomar ki moshe gam ken yada ki taam shello shamu hu letzad kotzer ruach, yihye hakkal vachomer mufrach.

Veulay ki yishpot kal vachomer al ze hadderech, shehagam ki bene yisrael hem bekotzer ruach, yesh bahem gam ken shete bechinot: haachat shehem baale emuna umakkirim malchut shamayim, vehashsheniyya shehabbesora hi besora tova vaatzuma. ushete ellu enam befaro, ki hu kafar baikkar veamar "mi Adonai" chas veshalom, vegam devarim hammachhim et enav vehannokvim et libbo. veim ken kal vachomer nachon hu, uma bene yisrael sheyyesh bahem shete middot hannizkarim lo hitta Adonai levavam lishmoa velo shamu mitztzad taam kol shehu sheyyesh lahem kotzer ruach, veech yishma paro sheyyesh lo shete sibbot monot mimmennu hashshemia, sheeno maamin kol ikkar vehem devarim shechonkim oto, peshita shello yishma hagam sheeno ketzur ruach. shekkotzer ruach shel paro bedivre moshe vegam bedivre hameshalleach hu yoter mikkatzrut ruach shel yisrael, veillu haya koach bedivre moshe lehacheriach lefaro lishmoa elav, mikkol shekken shehayu bene yisrael shomim elav hagam heyotam bekotzer ruach. vehu amro lemor hen vegomer, perush, hagam sheyyesh lehakeshot ma livne yisrael vechulei, halo yesh gam ken lemor lehacheria habbenaya hahu kannizkar.

Veamro vaani aral vegomer, perush: veod bah atziriyya ki hu aral sefatayim, veyomar paro: im elohe haivrim shallit vechol yachol, lamma lo rippe et moshe?, uveerech inyan ze gam ken yishtanne paro miyyisrael, lihyoto chasar haemuna bechol shehu yenasse leharechik haemuna ulehachzivah chas veshalom.

Od yirtze, letzad sheddikdek Adonai bidvarav sheamar lo befarashat shemot (Shemot 4:16) al aharon "vedibber hu lecha el haam", mikkan atta lamed ki en aharon lo lefe ella el haam velo lefaro. vechen timtza sheamar hakkatuv (Shemot 4:30) bishlichut rishona el haam "vaydabber aharon et kol haddevarim asher dibber Adonai el moshe", uvedabberam lefaro amar (Shemot 5:1) "vayyomru el paro", muchach ki moshe yedabber. vetaam amro "vayyomru" leshon rabbim, ken mishpat kol shenayim sheechad medabber veechad maskim yechashvu ki shenehem dibberu. veim tomar kallech lederech ze, aharon dibber umoshe hiskim – mimma sherainu sheddikdek hakkatuv lomar bedibbur el haam "vaydabber aharon" bediyyuk, gam bedivre Adonai matzinu shello amar ella "vedibber hu lecha el haam", ze yaggid ki haddevarim yatzdiku lanu. uchefi ze hacheraat tzad kal vachomer hu amro "vaani aral sefatayim", ki bechina zo enah ella befaro ki moshe yedabber, ma sheen ken el haam ki aharon hu hamedabber. veulay ki laze dikdek lomar beerech yisrael tevat elay uveerech paro amar yishmaeni, ki yisrael enam shomim mippiv mammash ella mippi aharon, aval paro haya shomea mimmoshe atzmo. ushemor lecha perat ze lehavin imre kadosh besamuch.

rashi: Hatel. kemo lehatel:
Mashliach becha. megare vecha, vechen "veshen behemot ashallach bam" (Devarim 32), leshon shissuy, 370 belaaz:

Et hearov. kol mine hachayyot raot unechashim veakrabbim beirbuveya, vehayu mashchitim bahem; veyesh taam baddavar baaggada bechol makka umakka lamma zo velamma zo; betachsise milchamot melachim ba alehem, keseder malchut keshetztzara al ir, battechilla mekalkel mayenoteha, veachar kach tokin alehem umeriin bashshofarot leyaram ulevahalam, vechen hatzefardeim mekarkerim vehomim vechulei, kidita bemidrash rabbi tanchuma (80 ba):
ohc: Umalu vatte mitzrayim et hearov. taam shechazar lomar paam sheniyya et hearov velo samach al hearov shehizkir samuch lah, nitkavven lomar shehabbattim yimmalu mehearov, veim lo haya omer "et hearov" yihye nishma al ze hadderech: "umilu hearov et batte mitzrayim", uchefi ze ze hu tachlit hammakka sheyyemalleu hearov battehem levad, velo chen hu, ella mittechilla amar mashliach becha vegomer, perush, lachavol ulehashchit, veod amar sheyyimmalu habbattim mehearov, vehaven.

O yomar, im lo haya omer "et hearov", vehayinu mefarshim "umilu hearov et batte mitzrayim", haya bannishma ki ze gevul ribbuyam ad sheyyihye bahem geder ze sheyyemalleu hem et habbattim, velo chen hu, ki rabbim hem hearov veyitmalleu habbattim mehem velo mikkullam, veze hu sheamar hakkatuv bahavaat hammakka "uvechol eretz mitzrayim" vegomer.

Hashekem babboker vegomer. shalosh mitzvot nitztavva: 1 sheyyelech behashekama, 2 sheyyityatztzev lefanav, perush, shello yarkin rosho velo yarkin komato kederech haomdim lifne gedolim, ella kegadol haomed lifne katan, ki kevar asao ribbon veshallit alav. vehutzerach letzauoto letzad shemmittivo shel moshe leharekin rosho meat kederech hashshefalim, laze amar ki lifne paro lo yitnaheg ken. od ramaz lo ki perat ze sheomer lo "hityatztzev", lo bechol makom yasir mealav hahachnaa haragil bah, ella lifne paro, aval yihye belibbo anav veshafal lifne el elyon, veyihye nitztzav begufo velibbo muchena meemat melo chol haaretz kevodo, umitzva 3 "veamarta elav" vegomer.

rashi: Vayhi beyom dibber vegomer. mechubbar lammikra shelleacharav:
ohc: Vayhi beyom dibber Adonai vegomer. perush, ma sheatta roe ki shave aharon lemoshe bechol perate davar ze, haya letzad ki beyom asher dibber vegomer beeretz mitzrayim. perush, lishlol dibbur rishon shehaya bammidbar sheamar lo Adonai (Shemot 4:14) "halo aharon achicha" vegomer, ki sham adayin lo hishva hakkatuv aharon lemoshe bishlichut mitzva zo, ad sheddibber Adonai im moshe beeretz mitzrayim, vehu amro beyom dibber vegomer beeretz mitzrayim.

Vechazar hakkatuv lomar ofen haddibbur sheddibber Adonai im moshe beeretz mitzrayim, vehu amro vaydabber Adonai el moshe lemor ani Adonai dabber el paro vegomer, perush "lemor" sheddikdek lomar lo "ani Adonai", vehakkavvana baze shettismoch al devaray vetelech bishlichuti utedabber atta beatzmecha el paro kol asher vegomer. vetimtza sheddibbur ze shel "ani Adonai" haya beeretz mitzrayim, dichtiv (Shemot 6:2) "vayyomer elav ani Adonai" – ze haya bemitzrayim, veamar lo sheyyelech hu vidabber el paro, lo aharon. vahagam shekkevar shittef Adonai immo aharon, hinne bearti hetev sham bimkomo sheaharon yedabber el haam, aval lefaro adayin Adonai chafetz sheyyedabber moshe, veritztza oto beamro ani Adonai velo tachush leshum davar. velo ratza moshe laasot ken, vechazar vetaan hen ani aral sefatayim veech yishmaeni paro. hinne dikdek hakkatuv lomar shettaanat aral sefatayim hayta letzad paro, letzad sheaharon eno medabber ad atta ella laam uchemo shekkatavnu. az amar Adonai lemoshe ree vegomer veaharon achicha yedabber el paro, perush, gam lefaro millevad haam. umeatta hushvu aharon umoshe bemitzva zo. velaze timtza shello amar Adonai lemoshe bammidbar kesheshshittef immo aharon et kol hahachanot haellu haamurim kan, vehaya lecha leot ki hem devarim chadashim kannizkar mittaam haamur.

Vehinne heranu Adonai ki hikpid Adonai al haddavar shello asao moshe, shekkol kach hishtaddel Adonai im moshe laasot hu hakkol. veulay ki laze amar hakkatuv vayhi leshon tzaar, ki hainyan yaggid ki yitron gadol haya im asa moshe hakkol, veharaya mehishtaddelut Adonai immo, uchefi ze amar "vayhi" al chesron hayyitron.

Veefshar ki laze nitkavven mesadder happarashiyyot lichtov pasuk ze "vayhi beyom" bapparasha shekkadma, uchefi haemet nikshar hu im ma shellematta kemo shepperashnu, ella nitkavven lomar ki hatztzaar haramuz betevat "vayhi" hi al asot hammitzva bishnehem yachad. veulay im haya moshe ose mitzva zo levaddo, haya mitchazzek kocho vehaya nichnas laaretz velo hayu ovrim harepatke al yisrael bammidbar. gam im haya nichnas laaretz haya bone bet habbechira vehaya omed kol hayyamim. o efshar shebbishvil chesron moshe amar leshon tzaar.

Od yechavven ma shehifsik hasseder, lomar ki chol haamur "hem asher dibber Adonai" vegomer, "hem hamedabberim" vegomer, shehem shavim bammitzva shenehem yachad – ze haya beyom dibber Adonai beeretz mitzrayim vegomer. aval kodem lachen, hagam sheamar Adonai "halo aharon" vegomer, lo hayu shavim bammitzva, ki moshe hu haya ose kol hashshelichut lefaro, ma sheen ken atta sheaharon levad hu yedabber el paro, keamro yihye neviecha vegomer yedabber el paro:

rashi: Emor el aharon. lo haya heafar keday lilkot ay moshe, lefi shehegen alav kesheharag et hammitzri vayyitmenehu bachol, velaka al yede aharon (Shemot Rabba):

ohc: Vayyasem Adonai moed lemor. perush, hodia otam zeman hammakka kede sheyyachnisu hammikne mehassadot, uchemo shemmatzinu lo sheasa bemakkat habbarad, vesham amar Adonai haddevarim meforashim dichtiv (Shemot 9:19): "shelach haez" vegomer, vechan amar haddevarim beremez, vehu ma shennitkavven lomar betevat lemor, perush, sheyyomru moshe veaharon simat moed ze lefaro velammitzriyyim ki hu tachlit hamechuvvan kemo shepperashnu.

Vehaddaga vegomer meta. hakkavvana baze lomar ki haya lahem siman bemaase ze, ki lo haya maase shedim velo maase keshafim, ki maase shenayim ellu yihyu dimyon velo mammash, vehaddimyon yihye leen haroim, lo sheyyihye mammash dam sheyyaharog kol shotav vaafillu dagim. laze amar vehaddaga vegomer meta vayyivash hayeor, veze yihye lahem leot olam ki maase elohim hemma peulla tzodeket velo dimyon. od amar vayhi haddam bechol eretz mitzrayim vegomer, ki afillu bemerchatzaot uveambataot. veulay ki yirtze od lomar shehaddam hahu shennaasa mehammayim, hagam shehayu notlim oto mimmakom ze venotnim oto bemakom acher vechozrim vechulei, vechol davar sheyyihye mimmaase shedim yevattelehu shinnuy makom, uvifrat kesheyyannichuhu baaretz kayyadua (zohar 10 192,1), uma shellefanenu haya haddam bahavayato bechol eretz mitzrayim.

rashi: Levilti redot baggoyim. leshon memshala, kemo "uredu vidgat hayyam" (Bereshit 1:28):
targum: Min malkevata tehe chalasha vela titravrev od al ammaya veazirinun bedil dela yiflechun beammaya:

rashi: Vehappishta vehasseora nukkata. nishbera, leshon "paro necho" (Melachim 2 23), "nechaim" (Yeshayahu 16), vechen lo nukku; velo yittachen lefarsho leshon hakkaa, sheen 106 bimkom hei lefaresh nukkata kemo hukkata, nukku kemo hukku, ella hannvn shoresh batteva vahare hu miggizrat "veshuppu atzmotav" (Iyov 33):
Ki hasseora aviv. kevar bikkera veomedet bekashyah, venishtabberu venaflu, vechen happishta gadla chevar, vehuksha laamod begivoleha:
Hasseora aviv. amda beibbeha, leshon "beibbe hannachal" (Shir 6):
ohc: Vehappishta vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma sidder inyan ze kodem gemar inyan tefillato shel moshe shehivtiach "ketzeti et hair" vegomer, haya lo ligmor omer ki asa moshe chen, vayyetze meet paro vehitpallel vegomer, veachar kach yodienu et asher asa habbarad.

Veulay sheyyitkavven lehasemich inyan ze leamro "terem tirun et Adonai", lirmoz hassibba asher sibbeva otam lechazzek libbam, veamar vehappishta vegomer. veamru zichronam livracha bemidrash tanchuma veze leshono: "ki afilot" pile pelaot naasu lahem shello laku, ad kan. vehinne kirot paro ki lo shalta makkat habbarad bachitta vechussemet shello kefi hatteva, keamram pile pelaot naasu lahem, hu lo yitle ki Adonai hifli, ella yitle ki en shelitat elohe yisrael bechol hove, veze yaggid chas veshalom hashshittuf veen shelita bakkol, veze haya lo makom lehachebid libbo. velaze amar moshe yadati ki terem tirun, vetamo ki happishta vegomer vehachitta vegomer lo nukku, veasa Adonai pele ze lechazzek lev paro kaasher dibber "vaani achazzek" vegomer.

rashi: Emor el aharon. lefi shehegen hayeor al moshe keshennishlach letocho, lefichach lo laka al yado lo vaddam velo vatzfardeim, velaka al yede aharon (Shemot Rabba):
Naharotam. hem neharot hammoshchim, keen neharot shellanu:
Yeorehem. hem berechot niggarim, haasuyot bide adam missefat hannahar lassadot, venilus memav mitbarchim veole derech hayeorim umashke hassadot:
Agmehem. kevutzat mayim sheenan novin veen moshchin, ella omdin bemakom echad, vekoryn lo 460:
Bechol eretz mitzrayim. af bammerchatzaot uvaambattaot shebbabbattim:
Uvaetzim uvaavanim. mayim shebbichle etz uvichle even:
Venehefchu ledam. lefi sheen geshamim yordim bemitzrayim venilus ole umashke et haaretz umitzrayim ovdim lannilus, lefichach hilka et yiratam veachakka hilka otam (tanchuma):
ohc: Bezot teda ki ani Adonai. taam shetztziyyen lo yediat Adonai beemtzaut makka zo, al derech amram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 9,9) ki nilus haya lemitzrayim leeloah, asher al ken rasham Adonai behakkaat hayeor ledam veamar "bezot teda ki ani Adonai" kesheeese mishpat katuv belohechem. vedikdek lomar ani Adonai, ki shem ze millevad sheamru zichronam livracha (zohar 11 297,1) sheyyirtze lomar haya hove veyihye, od yirtze lomar ki bemaamaro haya kol hove. vehinne kesheyyakke avdo layor yerae ki hu yitbarach hu sheasa hayeor, hu mehavvehu bechol et laasher yachpotz, vehinne hu ose bo havaya acheret vehofcho ledam.

Od ramaz lo ki mizze yeda middat rachamav yitbarach al hannivraim, birot lefanecha hayeor nehpach ledam kede shettashuv uteshalleach velo tamut, veim lo haya tzad harachamim haya makke bo umeabbedo min haolam, vekal vachomer haddevarim, uma yeor gadol mehappecho ledam, adam amgushi kemoto lo chol shekken, vehu amro bezot teda ki ani Adonai sheani mitchakkem alecha bidvarim gedolim kazo shel hakkaat elohecha kede shettaamin velo tovad:

rashi: Vaydabber Adonai el moshe veel aharon. lefi sheamar moshe ani aral sefatayim, tzeref lo hakkabba et aharon lihyot lo lefe ulemelitz:
Vaytzavvem el bene yisrael. tzivvam alehem lehanehigam benachat velisbol otam (Shemot Rabba):

Veel paro melech mitzrayim. tzivvam alav lachalok lo chavod bedivrehem, ze midrasho (sham); ufeshuto, tzivvam al devar yisrael veal shelichuto el paro; udevar hatztziuuy mahu, meforash befarasha sheniyya leachar seder hayyachas, ella mittoch shehizkir moshe veaharon, hifsik hainyan belle rashe bet avotam lelammedenu heach noldu moshe veaharon uvemi nityachasu:
