ohc: Vaydabber Adonai vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma dibber Adonai lahem. od tzarich ladaat kavvanat amro vaytzavvem el vegomer. verabbotenu zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 7,3) darshu sheyyinhag yisrael benachat vegam sheyyinhagu kavod bammalchut, veze derech derash. od kashe hechan teshuvat el elyon ledivre shelucho, uma gam shettaan taana hannishmaat, velu yehi shettaa vekal vachomer eno kal vachomer, haya lo listor devarav, vahagam shennuchal lomar ki heder hatteshuva hi hahachchasha bekal vachomer ki enennu nachon, im kol ze bema shellefanenu en anu yecholin lomar ken, behair heara achat bakkatuv sheachar ze "vaydabber Adonai" vegomer – im nomar shemma sheamar moshe "hen bene yisrael" lo chash lahashivo el elyon, im ken lamma lo ratza Adonai ledabber haddevarim hanneemarim befasuk "vaydabber" vegomer gam hatztzavvaa hallaz sheamar "vaytzavvem" ad achar dibber moshe lefanav "hen bene yisrael"?

Achen hannachon beenay ki va lahashivo al taanato shello hechshivuhu yisrael lishmoa devarav, veod lo ki letzad paro ki moshe yedabber yesh lo geraon ufechitut letzad heyoto aral sefatayim kemo shepperashti, uvaa hatteshuva al ze vaydabber Adonai el moshe veel aharon perush, hishva otam bashshelichut uvaze yedabber aharon gam lefaro ki shenehem shavim baddavar, uletzad shello yihyu nechshavim lishmoa lahem amar vaytzavvem perush himlicham al bene yisrael veal paro al derech (Shmuel 1 13:14) "vaytzavvehu Adonai lenagid", umeatta hinne moraam al yisrael veal paro.

Veamar lehotzi vegomer, perush, lesibbat perat ze hikna lahem Adonai bechinat hammalchut al yisrael leval yemaanu latzet, veal paro leval yeakkev al yadam. umikkan atta lamed sheyyesh reshut lemoshe uleaharon lirdot beish yisrael hammemaen latzet. veulay ki laze nitkavven moshe beamro "bene yisrael lo shamu elay", perush, lo ratzu latzet, ki amru "yaniach lanu ben amram bimkomenu". laze himlich Adonai et haachim limlachim alehem kannizkar, umeatta parcha lah taanat "hen bene yisrael" vegomer, ki meatta vahala mora malchut alehem veal paro, vidabber moshe elav kedabber el avdo, uchemo shekken haya. uvaze nityashshevu haddevarim al nachon.

rashi: Yocheved davedatev. achat avuhi, bat levi achot kehat:
Vesamti fedut. sheyyavdil ben ammi uven ammecha:
ohc: Vesamti fedut. perush, millevad shello yikkansu leeretz goshen, od yaase fedut afillu leyisrael shehem chutz meeretz goshen, leval kerov lahem hearov. vedikdek lomar ben ammi uven ammecha, perush, kesheyyihyu ammi veammecha omdim beshave, yaase Adonai pedut laze mibben ze, velannachri yashshich uleish yisrael lo yashshich.

rashi: Baz ledavar yechavel lo. habboze echad middivre tora, sof mitmashken alav:

Vire mitzva hu yeshullam. yekabbel sachar. umidrash tehillim doresh baz ledavar yechavel lo al david sheamar lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, ma hanaa bashshotim shebbarata? amar lo: chayyecha, sof shettitztarech leshittut; keshebba lifne achish lehishtaggea "vayyored riro al zekano vegomer" (Shmuel 1 21:14):
targum: Devaze al milta nitchabbel minah udedachel mippukedana mishtelam tavta:

rashi: Tochelet memushshacha. mavtiach atzmo al chavero veeno ose:
Machala lev. mevia choli lallev, veen machala ze shem davar kemo "vahasiroti machala mikkirbecha" (Shemot 23:25) ella kemo "maale gera" (Vayikra 11:5):

Veetz chayyim taava vaa. mesoras hu, kelomar: taava vaa hare hu keetz chayyim. tochelet shehochil hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael vetzippa sheyyashuvu, vehem lo shavu, sof baa lahem lemachalat lev; ucheshettaavato vaa, shehem osin retzono, etz chayyim hi lahem:
targum: Man dimshade lemadereh tav min detale besivra veilana dechaye rigta mayta:

rashi: Odcha mistolel beammi. ketargumo, kevishat be beammi, vehu miggizrat mesilla, dimtargeminan orach kevisha, uvelaaz 440; uchevar perashti besof vayhi mikketz, kol teva shettechillat yesodah 120 vehi baa ledabber bilshon mitpael, noten hattav shel shimmush beemtza otiyyot shel ikkar, kegon zo, uchegon "veyistabbel hechagav" (105 12), miggizrat saval, "ki tistarer alenu" (Bamidbar 16), miggizrat nagid vesar, "mistakkel havet" (Daniel 7):

ohc: Vaasher lo vegomer vayyaazov. taam amro vayyaazov betosefet vav, shiur hakkatuv ken hu: vaasher lo shat libbo bechol hakkodem el devar Adonai, hosif al chattato afillu bedavar kaze sheen lo shum hefsed behachenasatam habbayta vehu omed lehafesid kinyanav, af al pi chen vayyaazov vegomer lehareot ki devar Adonai baza. vehitztzatzti ki hammitzriyyim machisim hayu et hammakom, lo letzad shehayu machzikim beyisrael laavodatam hu shehayu memaanim leshallecham, vehinne lefanecha shello heeminu sheyyesh koach bo chas veshalom lehorid habbarad, vaafillu betorat safek lo haya etzlam shello chashshu lishmirat avdehem uvehemtam. veulay ki letzad shello hayu beshesh makkot hakkodmot devar pele kaze, lo lakchu mehem shiur ki yachol lah venire beenehem shehu rachok sheyyachol asohu.

rashi: Vaydabber Adonai. hu haddibbur atzmo haamur lemala ba dabber el paro melech mitzrayim, ella mittoch shehifsik hainyan kede leyachasam, chazar alav lehatechil bo:
Ani Adonai. keday ani leshalchacha ulekayyem divre shelichuti:
Netatticha elohim lefaro. shofet verode, lirdoto vemakkot veyissurin:

Yihye neviecha. ketargumo – "meturgemanach". vechen kol leshon nevua adam hammachriz umashmia laam divre tochachot, vehu miggizrat "niv sefatayim" (Yeshayahu 57), "yanuv chachma" (Mishlei 10), "vaychal mehitnabbot" dishmuel (1 10); uvelaaz korin lo 524:
Machazik bam. ochez bam, kemo "vehechezika bimvushav" (Devarim 25):

Baadam uvabbehema. veim tomar meayin hayu lahem habbehemot, vahalo kevar neemar vayyamat kol mikne mitzrayim? lo nigzera gezera ella al otan shebbassadot bilvad, shenneemar bemiknecha asher bassade, vehayyare et devar Adonai hichnis et miknehu el habbattim, ken shenuya bimchilta etzel "vayyikkach shesh meot rechev bachur" (Shemot 14):

ohc: Lemor ki yedabber alechem vegomer. taam amro lemor shennatan lahem reshut lomar ki al pi Adonai hem osim haotot, shezzulat ze yihye asur lahem lehodia davar ze hagam sheyyishalem, ucheamram zichronam livracha (yoma 4,1) shehu beval tomar ad sheamar lo lemor, vedavka im yishal paro o im yirtzu hem lomar elav, aval en chiyyuv baddavar ad sheyyomar lemor dabber achat reshut veachat lechova.

Od yirtze al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (torat kohanim 1) ki chol makom shenneemar lemoshe uleaharon eno ella lemoshe sheyyomar leaharon, vehu atzmo sheramaz beamro lemor, perush ki ma sheatta roe "el moshe veel aharon" lo shehaddibbur haya lishnehem, ella "lemor" perush lemoshe sheyyomar leaharon. vetaam hashevaatam baddibbur, letzad sheshshekulim hem bemitzva zo, ki aharon yedabber el paro kemo shekkatavnu lemala:

Paro lemor tenu vegomer. kavvanat amro lemor leval yitztarchu ad sheyyomar paro beferush "tenu lachem mofet" veaz hu shettaasu haamur bainyan, ella kol sheyyomar dibbur shehammechuvvan hu shetztzarich hu leot ulemofet, o sheritem shehu mefakpek baddavar umachchish lomar "mi yomar kedivrechem", hagam shello amar "tenu" vegomer af al pi chen emor el aharon "kach mattecha" vegomer.

rashi: Kol arum yaase vedaat. maasehu, kegon david: "yevakshu ladoni hammelech naara vetula vegomer" (Melachim 1 1:2):
Uchesil yifros ivvelet. ze achashverosh, "veyafked hammelech" (Ester 2:3). yodim hayu shello yissa lechullam, umi shehaya lo vat hitminah (Megila 12:):
targum: Kol arima avidteh midatta vesichla pares leh leshatyuta:

ohc: Vayyaasu chen moshe veaharon kaasher vegomer. perush, kesheasu moshe veaharon maase hakkaat hayeor, naaset happeulla venitkayyem haratzon keillu hayta mitzvat Adonai mippiv baruch hu layor sheyyehafech ledam. veayyen ma shepperashti od befasuk (Shemot 7:6) "vayyaas moshe" vegomer hakkodem laze, veayyen bappasuk sheachar ze.

Leene faro uleene avadav. hagam ki techillat devarav haya im paro beyichud beet hasetarato laasot tzerachav lefi divrehem zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 89), umin hassetam hu levaddo yihye sham, af al pi chen modiacha hakkatuv ki nitakkev mehakkot ad shehikka befirsum leene avadav. vahagam ki bemitzvat Adonai lo dikdek lomar perat ze, min hassetam ken dibber Adonai elav, veulay ki laze nitkavven hakkatuv beamro ken kaasher tzivva, perush, ken kaddevarim hanneemarim bedivre Adonai, ucheneged peratim asher tire bemaasehem sheen ketuvim ken bidvar haelohim, meid hakkatuv alehem ki hem kaasher tzivva Adonai, venachon.

rashi: Vehifleti. vehifrashti, vechen "vehifla Adonai" (Shemot 9), vechen "lo niflet hi mimmecha" (Devarim 30) – lo muvdelet umufreshet hi mimmecha:
Lemaan teda ki ani Adonai bekerev haaretz. af al pi sheshshechinati bashshamayim gezerati mitkayyemet battachtonim:
Atta tedabber. paam achat kol shelichut ushelichut kefi sheshshemato mippi, veaharon achicha yamlitzennu veyatimennu beazne faro:
Lachen. al pi otah hashshevua:
Emor livne yisrael ani Adonai. hanneeman behavetachati:
Vehotzeti etchem. ki chen hivtachti: "veachare chen yetzu birchush gadol" (sham):
Sivlot. torach massa mitzrayim:
ohc: Lachen emor livne yisrael ani Adonai. perush, hodiem mishshemi ki middati middat rachamim verichamti alehem, umillevad hodaa zo tomar lahem seder hattovot asher eese lahem vehotzeti vegomer.
Od yirtze beamro lachen leshon shevua shennishba Adonai laasot kol haamur bainyan, vechen timtza sheamar yechezkel (Yechezkel 20:6) "bayyom hahu nasati yadi lahem lehotziam meeretz mitzrayim".

Veamro vehotzeti vegomer, nitkavven lesadder seder hattovot, ki battechilla yakel ol subbolam, vehu amro vehotzeti etchem mittachat sivlot mitzrayim shehu tokef hashshibud, veze haya techef umiyyad bemakkat hayeor nitparda chavilat nogsim veshotrim, aval yisrael hayu ovdim ketzat ki emat hammitzriyyim hayta alehem umeatzmam hayu ovdim avoda kalla. ucheneged ze amar vehitztzalti etchem meavodatam shetteaker avoda mehem kol ikkar, veachar kach vegaalti etchem hi yetziatam meeretz mitzrayim, uvichlal perat ze hi keriat yam suf, sheim lo chen zo geulla sheachareha kelaya bar minan, velaze lo amar "vehotzeti etchem min haaretz" ella "vegaalti" lomar hotzaa sheyyesh bah geulla im yirdof oyev yirdof beaf uvechema shefucha. veachar kach velakachti etchem li leam shehu mattan tora, ki sham nityachadnu lo leam veyiched shemo alenu, vehu amro vehayiti lachem lelohim.

O yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (berachot 7,1) befasuk "veniflinu ani veammecha" vegomer (Shemot 33:16), ki bikkesh moshe alav hashshalom meAdonai shello yashre shechinato al ummot haolam, veheshivo el elyon "gam et haddavar vegomer eese" ad kan, ucheneged zeman ze amar vehayiti lachem vegomer, velo leummot haolam, shello yashre shechinato alehem.

Od yirtze al derech amram zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 6,4) ki arba geulot neemru befasuk ze, veulay ki hem remuzim beshem havaya sheamar Adonai petach devarav emor livne yisrael ani Adonai, uletzad ze shem happoel yifal arba mine geulot. ulefi ze yeduyyak amro vehayiti lachem lelohim al geula habbaa bechinat hei acharona, ki tikkare shem elohim kayyadua leanshe emet. veulay ki laze nitkavven beamro achar shessidder arba leshonot shel geula: "vidatem ki ani shem havaya", perush, veze lecha haot arba geulot.

targum: Vituvun alah lerochatzan veyivnun battin veyitzvun karmin veyetvun lerochatzan kad aved pureanut dinin mikkol debazzin yathon misachranehon veyedun are ana Adonai elahahon:
Bar adam kabbel nevua al paro malka demitzrayim veitnabbe alohi veal mitzrae kulehon:
Bechen kidnan amar Adonai elohim ha ana mayte alach dekatlin becharba veeshetze minach enasha uveira:
Are chidnan amar Adonai elohim misof arbein shenin achnesh yat mitzrae mibbene ammaya deitbadaru letaman:
Vahava pitgam nevua min kodam Adonai imi lememar:
Bechen ha ana shelach rugezi alach veal malkevatach veetten yat ara demitzrayim lechorev tzadu ushemamu mimigdal sevena vead techum kush:
Bechen kidnan amar Adonai elohim ha ana yahev linvuchadretzar malka devavel yat ara demitzrayim veyishbe itregushetah veyibboz bizah veyade adaah utehe agar lemashiryateh:
Utehe ara demitzrayim leishtemamu vechureba veyedun are ana Adonai chalaf daamar malchuta dili vaana chabbeshet:
Veetten yat ara demitzrayim letzadu bego medinan tzadyan vekirvaha bego kirvin dahavaa cherban yehevyan letzadu arbein shenin veagle yat mitzrae levene ammaya veevadrinun bimdinata:
Merachakateh deelaha sifvate deshikra uveilen deavdin hemanuta mitree:
Beshatta asiryeta baasiraa bitre asar leyarcha hava pitgam nevua min kodam Adonai imi lememar:

bart: En tormim middavar shennigmera melachto. middavar shennitmarach bakkeri:

Al davar shello nigmera melachto. shello nitmarach bakkeri, dichtiv (Bamidbar 18) kaddagan min haggoren vechamlea min hayyakev, min haggamur al haggamur, velo min haggamur al sheeno gamur, velo mishsheeno gamur al haggamur:

Veim taram terumato teruma. vedavka bishar perot, aval hattorem min hazzetim al hashshemen, o min haanavim al hayyayin, ha amrinan leel deen terumato teruma mishshum deit beh peseda lakkohen kidamran:
Tormim batzal katan shalem. lefi shehu mitkayyem:
Velo chatzi vatzal gadol. af al pi shehu yafe mimmennu:
Rabbi yehuda omer lo chi. rabbi yehuda letaameh deamar leolam hu torem min hayyafe:
Mibbene hammedina. tovim laachila min hakkuferim habbetzalim shel bene hakkefarim, aval shel bene hakkefarim mitkayyemim yoter:
Mippene shehu maachal politikin. betzalim shel bene hammedina hu maachol laanashim chashuvim, vehem yafim yoter meotan shel bene hakkefarim. politikin, bene palterin shel melachim:
Haish porea uforem. keshehu menugga porea et rosho uforem et begadav, dichtiv (sham 13) ish tzarua hu vechulei, ish porea uforem, veen ishsha poraat uforemet:
Haish maddir beno benazir. beno katan. vechala nezirato alav vaafillu lichsheyyigdal. vezo halacha hi bannazir, veen lah semech min hattora:

Haish megalleach al nezirut aviv. im nadar aviv binzirut vehifrish karbenotav umet vehaya beno nazir, o shennadar binzirut leachar mitat aviv, hare habben megalleach beyom meloot umevi karbanot shehifrish aviv. vegam zo halacha veen lah semech:
Haish mekaddesh et bitto. mekabbel kiddushe bitto ketanna shello middatah, dichtiv (Devarim 22) et bitti natatti laish hazze:
Haish niskal arom. dichtiv (Vayikra 24) veragmu oto, vei efshar lomar oto velo otah, deha ketiv (Devarim 17) vehotzeta et haish hahu o et haishsha hahi, ella oto belo kesuto aval otah bichsutah:
Haish nitle. dichtiv (sham 21) vetalita oto al etz, oto velo otah:
Haish nimkar bignevato. dichtiv (Shemot 22) venimkar bignevato, velo vignevatah:
Meahava. sheahav et hammakom:

Shakul. mishkalo shave, eno machria lechan ulechan. yesh lo hakkatuv bevav umashmauto cheillu haya lo beAlef. veyesh lo beAlef umashmauto keillu katuv bevav. hen yikteleni, hallo hu horgeni, lo ayachel lo od. o lo ani meyachel:
Miyyira. middaagat puranut shello tavo alav:
Yere elohim. velo ohev elohim:
Tzavar et haggechalim. shebbammachta:
Al gabbe hammizbeach. hakketoret:

Veriddedan beshule hammachta. kede shello yippol hakketoret meal haggechalim, lefichach hu merakkean ufoshtan shello yihyu meshuppaim elach vaelach. targum vayrakkeu, uredidu. veal mizbach hazzahav haya maktir, velo vetoch hammachta. aval bakketoret shel yom hakkippurim haya manniach haggechalim betoch hammachta vealeha haya maktir, velo haya sham riddud gechalim beyom hakkippurim:
Migrash. rechava penuya mizzeria umeilanot lenoy hair: vealpayim. lo huzkar letittam lalviyyim, velo neemru ella litziat techum shabbat:

Sadot ucheramim. vealpayim saviv nittenu lalviyyim. mehem hinnichu elef saviv hair lammigrash, vehashshear sadot ucheramim. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer beno shel rabbi yose haggelili, shettechum alpayim amma derabbanan:

Velo mishennitgarsha. sheim zinneta leachar sheggersha vechazar vehechzira vekinne lah venistera, en hammayim bodkim al zenut shelleachar gerushin, digrusha shezzinneta mutteret lachzor levalah, divkiddushin tala rachamana haissur, lo vevia, dichtiv (Devarim 24) veyatza mibbeto vehalcha vehayta leish acher. lefichach, nitkaddesha leish acher, af al pi shello nivala, asura lachzor levalah. veim nivala belo kiddushin, mutteret lachzor levalah:
Lo yitrom. lechattechilla, detzarich lehashemia leazno kesheyyevarech:
Cheresh sheddibberu vo chachamim bechol makom vechulei. lav kelala hu, divresh chagiga tane cheresh, umedabber veeno shomea bichlal, uveferek mitzvat chalitza leinyan chalitza:
Sheeno shomea veeno medabber. shennolad cheresh mimmee immo, vechevan shello shama meolam ma shemmedabberim lo i efshar lo sheyyedabber:
Mi shezzacha vammachta. leholich haggechalim lemizbach hazzahav. velo haya vaze fayis, ella mi shezzacha vakketoret al yede fayis omer laze sheimmo zeche immi vammachta:
Vechata. min hameukkalot happenimiyyot lo garsinan hacha, shehen kerovim laddeshen, deadderabba gechalim gassot uvoarot haya chote:
Veeran beshel zahav. aval lo haya chote veshel zahav, kede shello titkalkel, vehattora chasa al mamonan shel yisrael:

Nitpazzer mimmenna kekav gechalim. shehaya chote vemachta shel kesef bat arbaa kabbim umeare veshel zahav shehi shel shelosha. uchede leholichah melea haya meare vaacharona, shezzehu derech kavod shel mala:
Mechabbedan laamma. leammat hammayim shebbaazara. shello yikkavu vahen hakkohanim:
Uveshabbat. sheasur lechabbot:
Kofe alehen pesachter. keli echad gadol. targum sirotav, pesachtervoteh:
Letech. chatzi chor, chamesh esre sein, shehakkor sheloshim sein:

Ushete sharsherot hayu. bappesachter. achat mitztzad ze veachat mitztzad ze, lefi shebbo moridin haddeshen meal hammizbeach kidamrinan besamuch, ucheshemmorido male deshen derech karka hakkevesh shehu meshuppa haya chohen echad lefanav shemmoshcho vashsharsheret vechohen echad haya lemala min happesachter vetofes bashsharsheret shellefanav shello titgalgel bemidron hakkevesh:

Veal hashsheretz. shennimtza vaazara beshabbat, kofim alav pesachter kede shello yittamu vo hakkohanim. sheen yecholim lehotzio mishsham beshabbat, deal shevut kaze gazru vaafillu vammikdash. vedavka cheshennimtza vaazara, aval nimtza vahechol o vaulam, motziim oto miyyad vaafillu veshabbat:
Hammatbil kelim beshabbat. sheasur lehatebil kelim temeim lehaalotam mide tumatan beshabbat, mippene shennire kimtakken keli:
Hammeasser. sheasur lehaferish terumot umaasrot beshabbat, mippene shehu metakken:

Vehamevashshel bashshabbat. beshogeg, yochal oto tavshil lemotzae shabbat, aval lo beshabbat atzmo. uvemezid lo yochal hu, aval acherim ochlim lemotzae shabbat, dichtiv (Shemot lo) ushemartem et hashshabbat ki kodesh hi, hi kodesh veen maaseha kodesh:
Uvashsheviit ben shogeg ben mezid yaakor. shennechshedu yisrael al hashsheviit velo nechshedu al hashshabbat:
Eshet kohen shota umutteret levalah. im nimtzet nekiyya. demahu detema hoil veeshet kohen shenneensa asura levalah, nachush lah shemma neensa ulechach lo badkuha hammayim, ka mashma lan:
Eshet saris shota. delo tema mibbilade ishech amar rachamana, vehay lav bar hachi hu, ka mashma lan:

Al yede chol haarayot mekanneim. im kinne lah meaviha o meachiha umeechad mikkol arayot, venistera, have kinnuy veneeseret alav veshota. delo tema nitmea nitmea shete peamim, echad labbaal veechad labboel, hecha demittasra aleh behay zenut, laafoke ha daasira aleh vekayma ema lo, ka mashma lan:

Chutz min hakkatan. pachot mibben tesha shanim veyom echad, sheen biato via, kach peresh rambam. veli nire katan pachot mibben shelosh esre shana veyom echad velo hevi simanim, dichtiv (Bamidbar 5) veshachav ish otah, ish velo katan:
Umimmi sheeno ish. lemiute vehema:
Hattorem vechulei. beshogeg ayre, vaafillu hachi yachazor veyitrom, dahave karov lemezid, mishshum dahava leh [lemitammeh]:
Venimtzet shel chometz kulei. shehattorem min hachometz al hayyayin en terumato teruma, deyayin vechometz shene minim hen:
Im safek. ad shello teramah hechemitza o leachar shetteramah hechemitza:

Teruma veyachazor veyitrom. venoten shetehen lakkohen, vechohen noten lo deme harishona shehi gedola min hashsheniyya, shehashsheniyya mitmaetet kefi ma sheola terumat harishona, ulefi shehakkohen hu hammotzi mechavero vaanan kayma lan bechol ducheta hammotzi mechavero alav haraya, lefichach eno lokeach belo damim ella hakketanna, vetzarich sheyyitten lo deme haggedola shehi harishona:

Harishona enah medammaat bifne atzmah. im nafla lefachot mimmea shel chullin en naaset medumma, deshemma enah teruma ella hashsheniyya hi teruma, vechen hashsheniyya enah medammaat bifne atzmah, shemma harishona teruma velo hashsheniyya:
Veen chayyavim aleha chomesh. zar sheachal harishona levaddah o hashsheniyya levaddah eno meshallem chomesh kedin shear ochle teruma bishgaga:
Uchemin achsadra haya. shene ketalim echad mitztzad ze veechad mitztzad ze lashshaar, hayu boltin veyotzim michutz lechomat haazara letzad har habbayit, vaaliyya benuya lemala al otan shene ketalim:
Ufetach haya lo lachel. beechad min hakketalim haya petach hayyotze lachel, dehaynu makom lifnim mechomat har habbayit michutz laazara vehu karuy chel:
Shaar hakkarban. sham machnisim kadshe kadashim sheshshechitatan batztzafon:

Bet hammoked. al shem shemmedurot dolkim bah tamid lehitchammem sham hakkohanim mippene sheholchim yechefim, karuy bet hammoked. uvayit gadol haya, ulearba pinnotav hayu arba leshachot ketannot kedimfaresh veazil:
Shaar haddelek. al shem shehayu machnisim derech sham etzim shel maaracha haddolkim al hammizbeach nikra shaar haddelek:
Sheni lo shaar habbechorot. garsinan, sheshsham hayu machnisim habbechorot sheshshechitatan baddarom:

Shaar hammayim. kedichtiv besefer yechezkel [47] vehinne mayim mefakkim min hakkatef hayyemanit, vehayenu darom shekkaruy yamin kedichtiv tzafon veyamin. veraa yechezkel bannevua shehayu mayim yotzim mibbet kodesh hakkodashim dakkim kekarne chagavim ucheshemmaggiim leshaar ze naasim kimlo pi pach katan, vehayenu dekari lahem mayim mefakkim:
Shaar nikkanor. meforash bemassechet yoma:
Pinchas hammalbish. memunne haya lehalebish hakkohanim bishat avoda ulehafshitan achar avoda velishmor bigde kehunna:

Lishkat ose chavittin. bah hayu osin hammincha shekkohen gadol makriv bechol yom machatzitah babboker umachatzitah baerev, veal shem shenneemar bah (Vayikra 6) al machavat bashshemen tease, nikret chavittin:

Haya notel. balah et hammincha, sheen mitzvat kehunna bimnachot ella mikkemitza vaelach. vehaggasha nammi techillat kemitza hi, sheen zar karev lammizbeach. aval kiddushe keli vitzika uvelila, bimnachot hatteunot shemen, kasher bezar:
Venotnah al yadah. lehanif:

Vechohen meniach yado tachteha. shenneemar bishlamim (Vayikra 7) yadav teviena, veneemar beminchat sota (Bamidbar 5) velakach hakkohen miyyad haishsha, ma bishlamim kohen meniach yado tachat yad habbealim umenif, kach beminchat sota kohen meniach yado tachat yad haishsha umenif:
Har habbayit haya chamesh meot amma. mukkaf choma saviv:

Rubbo min haddarom sheni lo min hammizrach. kelomar, harochak sheyyesh mechomat har habbayit lechomat haazara letzad darom, yoter min harochak sheyyesh benehen mitztzad mizrach. veharochak sheyyesh benehen mitztzad mizrach, yoter min harochak sheyyesh benehen letzad tzafon, vehatztzefoni yoter min hammaarav:
Bau veamdu. leachar shebberchu vekaru veasu haavodot haamurot leel, bau lemaalot haulam:
Amdu harishonim. ellu hachamishsha chohanim shebbeyadam chamishsha chelim kulei:

Uverchu et haam beracha achat. vehen shelosha fesukim shel birkat kohanim, yevarechcha, yaer, yissa. vekare lehu veracha achat, lefi shello hayu onin acharehen amen ben pasuk lefasuk kederech sheosim baggevulim:
Et hashshem kichtavo. beYod hei:

Uvammedina vechinnuyo. beAlef dalet. sheen mazkirin et hashshem kichtavo ella vammikdash bilvad, shenneemar (Shemot 20) bechol hammakom asher azkir et shemi avo elecha uverachticha, sarsehu vedarshehu, bechol hammakom asher avo elecha uverachticha, dehaynu vammikdash, sham azkir et shemi:

Keneged kitfotehem. lefi shetztzerichim nesiut kappayim, dichtiv vayyissa aharon et yadav el haam vayvarchem, uchetiv (Devarim 18) hu uvanav kol hayyamim, ma hu vinsiut kappayim, af banav binsiut kappayim kol hayyamim:
Uvammikdash. shemmevarchim et haam bashshem hameforash ushechina lemala mikkishre etzbeotehem, magbihim yedehem lemala merashehem:
Sheen magbiah yadav lemala min hatztzitz. mippene shehashshem katuv bo:
Rabbi yehuda omer kulei. veen halacha cherabbi yehuda:
Amen shello satiti arusa unesua. al yede gilgul shevua hu megalgel aleha zenut shel erusin, veaf al pi shello haya bo bekinnuy usetira. umikkan legilgul shevua min hattora:

Shomeret yavam uchenusa. veim hayta yevimto uchenasah, vekinne lah venistera, megalgel aleha tuma shennitmea keshehi shomeret yavam. umatnitin rabbi akiva hi deamar shomeret yavam erva. veenah halacha, ella shomeret yavam shezzinneta mutteret layyavam, lefichach eno matne aleha im zinneta shomeret yavam:

Amen shello nitmeti vechulei. perushe kamfaresh laamen al haala amen al hashshevua ditninan leel. vehachi kaamar, amen shello nitmeti hu amen al hashshevua shehishbiah hakkohen mashbia ani alayich shello nitmet:
Veim nitmeti yavou vi. hayenu kabbalat ala, sheamar lah hakkohen veim nitmet yavou bach kol hakkelalot hallalu:
Amen shello ettame. sheim tittame leachar zeman mayim meararim otah. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Chamishsha lo yitromu. minyana lemiute midderabbi yehuda, deamar katan shettaram terumato teruma:

Haillem. vehu sheshshomea ella shennishtattek mechamat choli, lo yitrom, lefi sheeno yachol levarech. vechen hearom eno yachol levarech, dichtiv (Devarim 23) velo yire vecha ervat davar, beshaa sheatta medabber bo lo yire vecha erva:
Uvaal keri. nammi bizman hattakkana mikkamme devitteluha litviluta lo hava matze levarech, ditnan baal keri mehareher belibbo:

Vehashshikkor vehassuma. enam yodim livror min hayyafe, vaanan bainan sheyyehe hattorem borer vetorem min hayyafe, dichtiv (Bamidbar 18) mikkol chelbo et mikdesho. veshikkor mikre kol sheeno yachol ledabber bifne hammelech mechamat shichruto:

En tormin min halleket min hashshichcha umin happea. mi sheyyesh lo keri shel tevel eno yachol lehaferish alav teruma milleket veshichcha ufea shebbeyado, sheellu mattenot aniyyim hen veeno yachol letakken tivlo bemattenot aniyyim:
Hahefker. dichtiv (Devarim 14) uva hallevi ki en lo chelek venachala immach, mimma sheyyesh lecha veen lo atta chayyav litten, yatza hefker sheyyadcha veyado shavin bo:

Velo mimmaaser rishon shennittela terumato. en torem mimmennu teruma gedola al keri shel tevel shebbeyado. veitzterich leashmuinan hecha shehikdimo ven levi lakkohen bashshibbolim, shehu patur mitteruma gedola, vedavka shennittela terumato, aval lo nittela terumato yachol litrom, detanya besifri minnayin leven levi sheratza laasot mimmaaser rishon shello teruma gedola, minnayin sheose, talmud lomar (Bamidbar 18) ki et masar bene yisrael asher yarimu laAdonai‏ teruma, mikkan sheim ratza laasoto teruma laacherim ose, yachol af leachar shennittela terumato yehe ose oto teruma laacherim, talmud lomar (sham) et mikdesho mimmennu, bizman shekkadsho betocho hu ose oto teruma laacherim, en kadsho betocho en ose oto teruma laacherim:

Velo mimmaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu. hay tanna savar maaser sheni mamon gavoah hu. vehecha delo nifdu peshita deeno yachol letakken tivlo bemamon shel gavoah, aval hecha denifdu salka datach amena deyachol laasotan teruma gedola al tivlo. vechi tema ha nammi peshita, dechullin gemurim hu, itztarich hecha dehikdimo vashshibbolim, defatur mitteruma gedola kedifrishit bemaaser rishon. vehekdesh shennifda nammi itztarich, keshehikdish tevel umeracho haggizbar veachar kach pedao, defatur min hatteruma:
Min happatur al hachiyyuv. kegon mipperot shello heviu shelish, shehen peturin min hammaasrot, al happerot sheheviu shelish, shehen chayyavin bemaasrot:

Velo min hattalush al hamechubbar. dichtiv (Bamidbar 18) vaharemotem mimmennu, shello yitrom min hattalush al hamechubbar velo min hamechubbar al hattalush, dilshon harama lo shayyach ella betalush, umimmennu mashma shehatteruma vehachullin shenehem shavin:

Min hechadash al hayyashan. mipperot shana zo al perot shana sheavra, velo mipperot shana sheavra al perot shana zo, dichtiv (Devarim 14) hayyotze hassade shana shana. aval sade sheosa shene geranot beshana, kegon sede vet hashshelachin, tormim umeasserim mizze al ze:

Velo mipperot haaretz al perot chutza laaretz. dichtiv (Vayikra 27) vechol masar haaretz mizzera haaretz, gale kera bemaaser, vehu haddin litruma. vechen en tormin mipperot haaretz al perot shebbesureya, velo mipperot shebbesureya al perot shebbaaretz:
Barishon laAdonai‏ haaretz umeloah. lefi shehu rishon lemaase vereshit:
Bashsheni gadol Adonai. shebbo nechleku hammayim vehaya rakia ben mayim lamayim:
Bashshelishi elohim nitztzav baadat el. shebbo niret hayyabbasha shealeha omdim haddayyanin laasot din:
Barvii el nekamot. shebbo nivreu hashshemesh vehayyareach vehakkochavim sheatid hakkadosh baruch hu lehinnakem min haovdim lahem:
Bachamishi hareninu lelohim uzzenu. shebbo nivreu vaale chayyim sheharoe otan merannen umeshabbeach levoro:
Bashshishshi Adonai‏ malach. shebbo nishlema habberia uvo nivra adam shemmakkir malchuto shel yotzro:

Menucha leche haolamim. hay tanna savar la keman deamar shitta alfe shenin have alma vechad charuv, veal shem shebbaelef hashshevii lo yihye chi im hakkadosh baruch hu, shenneemar (yeshaya 2) venisgav Adonai‏ levaddo vayyom hahu, lechach omrim beshabbat mizmor shir leyom hashshabbat, laelef hashshevii, sheyyomo shel hakkadosh baruch hu hu elef shana:
Ellu shebbet din mekannein lahem. im roim otam shemmitnahagot bifritzut:

Velo lehashekotah amru. deha bainan vehevi haish et ishto, velekka. uvalah nammi lichsheyyavo eno yachol lehashekotah bekinnuy ze, devainan vekinne vehevi. verabbi yose lo bae vekinne vehevi. veen halacha kerabbi yose. vesuma eno mashke et ishto, shenneemar (sham) meene ishah. umimma shenneemar (sham) ishsha tachat ishah, lamadnu shekkol hammonea habbaal millehashkot monea haishsha millishtot im haya oto haddavar baishsha, lefichach im hayta hi suma enah shota. veim hayta chiggeret enah shota, shenneemar (sham) veheemid otah hakkohen. vechen im hayta giddemet, shenneemar (sham) venatan al kappeha. o illemet, devainan veamra haishsha. vechen im haya habbaal chigger o giddem o illem eno mashke middichtiv ishsha tachat ishah kidamran:
Hazzetim hannichtashim. regilim hayu lichtosh hazzetim bammachteshet lehotzi shamnan:
Terumato teruma. gemura hi middeorayta:
Veyachazor veyitrom. midderabbanan, leachar sheyyashlim ketishat otan hazzetim uderichat haanavim yachazor veyotzi teruma shenit kashshiur hatztzarich lashshemen velayyayin sheyyatza:
Harishona medammaat. im nafla lefachot mimmea chullin naasa hakkol medumma veasur lezarim, veyimkor hakkol lakkohen, ditruma gemura hi middeorayta:
Vechayyavin aleha chomesh. zar haochlah bishgaga meshallem keren vechomesh, kedin kol zar ochel teruma:

Aval lo sheniyya. lefi sheenah ella midderabbanan, lefichach enah neechelet ad sheyyafrishu aleha teruma umaasrot mimmakom acher, demiddeorayta hi tevel gamur. vei kashya may shena hacha betorem shemen al hazzetim hannichtashim ditrumato teruma veyachazor veyitrom, umay shena leel gabbe hattorem zetim al hashshemen vaanavim al hayyayin deen terumato teruma, veyesh lomar dehattorem zetim al hashshemen ikka peseda lakkohen, lefichach en terumato teruma, aval betorem shemen al hazzetim hannichtashim delekka peseda lakkohen terumato teruma, ella derabbanan hu degazur deyachazor veyitrom:
Meshammeshin kenisa vitzia. shebbahen hayu nichnasin veyotzim lehar habbayit:
Kifonos min hammaarav. shaar shel har habbayit shebbetzad maarav kifonos shemo, veshel tzafon tadi shemo:
Alav shushan habbira tzura. keshealu min haggola tziuu lahem malche paras letzayyer tzurat shushan habbira al shaare habbayit, kede sheyyihye lahem mora malchut, vetziyyeruhu beshaar hammizrach:
Kohen gadol hassoref et happara. matnitin rabbi meir hi desavar en para adumma nisrefet ella bechohen gadol. veenah halacha:
Vechol mesaadeha. kol hakkohanim hamesayyeim vesoadim lakkohen hassoref otah:
Lehar hammishcha. lehar hazzetim shehu bemizracho shel yerushalayim, sham hayu sorfin et happara:
Chamishsha lo yitromu. minyana lemiute ha deamar rabbi yehuda lekamman katan shello hevi shete searot terumato teruma, ka mashma lan deen terumato teruma:

Hacheresh vehashshote vehakkatan kulei. kullehu mechad kera nafka lan, dichtiv (Shemot 28) dabber el bene yisrael veyikchu li teruma meet kol ish asher yiddevennu libbo. el bene yisrael perat lenachri, meet kol ish perat lekatan, asher yiddevennu libbo perat lecheresh veshote sheen bahem daat lihyot nodvin. vekatan lo matze mamit measher yiddevennu libbo, deikka katan shehiggia leonat nedarim sheyyesh lo daat lihyot nodev. vezot hatteruma asher tikchu meittam perat letorem sheeno shello. veshote, hameabbed ma shennotnim lo karuy shote:

Afillu virshut. shel yisrael, sheasao yisrael shelucho litrom, en terumato teruma, dichtiv (Bamidbar 18) ken tarimu gam attem, gam lerabbot sheluchachem, ma attem bene verit af sheluchachem bene verit:
Rabbi yehuda omer terumato teruma. bediavad, delet leh lerabbi yehuda hach derasha meet kol ish perat lekatan:
Ad shello va leonat nedarim. hazzachar ben shetem esre shana veyom echad, vehannekeva bat achat esre shanim veyom echad. umeotah ona veelach im taram terumato teruma. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Kol hakketalim shehayu sham. bechol binyene har habbayit:
Hayu gevohim. harebe, ad shehayu kol happetachim shebbahen gavhan esrim amma, levad mimma sheal happetachim:
Chutz mikkotel mizrachi. hu hattachton leragle har habbayit:

Shehakkohen hassoref et happara omed behar hammishcha. hu har hazzetim asher al pene yerushalayim mikkedem, ufene hakkohen lammaarav, umitkavven veroe meal gova rosh hakkotel derech hashshearim shellifnim mimmennu et pitcho shel hechol, keshehu mazze bedam, kedichtiv (Bamidbar 19) vehizza el nochach pene ohel moed. veim haya hakkotel gavoah, af al pi shehashshearim mechuvvanot kullam ze keneged ze, shaar har habbayit keneged shaar ezrat nashim, veshaar ezrat nashim keneged shaar haazara haggedola, veshaar haazara haggedola keneged petach hahechol, lo haya yachol lirot et petach hahechol derech happetachim, lefi shehahar holech umagbiah veole ad shekkarka petach hahechol gavoah (shete) [22 ammot] yoter mikkarka ragle har habbayit, venimtza sheaskuppat hahechol gevoha mimmashkof petach har habbayit [shete] ammot, shehare lo haya petach har habbayit gavoah ella esrim keditnan leel, venimtza sheen hakkohen hashshochet et happara yachol lirot chalalo shel petach hahechol derech oto petach:

Perozbul hammukdam. shezzemanno mukdam, shennichtav bechislev uzemanno hakkatuv betocho mittishre kodem, kasher, mippene shehura kocho shel malve bechach, difrozbul eno moil ella lahalevaot shellefanav, demishshennimseru levet din hare hen kigvuyot veshuv en mashmitot, hilkach halevaot habbaot acharav shello nimseru levet din mashmitot, nimtza demafsid bema shehikdim zemanno. aval perozbul hameuchar pasul, sheicher zemanno vehu hilva bentayim, ucheshemmotzi perozbul ze veroim bet din hazzeman sevurim sheotan halevaot kadmu lapperozbul, venimtza gove shello chaddin:

Shitre chov hammukdamim pesulim. kegon dekae benisan vechatav bashshetar zeman tishre shellefanav, pesulim mishshum degove shello chaddin min hallakochot shebben tishre lenisan. vekansinhu rabbanan delo ligbu bishtar ze min hallakochot kelal, vaafillu minnisan ulehallan, gezera shemma yigbe meotan shebben tishre lenisan shello chaddin. umihu lo have hashshetar pasul mechamat shehaedim shechatmu vo havo reshaim shechatmu al shetar mukdam besheker, dematzu haedim lememar anachnu al ikkar hammilva chatamnu velo al hazzeman, shello vanu lehaid shennichtav venechtam beyomo:
Vehameucharim kesherim. dehura kocho shel malve, sheeno toref lakochot ella mizzeman shekkatuv bashshetar:

Kotvin perozbul lechol echad veechad. shekkol malve umalve tzarich sheyyimsor shetarotav levet din veyichtov lo perozbul, hilkach keshechamishsha lovin meechad eno kotev ella perozbul echad, sheen kan ella malve echad, veaf al pi shehallovin merubbin, kesheyyihye lammalve perozbul echad al kullan dayyo:

Perozbul. peroz takkana, bul ashirim, dichtiv (Vayikra 26) veshavarti et geon uzzechem, veamar rav yosef ellu bulaot shebbihuda. takkana laashirim shello yaavru al hishshamer lecha pen yihye davar im levavcha beliyyaal, vetakkana laaniyyim sheyyimtzeu mi sheyyalve lahem. vehashematat kesafim bazzeman hazze derabbanan, dichtiv (Devarim 15) veze devar hashshemitta shamot kol baal mashshe yado, bishte shemittot hakkatuv medabber, achat shemittat karkaot veachat shemittat kesafim, bizman sheatta meshammet karka atta meshammet kesafim, uvizman shei atta meshammet karka i atta meshammet kesafim, verabbanan hu ditkinu shemittat kesafim bazzeman hazze, umishshum hachi haya koach beyad hillel letakken perozbul lehafekia din hashshemitta, hoil veen shemittat kesafim bazzeman hazze ella middivre sofrim:
Sheen talmud lomar lemor. sheen dome lishar lemor shebbattora, shehashshechina medabberet lemoshe lemor haddibbur leyisrael, aval kan en lomar ken:
Kekorin et hahallel. rashe ferakim bilvad hayu onim acharav:
Kol min chittim echad. veaf al gav deikka shechamtit ulevana:
Vechol min teenim echad. veaf al gav deikka shechorot ulevanot. teenim beodan lachim keruyin teenim, uchesheyyavshu keruyin gerogarot, ucheshennidrasin baiggul keruyin iggul devela:
Torem min hayyafe. min hatteenim al haggerogarot, ditenim yafim min haggerogarot:
Torem min hammitkayyem. min haggerogarot al hatteenim, digrogarot mitkayyeme tefe:
Leolam hu torem min hayyafe. dichtiv (Bamidbar 18) baharimchem et chelbo, leolam bainan chelbo, vei pased, yippased. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Ella al hakkarka. ella im ken yesh lo karka lallove, sheaz chashuv hachov kegavuy beyad bet din velo karinan beh lo yiggos:

Im en lo. lallove, umalve yesh lo, mezakke lo malve lallove betoch sadehu karka kol dehu, vechotvim alav perozbul, vaafillu hachov mea mane, mishshum dekarka kol shehu rauy ligbot bah kol chovo, kegon degave vehadar gave ad demashlim kol chovo:
Hayta lo. lallove sade memushkenet bair, ben sheacherim mishkenu otah lo ben shemmishken hu laacherim, kotvin perozbul:
Kotvin laish al nichse ishto. kegon karka shel nichse melog shehu ochel perot:
Al nichse appotroppin. shellovin letzorech hayetomim, vehayetomim en lahem karka:

Bo bayyom darash. kol hechi ditninan bo vayyom, bayyom shehoshivu et rabbi elazar ben azarya linsiut, shennitrabbu hattalmidim, shennatnu reshut lakkol likkanes. umishshum dehach derasha denitmea venitmaa nammi bo vayyom nidresha, naktinhu lechol hanach hacha:
Keli cheres. hu rishon, shennitma min hashsheretz shehu av. vehaochel shebbetocho sheni, shettimmeo hakkeli:
Eno omer tame. kol asher betocho tame. ella yitma, lemidrash beh nammi yetamme, shemmetamme et acherim:
Limmed al kikkar sheni. lehachi nakat kikkar, lefi shehu matzuy battannur:
Shemmetamme et hashshelishi. vaafillu bechullin. dikra setama ketiv:
Dor acher. min haatidim lavo. sheyyetaher et hashshelishi, veaf bitruma, sheen lo mikra min hattora:
Vahare akiva talmidcha mevi lo reaya min hammikra shehu tame. af bechullin. veen halacha kerabbi akiva, deen sheni ose shelishi bechullin, ella bitruma:

Hammizbeach haya sheloshim ushetayim. amma: al sheloshim ushetayim. amma. haya mevi defus merubba asuy mearba kerashim, kol keresh arko sheloshim ushetayim ammot, verochav hakkeresh amma, vehu gavho shel haddefus, umemalleo avanim vesid vezefet veoferet mehuttach vehu naasa miksha achat shel sheloshim ushetayim amma al sheloshim ushetayim amma gavoah amma. vezehu yesod:

Ala amma vechanas amma. achar sheala hayesod legova amma mevi defus acher sheorech kol keresh sheloshim amma verochav hakkeresh dehaynu gavho shel defus ze chamesh ammot, unetano al hayesod, umemalleo avanim vesid vezefet veoferet karishon, venidbak baysod venaasa miksha achat shel sheloshim amma al sheloshim amma omed al hayesod. veze nikra sovev. vehu gavoah min hayesod chamesh ammot. vehayenu kones amma, shehu mitkatztzer min hayesod amma lechol ruach. vechozer umevi defus shelishi shehu esrim ushemone amma al esrim ushemone amma, gavoah shalosh ammot, unetano al hassovev, umemalleo karishon, vezehu mekom hammaaracha shehu rosho shel mizbeach. nimtza hayesod bolet veyotze min hassovev amma lechol tzad, vehassovev bolet min mekom maaracha amma lechol tzad. veachar kach mevi defus amma al amma gavoah amma unetano al zavit hammizbeach umemalleo, vehu keren hammizbeach. vechen learba zaviyyot:
Mekom hilluch ragle hakkohanim. shello yihyu hakkohanim tzerichim lahaloch ben hakkeranot, ella mannichin amma panuy mimmekom hakkeranot velifnim lehilluch ragle hakkohanim:
Mittechilla. bime shelomo:
Lo haya ella esrim ushemone al esrim ushemone. vechones veole shel yesod vesovev umekom hakkeranot umekom hilluch ragle hakkohanim ad shennishar mekom hammaaracha esrim al esrim:
Ucheshealu vene haggola vehosifu arba ammot vechulei. nimtza yesodo sheloshim ushetayim al sheloshim ushetayim, umekom maarachto esrim vearba al esrim vearba:
Arba ammot min haddarom vearba ammot min hammaarav. garsinan. vehachi mayte la bizvachim perek kadshe kadashim:

Kemin gamma. gimel yevanit shehu kemin nun hafucha shellanu. vehatam mefaresh demishshum shitin dehaynu hannekavim sheyyordin bahen hannesachim, hosifu limshoch hammizbeach laddarom velammaarav. demeikkara bime shelomo darshu, mizbach adama, atum kaadama shello yehe chalul, ucheshehayu menassechim al gabbe hammizbeach bekeren deromit maaravit hayu hannesachim yordin min hammizbeach laritzpa veshottim labbor shehaya karuy sham etzel keren deromit maaravit samuch lammizbeach, velo haya betoch hammizbeach. uvene haggola hosifu bevinyan hammizbeach ad shehaya oto bor kalut letoch hammizbeach, ufatchu nekavim lerosh hammizbeach kenegdo lered sham hannesachim. shehem hayu omrim shetiyya kaachila, ma achila mitakkelet bammizbeach, dehaynu hakkarbanot shennisrafim al gabbe mizbeach, af shetiyya dehaynu nesachim tibbala bammizbeach. ukera demizbach adama, darshe leh sheyyehe mechubbar baadama, shello yivnennu al gabbe kefim velo al gabbe mechillot:
Shenneemar vehaariel. mikra hu bichezkel [mag] shehaya mitnabbe al middat bayit sheni veshelleatid lavo:
Vehaariel shetem esre. middot mekom hammaaracha kaamar shetem esre:
El arbaat revaav. melammed shemmeemtzaito moded shetem esre amma lechol ruach, vehayenu esrim vearba al esrim vearba:
Vechut hassikra chogro vaemtza. chut adom haya asuy saviv lammizbeach beemtzao lesof chamesh ammot shel gavho, dehaynu amma achat lematta meelyono shel sovev:
Lehavedil ben damim haelyonim. chattat behema veolat haof sheddaman nizrak lemala michut hassikra:
Laddamim hattachtonim. lechol shear karbanot shezzerikat daman lematta min hachut:

Veochel baddarom amma achat kulei. hammizbeach kullo haya bechelko shel binyamin, chutz meamma achat al pene orech haddarom veamma achat al pene orech hammizrach shehaya tofes mechelko shel yehuda, ella shello hayta amma shebbammizrach al pene kol hammizrach, shekkeshemmaggia lekeren mizrachit tzefonit hayta kullah betoch amma lakkeren, vechen achilat haamma hadderomit lo hayta mehallechet al pene kol haddarom, shekkeshemmaggia lekeren deromit maaravit hayta kullah samuch lakkeren amma. venimtzeu shelosh karnot hammizbeach bechelko shel binyamin, vekeren deromit mizrachit bilvad hayta bechelko shel yehuda. ulefi shebberach yaakov et binyamin zeev yitraf babboker yochal ad (Bereshit 49) umetargeminan uveachasanteh yitbene makdesha, davar hamekuddash laddamim lo yehe ella bechelko shel binyamin, lefichach lo asu yesod lammizbeach bekeren deromit mizrachit, lefi shello hayta bechelko shel toref, velo hayu damim nittanim lematta beoto keren. ucheshehayu osim defus merubba laysod lemalleoto avanim vesid vezefet veoferet kedaamaran, hayu mesimim etz o kol davar beoto zavit shel deromit mizrachit, kede shello titmalle hazzavit hahi, veachar kach shomtin haetz venishar oto keren panuy beli yesod. umippene ze nikra hachelek haemtzai shel mizbeach sovev, lefi shehu makkif vesovev et kol hakkeranot, ma sheen ken baysod:
Lifnim. mechomat har habbayit:
Soreg. mechitztza haasuya nekavim nekavim kemitta mesoreget bachavalim, vehi asuya maddefe etz arukkim uketzarim shemmarkivin otan zo al zo baalachson:
Vegazru chenegdam shelosh esre hishtachavayot. keshemmaggia keneged kol pirtza ufirtza, mishtachave umode al avdan malchut yavan:
Lifnim. meoto soreg haya makom panuy eser ammot, vehu nikra chel:
Ushetem esre maalot hayu sham. kede laalot mishsham leezrat nashim:
Rum maala. kol maala mehen gevoha mechavertah chatzi amma. vechen hammaala harishona gevoha min hakkarka chatzi amma:
Veshilchah. meshech rochav hammaala, dehaynu mekom derisat haregel, chatzi amma:
Chutz mishshel ulam. chutz min hammaalot shebben haulam velammizbeach shello hayu kullam ken, keditnan beferek 3:
Chutz mippetach shel ulam. ditnan lekamman beidach pirkin gavho arbaim amma verachbo esrim:
Hayu lahen shekofot. even munnachat al shete hammezuzot shehaddelet shokef alav. ushekofot leshon mashkof:
Mippene shennaasa vahen nes. kemo shemmeforash beyoma perek 3‏ [daf lach.]:
Matzhivot. kemo mazhivot, shemmaritan doma lezahav lefichach lo hutzrechu laasoto shel zahav:
Bizman shekkohen gadol nichnas lehishtachavot. bahechol. velo mikkarya via shello letzorech:
Baavanim tovot. sheal kitfot haefod:
Higbiah lo et happarochet. shettaluy vefitcho shel ulam. shello haya lefitcho shel ulam delatot kishar petachim shebbammikdash ella farochet bilvad:
Meim lo shachav ish otach vegomer. hinnaki. shehen kelalot habbaot mechamat berachot, demashma ha im shachav lo tinnaki:
Veeno kotev vehishbia hakkohen et haishsha vegomer. sheen ze ella mitzva al hakkohen lehashebiah:

Velo haya kotev veamra haishsha amen amen. sheeno ella kabbala shehaishsha mekabbelet aleha haalot. veyalef la middichtiv haalot haelle. haalot, lerabbot kelalot habbaot mechamat berachot. haelle, lemiute tzavvaot vekabbalot:

Rabbi yose omer eno mafsik. mishshehitchil im lo shachav ish otach ad amen amen. vechotev tzavvaot divhishbia hakkohen et haishsha vekabbalot divamra haishsha amen amen, dedaresh et, lerabbot tzavvaot vekabbalot:

Rabbi yehuda omer kol atzmo eno chotev. kelomar haya zahir beatzmo shello lichtov ella alot bilvad, velo kelalot habbaot mechamat berachot, velo tzavvaot, velo kabbalot. dedaresh haalot velo kelalot habbaot mechamat berachot. haelle, lemiute tzavvaot vekabbalot:
Verashe fispasin. rashe korot boltim veyotzim min hakkotel lehavedil ben ezrat yisrael leezrat kohanim:
Maala hayta sham. beezrat yisrael:
Ugevoha amma. vearkah keorech kol haazara:
Veduchan. shel leviyyim banuy aleha veasuy kemin itztabba, vegova hadduchan amma vachetzi:
Uvo shalosh maalot shel chatzi chatzi amma. sheolin bahen ladduchan:
Kol haazara. mittechillat ezrat yisrael ad [achare] achat esre amma makom panuy shehaya achore bet hakkapporet:
Al rochav. mitztzafon ledarom:

Shelosha asar shearim. kidka chashiv lehu veazil. vehaomer shiva shearim hayu laazara noten taam lishlosha asar hishtachavayot, keneged shelosha asar peratzot sheppartzu malche yavan bassoreg, kidamrinan leel befirkin. vechullah matnitin meforeshet beferek kamma:
Amar balah eni mashkah veshebbalah ba aleha vadderech. shehu gorem lah shello tishte, notelet ketubbatah:
Metu vaalehen. shel kol sotot haruyot lishtot, velo hispiku lehashekotan ad shemmetu:
Bet shammay omrim notlot ketubba. dishtar haomed liggavot kegavuy dame:
Velo shotot. dichtiv (sham) vehevi haish et ishto:
Uvet hillel omrim lo shotot velo notlot ketubbatan. kelomar mittoch shello shotot en notlot ketubbatan, dishtar haomed liggavot lav kegavuy dame:
Haya mevi. hakkohen:
Peyali. kos bilshon yevani:
Min hakkiyyor. dichtiv (Bamidbar 5) mayim kedoshim, veen kedoshim ella shennitkaddeshu bichli:
Keshem shemmemaet. rabbi yehuda bichtav hammegilla, lekamman bematnitin, kach memaet kan bammayim. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Makom haya sham. nikkar mittoch shear ritzpat hahechol:
Vetabbaat kevua vah. leochazah betabbatah ulehagbihah mishshear haritzpa shehi kullah beavne shayish:
Kede sheyyerae. tzarich sheyyitten bah shiur sheyyehe nire venikkar al pene hammayim:
Venatan el hammayim. middelo ketiv venatan bammayim, ella el hammayim, mashma shello yehe nivla betochan:
Hammachazir chov bashsheviit. love sheomer lammalve af al pi chen, umachazir lo maotav, ruach chachamim nocha hemennu:
Lo yachazir levanav. eno chayyav lehachazir levanav im met hagger:

Veim hechezir ruach chachamim nocha hemennu. vedavka levanav shennitgayyeru immo, mishshum deoved kochavim yoresh et aviv min hattora dichtiv (Devarim 2) ki yerushsha leesav natatti et har seir, veim lo yachazir levanav yesh lachush shemma yachzeru lesuram, sheyyomru im hayu ovde chochavim hayu yorshim avihem vehayu tzerichin lehachazir lahem. aval im hayta horatam shello vikdushsha veledatam bikdushsha, demeolam lo yarshu et avihem min hattora velo hayta yerushsha zo reuya lahem leolam, en lachush baze shemma yachzeru lesuram, vehammachazir lahem en ruach chachamim nocha hemennu:

Bishlosha mekomot hakkohanim shomrim. lo mippene pachad listim vegannavim, ella shekkavod ugedulla hu labbayit shello yehe belo shomrim, ushemira zo mitzvatah kol hallayla. vehane shelosha mekomot shehakkohanim shomrim, keneged ma shekkatuv battora (Bamidbar 3) vehachonim lifne hammishkan kedma vegomer‏ shomrim mishmeret kulei‏ lemishmeret, remez lishlosha mishmarot bishlosha mekomot. ucheshem shebbammishkan hayu aharon ushene banav shomrim bishlosha mekomot, af bevet olamim ken:
Bet avtinas uvet hannitzotz. shete aliyyot hayu benuyot betzad shaare haazara. uvet hammoked lo hayta aliyya ella kippa, 352 belaaz, asuya baaretz, kach meforash beresh massechet tamid:

Vehalleviyyim beesrim veechad makom. shebbeesrim vearbaa mekomot hayu tzerichim lishmor hammikdash. kedichtiv bedivre hayyamim, lemizrach haleviyyim shishsha, litzfonah leyom arbaa, lenegbah leyom arbaa, velaasufim shenayim shenayim, lefarvar lammaarav arbaa lammesilla, shenayim lefarvar, hare kan esrim vearbaa mishmarot, shelosha mehen hayu lakkohanim kedaamaran beresha, veesrim veechad lalviyyim. veaf al gav dikra lo amar ella leviyyim, kohanim nammi keruyin leviyyim, dichtiv (Yechezkel 44) vehakkohanim haleviyyim bene tzadok:
Chamishsha. shomrim, al chamishsha shaare har habbayit:
Vearbaa. shomrim acherim al arba pinnotav:
Mittocho. mibbifnim lechomat har habbayit:
Al chamishsha shaare azara. hay tanna savar chamishsha shearim bilvad hayu laazara. vaafillu ledivre haomer lekamman shiva shearim hayu, mode shello haya mishmar ella al chamishsha:

Al arba pinnoteha mibbachutz. lefi sheen yeshiva baazara ella lemalche bet david bilvad, velo haya efshar lashshomer lishmor baamida kol hallayla, lefichach hayu hashshomrim befinnot haazara vechen hashshomrim beshaare haazara shomrim mibbachutz, kede sheyyihyu muttarin bishiva. veasmechuha akkera, dichtiv shenayim lefarvar, kelappe bar, kelomar chutz lechomat haazara:
En tormin min hattame al hattahor. mishshum peseda dechohen:

Veim taram shogeg terumato teruma. vedavka shehayta lah sheat hakkosher vehiggia leonat maasrot kodem shennitmea, demiddeorayta teruma maalyata hi, aval im nitmet kodem shehiggia leonat maasrot lo haveya teruma middeorayta, veim taram afillu shogeg en terumato teruma:
Maaser tevel. maaser rishon shello nittela mimmennu terumat maaser:
Haya mafrish alav veholech. haya mafrish mizze al shear maasrotav:

Im haya yodea bo battechilla. shehu tevel o shehu tame, af al pi shebbeshaa shettaram haya shogeg, sheshshachach shehu tevel o shehu tame, have shogeg karov lemezid, velo asa velo chelum. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Luach. shel etz:
Neyar. shel asavim shekkotshim otam veosim kemin or:
Diftera. or sheeno meubbad kol tzarko, dimliach vekamiach velo afitz:
Bassefer. bakkelaf:
Komos. seraf hailan, umatticho vemayim:
Kankantom. 310. uvelaaz vaderayavelav:
Velo vechol davar shehu roshem. venivla bakkelaf veeno yachol limchot, dekomos vekankantom avde roshem:
Echad patuach lachel. happetach shebbitzfon bet hammoked haya patuach lachel, veshebbidromo haya patuach laazara:
Pishpash katan. shaar katan betoch hashshaar haggadol:

Shebbo nichnasim livlosh et haazara. shehayu nichnasim bechol boker derech oto pishpash lechappes al kol chele sharet shebbaazara sheyyihyu kullan bimkoman. vehachi tenan bemassechet tamid [perek 1] natal et hammafteach ufatach et happishpash venichnas mibbet hammoked laazara vechulei, ellu holchim baachsadra derech hammizrach veellu holchim baachsadra derech hammaarav, hayu bodkin veholchin ad shemmaggiim limkom ose chavittin, higgiu, ellu vaellu omrim shalom hakkol shalom, kelomar kol kele sharet hen bimkoman beshalom:
Livlosh. targum vayyechappes, uvalash:
Venotno. lakkaf:

Leohavo. shebba sham immo lahechol letzorech kach. veim nitpazzer min hakketoret shebbabbazach letoch hakkaf, lefi shehabbazach haya male vegadush ufeamim nofel mimmennu letoch hakkaf, noten ohavo et hakketoret shennitpazzer betoch hakkaf bechafnav shel maktir:
Umelammedim oto. lefi shello hiktir meolam, keditnan leel chadashim lakketoret bou vehafisu, lefichach hutzrechu lelammedo:

Shemma tatchil lefanecha shello tikkave. haya shofech hakketoret al haggechalim letzad maarav rachok mimmennu, ucheshehaya mitpazzer letzad atzmo haya tzovro, kidamrinan beyoma [daf mat] kede sheyyehe ashanah shohe lavo, vezehu chavod sheyyehe shohe vaavoda. vehaya tzover veose haggal letzad maarav, shekkeshebba ligror hakketoret hassamuch lo hu tzovro letzad maarav rachok mimmennu veeno nichve min hakketoret shennisraf. aval im haya ose haggal lefanav, kesheyyeesof hakketoret shennitpazzer chutza lo umevio etzlo, nimtza zeroo nichve vetzibbur hakketoret shessaraf lefanav. vehayenu detanya beferek hotziu lo [yoma sof daf nov.] tzover penima shehu chutza lo:
Hitchil meradded veyotze. kelomar miyyad sheridded hakketoret al gabbe gechalim yatza:

Parshu haam. kol hakkohanim porshim mibben haulam velammizbeach bishat haketarat hakketoret, dichtiv (Vayikra 16) vechol adam lo yihye veohel moed bevoo lechapper bakkodesh, kol kappara shennaaset bakkodesh, kol adam lo yihye veohel moed, hilkach ben bishat haketara ben bishat mattan damim shel par kohen mashiach ufar helem davar shel tzibbur useire avoda zara, hayu hakkohanim porshim mibben haulam velammizbeach. aval bishat haketarat ketoret shel yom hakkippurim lo hayu forshim ella min hahechol bilvad, lefi shekketoret shel yom hakkippurim lo haya vachutz bahechol al mizbach hazzahav, ella lifnay velifnim bevet kodesh hakkodashim, hilkach en tzarich sheyyifreshu mibben haulam velammizbeach ella min hahechol bilvad:
Vehiggish. lekeren maaravit deromit:
Vehashshear neechol lakkohanim. shekkol hannikmatzot sheyarehen neechalim:

Haya mashkah veachar kach makriv et minchatah. telata kerae ketive. vehishkah kamma, veachar yashke, vehishkah batra. vehishkah kamma, legufeh, shemmashke achar shennimchaka hammegilla kodem haketarat hammincha. veachar yashke, af al gav demashma davka, al karchach mikra haamur rishon nidrash legufo, umikraot yeterot haamurot acharav nittenu liddaresh, hilkach veachar yashke af al pi shennichtav achar haketarat hammincha akkodem haketara kae, veammechika hakketuva lemala kae, vekaamar deim lo nimchaka yafe vaadayin rishshuman shel otiyyot nikkar lo yashkenna. vehishkah batra, leashmoinan sheim nimchaka hammegilla veamra eni shota, meararim otah umashkin otah beal karchah:

Rabbi shimon omer makriv et minchatah veachar kach mashkah. al karchacha veachar yashke davka hu vedavka katveh leachar haketara. vehishkah kamma, sheim bediavad hishkah veachar kach hikriv minchatah, keshera. vehishkah batra, sheim nimchaka hammegilla veamra eni shota, meararin otah umashkin otah beal karchah. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

En tormin lo vemidda. dichtiv (sham) venechshav lachem terumatchem, bemachashava atta torem, kelomar meomed, vei atta torem lo vemidda velo vemishkal velo veminyan. veaf al gav dehay kera bitrumat maaser hu dichtiv, im eno inyan litrumat maaser, shehare natna vo tora shiur maaser min hammaaser vetzarich sheyyimdod kede sheyyitten hashshiur harauy, tenehu inyan litruma gedola shello natna vo tora shiur:
Aval torem hu et hammadud. shemmoded hu et tivlo, o mone veshokel et tivlo, umachniso letoch beto, ucheshemmafrish hatteruma gedola mimmennu mafrish meomed velo yimdod velo yishkol velo yimne:
En tormin besal uvekuppa shehem shel midda. sheharoe omer bemidda hu torem:
Aval torem hu vahen chetzyan ushelishan. dechevan deeno memalle otan lekka lemigzar:
Shechetzyah midda. sheyyesh bassea peamim simanin ad mekom chetzyah, veikka lemigzar dilma atu litrom bemidda:
En tormin mittahor al hattame. gezera shemma yitrom shello min hammukkaf mishshum demistefe shemma yigga hattame battahor vitammeennu, vaanan bainan shehattorem yitrom min hammukkaf:

Beemet amru. kol hecha detaninan beemet amru keillu hi halacha lemoshe missinay, aval lav davka halacha lemoshe missinay, shehare beferek kamma deshabbat shaninu beemet amru hachazzan roe hechan hattinokot korin, umidderabbanan hi:
Haiggul shel devela. af al pi shehaddevelot medubbakot zo vazo betoch haiggul enan chashuvot chibbur leinyan tuma, veim naga tuma beachat min haddevelot lo nitmet haacheret:

Vechen agudda shel yarak vechen arema. tzeriche, dei ashmeinan iggul hava amena iggul shekkullo guf echad torem, agudda sheenah guf echad eno torem. vei ashmeinan agudda hava amena agudda shehakkol tefusa achat torem, arema sheenah tefusa achat eno torem, tzeriche:
Rabbi eliezer omer tormim. lechattechilla min hattahor al hattame, delo gazar rabbi eliezer shemma yavo litrom shello min hammukkaf. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:

Enah maspeket lishtot vechulei. baggemara mochiach dematnitin rabbi akiva hi desavar kerabbi shimon deamar makriv minchatah veachar kach mashke otah, dechamma delo karva minchatah lo badke lah mayya, dichtiv (Bamidbar 5) minchat zikkaron mazkeret avon:
Mitmallet gidin. mittoch shebbesarah nafuach niret kimlea gidim:

Shello tetamme et haazara. lo mittumat met kaamar, ella shello tifros nidda utetamme shaar nikkanor veezrat nashim shettetze derech sham, shennidda vezava asurin lichnos behar habbayit. aval hammet atzmo muttar lehacheniso lehar habbayit uleshaar nikkanor, shello nitkaddeshu bikdushshat haazara:
Yesh lah zechut vechulei. baggemara mefaresh dizchut detora hu detole lah, sheholicha baneha levet hassefer vehimtina levalah sheyyatza chutz lair laasok battora:
Keillu melammedah tiflut. chibbur mishkav anashim. shemmittoch hattora hi mevina armimut veosa devareha behetznea. kedichtiv (Mishlei 8) ani chachma shachanti arma:
Rotza ishsha vekav. lizzon mezonot muatim, vihe tashmish matzuy lah:
Mittisha kabbin uferishut. lifrosh min hattashmish, hilkach en tov shettilmod tora:
Chasid shote. mefaresh baggemara kegon detava ishsha bannahar veamar lav orach ara leistakkule beitteta uleatztzola:

Rasha arum. kegon hammatim devarav laddayyan kodem sheyyavo baal din chavero. umishshenniftechu belev haddayyan shaare zechut ledivre ze, kashe lesallekan, vahare rishato vearmato shel ze sheavar al lo tissa shema shav (Shemot 23):

Veishsha ferusha. kegon ishsha kashfanit shehayta otzeret rechem hannashim hayyoldot bichshafeha, uveshaa shehayta hayyoledet maksha belidtah hayta omeret elech veetpallel ulay tekubbal tefillati, vesoteret keshafeha veyoledet:

Umakkot perushim. shemmakke atzmo lehareot shehu anav vetzanua, kegon shemmehallech akev betzad guddal veeno merim raglo min haaretz umittoch kach menakkef etzbeotav baavanim, vehu shennikra baggemara parush nakpi. o mi sheose atzmo keotzem enav shello lehistakkel bannashim, umittoch kach makke rosho bakkotel veyotze mimmennu dam, vehu hannikra parush kozai, kelomar shemmakkiz dam merosho mechamat perishuto:
Hare ellu mechalle olam. sherotzim lehareot labberiyyot shehem chasidim, veen tocham kevaram:
Hammagrefa. keli gadol shehayu zorkim oto chede lehashemia kol, vehakkol hayyotze mimmennu meshammesh shelosha devarim kedimfaresh veazel:
Kohen hashshomea kolah. im lo haya vaazara:
Ratz uva. lehishtachavot im echav hakkohanim:
Verosh hammaamad. keshehaya shomea kol hammagrefa:
Haya maamid et hattemeim. shel oto vet av shello hayu reuyim laavod:

Beshaare hammizrach. it deamre chede levayyeshan ulehodia shemmippene tumat keri hu nimna laavod, kede sheyyizzaher paam acheret. veit deamre mippene hachashad, shello yachsheduhu shellimlachto halach vehinniach millaavod, aval yedu shemmippene tumat ones shel sheretz o davar acher nimna millaavod. veharambam katav, shemmetzoraim shekkevar taharu mitztzaratam haya maamidam beshaar hammizrach, kede sheyyihyu mezummanim lizrok alehem dam haasham:
Ish har habbayit. memunne al kol hashshomrim:
Arusa veshomeret yavam. arusa shekkinne lah arus veshomeret yavam shekkinne lah yavam:
Lo shotot. demaatinhu kera:

Velo notlot ketubba. shehi garma leesor atzmah alav, shennistera achar kinnuy, demikkinnuy veissur lo imit, dichtiv (Bamidbar 5) dabber el bene yisrael kulei, lerabbot arusa veshomeret yavam lekinnuy:
Tachat ishah. beyoshevet tachtav hakkatuv medabber:
Netina. min haggivonim. vaasurim lavo bakkahal:
Lo shotot. delo neemra parasha ella baruya lekayyemah, dichtiv (sham) ki tiste ishto, baruya leishut hakkatuv medabber, perat lealmana lechohen gadol vechulei:
Velo notlot ketubba. veaf al gav dishar almanot lechohen gadol govot ketubbatan kidamrinan bichtubbot [100: vechen bivamot 84.], zo en lah ketubba, shessetiratah garma lah:
Nitmet minchatah ad shello kadsha vakkeli hare hi kechol hammenachot. shennitmeu ad shello kiddeshu vichli:
Vetippade. vetetze lechullin, umin hammaot yikne acheret:
Vetissaref. shekkadsha kedushshat hagguf veenah yotza od lechullin:

Vechol hannesuot lechohanim minchotehen nisrafot. vaafillu karav kometz kehilchato velo nitmet, nisrafim sheyareha al bet haddeshen veenan neechalim, mippene sheyyesh lakkohen balah chelek bah, shemmishshello hi baa, vehattora amra (Vayikra 6) vechol minchat kohen kalil tihye lo teachel, veen kullah kalil mippene sheyyesh lah chelek bah shellechapparatah hi baa, ha ketzad, hakkometz karev beatzmo vehashshirayim kerevin beatzman:
Nichnasim derech yamin umakkifin derech semol. kegon hannichnasim derech shaare chulda shehen min hayyamin, makkifin derech shaar hattadi:
Sheani avel. nishalin oto ma lecha lehakkif lismol, veamar sheani avel, omrim lo hashshochen babbayit hazze yenachemcha vechulei:
Asitan keillu avru alav et haddin. im hen omrim lo ken, nire keillu chaverav ivvetu haddin venidduhu shello kahalacha:
Yitten belibbecha shettishma ledivre chaverecha. hasheta mashma shehu asa shello kaddin vetzarich teshuva. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Kekitonot. kachadarim ketannim happetuchim levayit gadol shel melachim dehaynu teraklin:
Shetayim bakkodesh ushetayim bachol. shebbet hammoked ketzato banuy betoch haazara hamekuddeshet umiktzato bachol:
Verashe fispasin. rashe korot yotzim min hakkotel ad hammakom shehu kodesh, kede ladaat eze kodesh veeze chol veleechol kadashim bakkodesh:
Lishkat telae karban. shehayu sham telaim mevukkarim litmidim, keditnan en pochatim mishshishsha telaim belishkat telaim:
Lishkat ose lechem happanim. bet garmu hayu osim lechem happanim sham:
Sheshshikketzum malche yavan. shehiktiru alav laavoda zara. uvemassechet shekalim uvemassechet tamid kore lah lishkat hachotamot:

Bah yordin levet hattevila. beotah lishka haya yored hakkohen sheraa keri veholech bammechilla (sheachar) [shettachat] bet hammikdash levet hattevila, vesham medura shemmitchammem bah hakkohen leachar shettaval veala venistappeg, velishkat hammoked hi keruya, vehi petucha levet hammoked haggadol:
Sheviit meshammetet et hammilva. hammalve et chavero veavra alav sheviit achar hahalvaa, eno yachol litboa halevaato mechavero, kedichtiv (Devarim 15) shamot kol baal mashshe yado:
Bishtar. shekkatav lo shetar beachrayut nechasim veshibed karkaot al hammilva demechaze kemi shemmishken, karkaot etzlo, af al pi chen sheviit meshammatto:
Hakkafat hachanut. shekkana mimmennu baamana:
Enah meshammetet. deen ze chov veen zo derech milva:
Veim asaah milva. shechishshav im hakkone uzekafan alav bemilva:

Harishon harishon meshammet. im lakach baamana paam rishona min hachanut vechazar velakach sheniyya, harishona naaset milva umeshammetet velo hashsheniya. chazar velakach shelishit, rishona usheniyya naasu milvot usheviit meshammattan velo hashshelishit. vechen leolam, haacharona en sheviit meshammattah vechol haacherot sheviit meshammattan, hoil vehaya rauy sheyyitten lo meot harishona kodem sheyyikkach hashshenit behakkafa velo natan, naaset harishona milva, vechen leolam. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Kol melacha shepposeket bashsheviit. im sechar sachir ze mimmelachot happoskot bashsheviit, kelomar mimmelachot sheasur laasotan bashsheviit, kegon charisha uketzira vaavodat karka, naasa sachar ze bashsheviit kemilva, usheviit meshammetet. veim lav, shessachar ze shechayyav lo haya mishshear melachot sheen asurot bashsheviit, lo naasa kemilva veen sheviit meshammetet. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Haya mevi. habbaal:
Et minchatah. kedichtiv (Bamidbar 5) vehevi et karbanah:
Bichfifa mitzrit. sal asuy mitztzure haddekel min (harach) [zeradim] haggedelim sevivot haddekel:

Kede leyaggeah. shettode velo yimmache hashshem al hammayim. uleman deamar shebbitchilla haya mashke otah veachar kach mevi minchatah, af al pi shennimchak hashshem, meyaggeah kede shettode velo tamut mita menuvvelet, sheaf al pi shennimchaka hammegilla im amra temea ani enah shota:
Techillatan vesofan bichli sharet. lav bichli sharet mammash kaamar, sheen adam mevi minchato mittoch beto bichli sharet, ella biklatot shel kesef veshel zahav shehem reuyim lichle sharet:
Vezo bichfifa mitzrit. sheen rauy laasot mimmenna keli sharet, dedami lehakerivehu na lefechatecha (Malachi 1):

Kol hammenachot teunot shemen ulevona. baggemara parech, veha ikka minchat chote dichtiv bah (Vayikra 5) lo yasim aleha shemen velo yitten aleha levona. vechen ha ditninan kol hammenachot baot chittim, kashe, deha minchat haomer baa min hasseorim. umetoratz baggemara lo titne milleta beanpe nafsheh ella keroch vetane, vehachi kaamar, kol hammenachot teunot shemen ulevona, veotan sheenam teunot shemen ulevona baot min hachittin uvaot solet. minchat chote af al pi sheenah teuna shemen ulevona baa chittin uvaa solet. minchat haomer af al pi shebbaa min hasseorin teuna shemen ulevona:
Uvaa geres. vezo enah teuna shemen ulevona uvaa min hasseorim uvaa kemach:
Geres. mevorar umenuppe bishlosh esre nafa keen solet bachittim:
Kemach. hakkol meorav kemo shennitchan:
Bet hammoked kippa. binyan shel bet hammoked lo haya aliyya, ella kippa 352 belaaz asuya baaretz:

Mukkaf rovadim shel even. itztabbaot saviv shel avne gazit hayu meshukkaot bakkotel veyotzot min hakkotel letoch bet hammoked letzad hakkarka, veal gabbehen avanim acherot ketzarot mehen sheyyotzot nammi min hakkotel, vehayu keen maalot zo al zo:
Vezikne vet av. hammishmar haya mitchallek leshiva batte avot keminyan yemot hashshavua, kol echad oved yomo, vezikne bet av shel oto yom hayu yeshenim sham al otan rovadim:
Ufirche chehunna. bachurim shemmatchil sear zekanam lifroach, vehem hayu hashshomrim:
Ish kisto vaaretz. shello hayu rashshaim lishkav sham al gabbe mittot ella baaretz, kederech sheshshomre chatzrot hammelachim osim:
Kisto. leshon karim uchesatot:
Vechen leinyan hattova. notnim lo laadam sachar meen hattova sheasa. umihu yoter mimma sheasa mishtallem, demidda tova merubba betashlumin mimmiddat puranut:
Mi shekkinne leishto venistara afillu shama meof happoreach. shennistera:

Yotzi veyitten ketubba. rabbi eliezer letaameh deamar beferek kamma setira lo baya edut, vaafillu eved vaafillu shifcha neemanim, dehaynu nammi keof happoreach, deittakkash setira letuma dechullehu mehemone vah, hilkach neesra alav. veim eno rotze lehashekotah yotzi veyitten ketubba:

Rabbi yehoshua omer ad sheyyisu veyittenu vah mozrot ballevana. nashim hattoot leor hallevana. rabbi yehoshua letameh deamar mashke al pi shenayim. mihu mishsheyyisseu veyittenu bah mozrot ballevana bifritzutah mechoar haddavar vetetze, deha afillu mayya tu lo badke lah kidtanya beferek kamma. utehora hi. velo sheyyisseu veyittenu bah mozrot ballevana. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:
Bizman shekkohen gadol rotze lehaketir. shehu maktir kol zeman sheyyirtze, venotel chelek kesheyyirtze:
Lemachatzit hakkevesh. uchevar nityaggea ketzat:
Vesamach alehen. mishshum kevodo shel kohen gadol, shettehe chashuva haketarato yoter mishshear kohanim:
Uzerakan. kiddarshinan veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam (Devarim 12), ma dam bizrika af basar bizrika:
Nishmat hashsheni vehalach lo. aval harishon nishar sham lekabbel haevarim min hammoshitim velittenan lechohen gadol:

Ba lo lehakkif et hammizbeach. kohen gadol shehaya verosh hakkevesh shehu vaddarom, makkif derech yamin, dechol pinnot sheatta fone lo yehu ella derech yamin, lechach haya holech lemizrachit deromit umishsham litzfonit mizrachit, ad shemmaggia lemaaravit deromit mekom hannekavim shehayyayin vehammayim shemmenassechim yordin bahen umishsham holchim lashshitin shehen hayesodot, vesham omed kohen echad umoshit lo hayyayin lannesachim, aval kohen gadol lo haya nose hayyayin immo, shemma yitkalkel hayyayin baashan hammaaracha cheshemmakkif et hammizbeach, uveod shehu makkif mehappech betzinnora, dehaynu mazleg, et haevarim shello nitakkelu al hammizbeach. aval shear hakkohanim kesheosim nissuch hayyayin, holchim derech semol min hakkevesh lidromit maaravit shehu karov lakkevesh, keditnan perek kadshe kadashim (zevachim perek 6 mishna 2), kol haolin holchim derech yamin chutz min haole lishlosha devarim, nissuch hayyayin vehammayim veolat haof. hayyayin vehammayim, shello yitashshenu. veolat haof nammi shello tamut beashan. vechohen gadol sheddome leven bayit sheyyesh lo reshut lehallech kemo shehu chafetz ma sheen shear hakkohanim rashshaim laasot ken, vegam yesh lo reshut lehappech betzinnora velo fayis, yesh lo lehakkif kede lalechet derech yamin:
Hassegan omed al hakkeren. etzel hakkohen gadol shebba lenassech:
Vehassudarim beyado. lehanif kesheyyenassech hakkohen. kede sheyyedu haleviyyim vidabberu vashshir, veyeda ben arza veyakkish batztzeltzal, kidamar besamuch:

Al shulchan hachalavim. shete shulchanot hayu vemaaravo shel kevesh, echad shulchan shel kesef shebbo notnin kele sharet, veechad shulchan shel shayish shebbo notnim haevarin, vehu nikra shulchan hachalavim:
Ben arza. shem adam hammakkish batztzeltzal, 172 belaaz:
Higgiu leferek. lesof parasha:
Madhe atta et hammayim. mechasser umachshich. haggaven hechaser nikra diha bilshon mishna:
Mitnavvena veholechet. nechelet veholechet:
Zehu gufo shel perozbul. ikkaro vesharsho:
Vehaddayyanim chotmim lematta o haedim. lehachi katane haddayyanim o haedim, lelammedcha sheyyachol haed lihyot dayyan o haddayyan ed, devidrabbanan ed naase dayyan, uferozbul derabbanan hu:
Tormin zete shemen. haomdim lehotzi shamnan:

Al zete chevesh. zetim sheen osim shemen, vechovshim otan beyayin o vechometz lekayyem otan laachila. vezete shemen yafin mizzete chevesh, hilkach mafrishim mizzete shemen al zete chevesh dahava leh min hayyafe al hara:
Veyayin sheeno mevushshal. yafe lishtiyya min hamevushshal:
Kol shehu chilayim bachavero lo yitrom mizze laze. deamar kera (Bamidbar 18) kol chelev yitzhar vechol chelev tirosh vedagan, amra tora, ten chelev laze vechelev laze:
Chutz min hazzunin. baaravi 64 uvelaaz 107, veeno ochel adam umekayyemim oto layyonim:
Hakkishshut. baaravi 247:
Vehammelaffon. baaravi 241:
Min echad. vetormin mizze al ze:
Shene minim. veen tormin mizze al ze, veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Hashshochet et happara. beshana sheviit, vechillekah beyom rishon shel shene yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana, im haya elul meubbar nimtza deyom echad shennitchalleka haya chol vehaya yom acharon shel elul shel shana hashsheviit, usheviit meshammetet besofah, dichtiv (Devarim 15) mikketz sheva shanim taase shemitta:
Haones vehamefatte. shennotnim chamishshim shekel:
Vehammotzi shem ra. shennoten mea:
Vechol maase vet din. mamon shekkatvu alav pesak din, chayyav atta litten lo:
En mashmitin. shekkevan sheppasku bet din al hammamon, kegavuy dami ucheillu higgia leyado:
Hammalve al hammashkon. dichtiv (sham) vaasher yihye lecha et achicha tashmet yadecha, perat laze sheyyesh leachicha beyadecha:
Vehammoser shetarotav levet din. dichtiv vaasher yihye lecha et achicha, perat lemoser shetarotav levet din, shebbet din yesh lahem ze hachov etzel achiv:
Meubberet chavero. shemmet o gershah vehinnichah meubberet o menika. vaasaruha chachamim linnase ad sheyyihye havvalad ben shete shanim. vehalach ze unesaah kodem hazzeman, vekinne lah venistera:
Lo shota. shehare enah reuya lekayyemah, disvira leh lerabbi meir hannose meubberet chavero o meneket chavero yotzi velo yachzir olamit. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Yachol hu lehaferishah. ad esrim vearbaa chodashim ulehachzirah, hilkach reuya leishut karina bah:
Aylonit. ducheranita delo yalda:
Vesheenah reuya leled. sheshshatta kos akarin. veasur lekayyeman lemi sheen lo vanim:
Rabbi eliezer omer yachol hu lissa ishsha acheret. veyihye muttar lekayyem et zot, hilkach reuya leishut hi. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Orech. min hammizrach lammaarav:
Al rochav. min hatztzafon laddarom:
Keturot ella sheenan mekorot. milleshon vehinne ala kitor haaretz (Bereshit 19), kelomar maalot ashan, lefi sheen lahen tikra:
Umeshallechim tachat haddud. lesarfan baesh shettachat hayyora shemmevashshelim bah hashshelamim, dichtiv (Bamidbar 6) venatan al haesh asher tachat zevach hashshelamim:
Matliin baetzim. mesirin haetzim shennimtza bahen tolaat, lefi shehen pesulim lammaaracha:
Lishkat metzoraim. sheshsham hammetzoraim tovlim bashshemini letohoratan keshebba lehachenis yado bifnim lemattan behonot veaf al pi shettaval mibbaerev:

Amar rabbi eliezer ben yaakov shachachti me hayta meshammeshet. mikkelal deresha kulla rabbi eliezer ben yaakov kaamar lah, vehachi muchach baggemara deyoma distam matnitin demiddot rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hi:
Vachalaka hayta barishona. peresh rambam, perutza, shello hayta mukkefet mechitztza:
Ketzotztera. kemo gezuzetra hikkifu saviv leezrat nashim, sheyyihyu hannashim omdot lemala al haggezuzetra vehaanashim lematta lirot besimchat bet hashshoeva, kede shello yavou lide kallut rosh:
Chamesh esre maalot. gova karka ezrat yisrael meezrat nashim:
Lo hayu terutot. arukkot uvaale zaviyyot kederech kol hammaalot, ella agullot kachatzi goren agulla:
Higgia zeman hanneila. linol shaare haazara:

Hakkohen mibbifnim uven levi yoshev lo mibbachutz. shehaleviyyim tefelim lakkohanim, kema shenneemar (Bamidbar 18) veyillavu alecha vishartucha. hilkach bevet avtinas uvevet hannitzotz shehayu aliyyot, hayu hakkohanim shomrim lemala uleviyyim lematta. uvet hammoked shello hayta ella kippa al haaretz, haya kohen mibbifnim uven levi mibbachutz:

Bammesibba. bammechilla hamehallechet tachat habbira, shemmechilla hayta tachat hammikdash. vechol hammikdash karuy bira, kedichtiv (divrei hayamim 1 29) el habbira asher hachinoti. umippene shehaya baal keri, lo haya mehallech derech haazara ella derech hammechillot, dekayma lan mechillot lo nitkaddeshu:
Vehannerot dolkim. bammechilla mikkan umikkan:

Bammesibba haholechet tachat hachel yotze. veeno chozer levet hammoked, lefi shehu tevul yom. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov, ella keditnan beresh tamid, ba veyashav lo etzel echav hakkohanim bevet hammoked ad shehashshearim niftachim, yotze veholech lo, sheaf al gav shettevul yom asur lehikkanes leezrat nashim dehaynu machane leviyya, laze hekellu, lefi shennitma bifnim:

Zetim hannichbashim. zetim meluchim uchevushim beyayin o vechometz kede sheyyitkayyemu, vachashive davar shennigmera melachto, hilkach tormin min hashshemen alehem, dedavka shemen al zetim haomdim lehotzi shamnan. vechen yayin al anavim haomdot liddarech hu deasur litrom, aval yayin al tzimmukim veshemen al zetim hannichbashim share. ucheshehu torem min hashshemen al hazzetim hannichbashim umin hayyayin al hatztzimmukim torem lefi hashshemen harauy sheyyetze min hazzetim hannichbashim ulefi hayyayin harauy sheyyetze min hatztzimmukim:
En tzarich litrom. hoil vechi ka taram shappir ka taram, shehare beotah shaa hayu omdot laachila:

Kavveret devorim vechulei. keshehi mechubberet betit hakkol modim shehi kekarka lechol davar, veim hayta munachat al gabbe yetedot hakkol modim shehi kechelim veenah kekarka, lo nechleku ella shemmunachat al gabbe karka veenah mechubberet betit:
Rabbi eliezer omer hare hi chekarka. veniknet bechesef bishtar uvachazaka kekarka:
Vechotvin aleha perozbul. im yesh lallove kavveret keillu haya lo karka:
Veenah mekabbelet tuma. kederech shehakkarka hamechubbar eno mekabbel tuma:

Veharode. mechallot devash shebbetochah beshabbat chayyav chattat ketolesh davar mimmekom chibburo, dichtiv (Shmuel 1 14) vayyitbol otah beyarat haddevash, vechi ma inyan yaar etzel devash, ella ma yaar hattolesh mimmennu beshabbat chayyav chattat, af devash harode mimmennu beshabbat chayyav chattat. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Hammachazir chov bashsheviit. besof sheviit, dehaynu bishmitatah, sheen sheviit meshammetet ella besofah, shenneemar (Devarim 15) mikketz sheva shanim:
Amar lo af al pi chen. amar lo hallove af al pi chen ani rotze lifroa lecha:
Yekabbel mimmennu. velo od ella shemmuttar lo shettehe yado peshuta lekabbel beshaa sheomer lo meshammet ani:

Shenneemar veze devar hashshemitta. kelomar dibbur bealma shemmotzi mippiv shehu meshammet dayyo, uvedibbur rishon sheamar meshammet ani saggi, veen tzarich sheyyomar veyishne, shenneemar veze devar, en lecha ella dibbur rishon, vechen veze devar harotzeach:
Vechohenet shennisset leyisrael. bat kohen:
Minchatah neechelet. dechol minchat kohen kalil tihye ketiv, kohen velo kohenet. vechen kohenet almana ugerusha shehevia minchat nedava, neechelet:
Kohenet mitchallelet. min hatteruma umin hakkehunna, im nivala lappesulim shuv enah chozeret lechashrutah leolam:

Kohen eno mitchallel. im nasa gerusha chalala o zona, ella kol zeman shehu immah hu pasul laavoda, mishsheggershah chozer lehechshero, dichtiv (sham 21) velo yechallel zaro, zaro chalal, vehu eno chalal:
Kohenet mittammea lemetim. dichtiv (sham) bene aharon, velo venot aharon:
Veen kohenet ochelet bekadshe kadashim. dechattat veasham umincha bechulehu ketiv (sham 6) kol zachar bivne aharon yochlenu:

Hechellu. otam shezzachu vechaf shel ketoret uvemachta shel gechalim lihyot olim bemaalot haulam, sheshshetem esre maalot hayu laulam. velifnehem hayu makdimim lalechet mi shezzacha vedishshun mizbeach happenimi kede lehotzi et hatteni shehinniach sham, meachar shetztzarich latet deshen etzel hammizbeach kedma kemo dishshun hammenora, haya mamtin ad leachar zerikat hattamid shehaya hazzoche vedishshun hammenora ose hatavat shete nerot vegomer hashelamat dishshun hammenora, veaz hayu shenehen motziin ze hatteni veze hakkuz veshofchim haddeshen bemakom echad etzel hammizbeach kedma:
Vehishtachava veyatza. sheatta nigmera mitzvato:

Metzao shekkava. kegon leachar shemmet shimon hatztzaddik shello haya hannes, ben shekkava achshav leachar shechitat hattamid, ben shemmetzao shekkava kodem shechitat hattamid vehidliko kedaamaran leel beferek amar lahem hamemunne kamma, af al pi sheachshav metzao adayin dolek, kevan shello haya hannes kayyam, mechabbehu umedashsheno kede ligmor hatavat shete nerot yachad:

Umadliko meal mizbach haola. sheen madlikin ner maaravi leolam ella meesh shel mizbach haola, dichtiv (Vayikra 6) esh tamid tukad al hammizbeach, esh shenneemar bah tamid dichtiv (sham 24) lehaalot ner tamid, meal hammizbeach hachitzon tukad:
Mimmaala sheniyya. shel shalosh maalot shehayu lifne hammenora:
Vehishtachava veyatza. shehare gamar mitzvato:
Kach bodkim oto. et habboel:
Uvau uvau. shenehem bevav yetera lidrasha:
Nitmea venitmaa. vav yetera divvenitmea sheniyya lidrasha:
Rabbi omer shene feamim vechulei. rabbi lo daresh vav yetera kerabbi akiva ella ribbuy dikrae ka daresh, ben beuvau uvau, ben benitmea venitmaa:

En tormin zetim al hashshemen. mi sheyyesh lo shemen shechayyav lehaferish mimmennu teruma, vezetim shechayyav lehaferish mehen teruma, eno yachol litrom min hazzetim kefi hashshiur sheyyesh lo litrom al hazzetim veal hashshemen, veliftor hashshemen bitrumat hazzetim, dichtiv (Bamidbar 18) kaddagan min haggoren, min haggamur al haggamur, velo mimma sheeno gamur al haggamur:
Veim taram bet shammay omrim terumat atzman yesh bahen. kelomar en kan teruma ella al hazzetim bilvad, aval lo al hashshemen:
Uvet hillel omrim enah teruma. hoil venitkavven litrom gam al hashshemen en kan teruma lo al hazzetim velo al hashshemen, vahare hu keillu lo taram kelal:
Megillatah nignezet. betzad hahechol:
Uminchatah mitpazzeret al haddashen. venisrefet al bet haddeshen shehaya baazara shessorfim sham pesule kadshe kadashim, dehoil vekadsha bichli sharet teuna serefa baazara:
Veen megillatah keshera lehashekot [bah] sota acheret. devainan ketiva lishmah, dichtiv (sham) veasa lah hakkohen, kol asiyyatah lishmah:
Hammayim nishpachin. dechevan deamra temea ani, beduka veomedet hi. umayim hammarim lo nittenu ella levarer bahem et hassafek:
Meararim otah. dedilma tehora hi, umechamat beituta kaamra:
